t: Fill in the blank: A ______ of bees swarmed near the tree.
e: Bees are collectively called a 'swarm'.

t: Fill in the blank: The ______ (Quiet/Quite) library was perfect for studying.
e: 'Quiet' means silent; 'quite' means to a great extent.

t: Fill in the blank: This laptop is, ______, the best in its price range.
e: 'By far the best' is a fixed superlative-emphasis phrase.

t: Schools will restart physical classes partially and states have ______ their own conditions and procedures to ensure the safety of students.
e: Devised (योजना बनाना) means to plan or invent something by careful thought. The sentence discusses preparations made by schools, so "devised" fits best. Insisted means to assert firmly; accepted means to agree; adopted means to take up.

t: Unable to check her ______, Alice ran after the rabbit down the rabbit hole.
e: Curiosity (जिज्ञासा) means a desire to know or learn. Alice followed the rabbit because she couldn't control her desire to know more. Pleasure means happiness; Nervousness means anxiety; Wisdom means sound judgement.

t: Delhi University's new institution called School of Public Health will offer a ______ of programs.
e: Plethora (बहुतायत) means a very large amount of something. The sentence indicates the institution offers many programs, so "plethora" fits.

t: Some people think that the credit card culture encourages people to shop compulsively and merely ______ debts.
e: Accumulate (इकट्ठा करना) means to gather together over time. The sentence discusses debts piling up due to compulsive shopping.

t: According to experts, some sectors remain ______ during these difficult times, including banking and financial services, FMCG, food, and technology.
e: Resilient (लचीला/सहनशील) means able to withstand or recover quickly from difficult conditions, fitting the context of sectors surviving tough times.

t: Countries like China and the United States invest ______ in wind, hydro, solar and biofuels.
e: "Heavily" (भारी मात्रा में) indicates a large degree of investment, matching the context of major spending on renewable energy.

t: Is there ______ buttermilk in the cooler?
e: "Any" is used with countable/uncountable nouns in questions and negative sentences to ask about an unspecified amount.

t: Take possession of the records immediately so that they are not ______ with.
e: "Tampered with" (छेड़छाड़ करना) means to interfere with something in an unauthorized way; this past participle fits the passive structure "are not tampered with."

t: Stereotypes may be used to justify ill-founded ______ or ignorance, and prevent people of stereotyped groups from succeeding in various fields.
e: Prejudices (पूर्वाग्रह) means preconceived negative opinions without justification, which logically follows from stereotypes as stated in the sentence.

t: Recycling is a key component of modern waste reduction and is the third component of the 'Reduce, Reuse and Recycle' waste hierarchy ______ aim is to extract the maximum practical benefits from products.
e: "Whose" (जिसका) is a possessive pronoun showing that the waste hierarchy possesses an aim, correctly linking the clause.

t: New York ______ its roots back to 1624, when it was founded as a trading post by colonists of the Dutch Republic.
e: "Traces" (पता लगाना) means to follow something back to its origin, fitting the context of finding New York's historical beginning.

t: Treks in wilderness areas are even ______ as children can then engage with all kinds of life-forms.
e: "Even better" (और भी बेहतर) is the correct comparative phrase here; "best" is superlative and grammatically unsuitable in this context.

t: ______ the attractions of Hampi are beautiful temples...
e: "Among" (के बीच) is a preposition showing membership within a larger group, fitting that the attractions are part of a bigger set.

t: ...ranging ______ the hills of Pavagadh, and extending into the city of Champaner.
e: "From" (से) indicates distance from a reference point, correctly describing the bastions ranging from the hills.

t: He named it ______ his friend and general Champa...
e: "Named after" (के नाम पर) is a fixed phrase meaning to give someone's name to something, fitting the naming of the city.

t: They are made to believe, by ______ publicity, that the new products will enhance their happiness.
e: Ubiquitous (सर्वव्यापी) means seeming to be everywhere; publicity for gadgets is described as appearing everywhere.

t: Due to this, it would ______ easily.
e: The passage discusses fabric fading and wearing out from sun and rain, so "rip and tear" logically describes the fabric's deterioration.

t: ...the rain makes a more ______ colour.
e: "Soft" describes a faded, muted colour caused by sun and rain, matching the description of worn clothing.

t: Rajasthan is ______ to the Darrah Wildlife Sanctuary.
e: "Home to" (का घर) means a place where something is located, fitting that the sanctuary is situated within Rajasthan.

t: ...some may be taken up by plants and released back into the atmosphere through a process called ______.
e: Transpiration (वाष्पोत्सर्जन) is the process by which plants release absorbed water as vapour, matching the context exactly.

t: ...they release their moisture through ______, which can fall as rain...
e: Precipitation (वर्षण) refers to moisture falling from clouds as rain, snow, etc., matching the described process.

t: ...which can ______ tissue, joints, artery walls and organs.
e: Damage (नुकसान) means harm caused to something; inflammation negatively affecting tissues fits this context.

t: The finest example is the ______ of bottled water...
e: "Sale" directly relates to the commercialisation theme of the passage, referring to bottled water being marketed and sold for profit.

t: ...bottled water indicates ______ for nature
e: Contempt (तिरस्कार) conveys disregard or disdain, matching the critical tone about humans disrespecting nature's complexity.

t: Bottled water demonstrates how much humans ______ nature...
e: Commodify (वस्तु बनाना) means to turn into a sellable product, matching the theme of nature being commercialised through bottled water.

t: Weathering occurs as a result of different chemical and physical ______ that occur on the earth
e: Interactions (अंतःक्रिया) best describes the complex chemical and physical processes between rock particles forming soil.

t: The coronavirus pandemic has brought most of the US to ______ standstill.
e: "A" is used before non-specific singular countable nouns like "standstill," making it grammatically correct here.

t: The ______ of his bed was suddenly cool.
e: Dampness (नमी/सीलन) describes moisture from rain seeping into the wall, causing the bed area to feel cool.

t: Then he heard them drip and ______ against the wall under the windows.
e: "Puddle" (छोटा जल-संचय) means to form a small pool of liquid, matching the description of raindrops collecting against the wall.

t: ...may face pressure from peers, parents and society to ______ to certain expectations.
e: Conform (अनुरूप होना) means to comply with rules or expectations, fitting the social pressure described in the passage.

t: Communication can also help us to make positive changes in our communities and ______ for important causes.
e: Advocate (समर्थन करना) means to publicly support a cause, which fits naturally with "for important causes."

t: (Climatic disasters passage) By taking a _________ approach to disaster management, we can reduce the impacts of climatic disasters and build more resilient communities.
e: Proactive (पहले से सक्रिय) means taking action before a situation becomes a problem — a forward-thinking, preventive behaviour, perfect for disaster management context.

t: (Climatic disasters passage) To mitigate the effects of these disasters, it is essential to invest in disaster preparedness and _________.
e: Response (प्रतिक्रिया/राहत कार्य) refers to a reaction or reply to a situation — here it means disaster response measures alongside preparedness.

t: (Mona Lisa passage) The Mona Lisa's fame is the result of many chance circumstances combined with the painting's _________ appeal.
e: Inherent (अंतर्निहित) means something that is a permanent, essential, or characteristic attribute — the painting's appeal comes from within its own nature.

t: (Social media passage — Stenographer) The true source of _________ is our confrontational style, not the problem itself.
e: Contestation (विवाद/मतभेद) refers to an action or process of agreeing or disagreeing on something — perfect for describing the source of conflict.

t: (Sportsmanship passage) Sportsmanship can be thought of as a sustaining and reasonably stable attribute or possession that _________ individuals on the basis of how they are expected to behave in sporting circumstances.
e: Identifies (पहचानता है) means to recognize or tell who or about what a person is — synonymous with recognizing individuals on the basis of expected behavior.

t: (NEP passage) The National Educational Policy discusses the _________ and scope of vocational training.
e: Outline (रूपरेखा) means to give importance to or present key facts and information about something — suits discussing the scope and nature of vocational training.

t: (Amazon passage — CPO) It is _________ the size of the continent of Australia.
e: Roughly (लगभग) means approximately — the passage says the Amazon Rainforest is approximately the size of Australia.

t: (Moon passage — CHSL) As it does so, we see different amounts of its side _________ by the Sun.
e: Lit (प्रकाशित) means provided with light or lighting; illuminated — the Sun provides light to one side of the Moon.

t: (Naini Lake passage — CGL Tier II) Uncertainty looms over the revival of Naini Lake due to differences in the opinions of residents and local bodies regarding its desilting and _________.
e: Beautification (सुंदरीकरण) refers to the process of making something more beautiful or attractive — provides a clear counterpart to "desilting."

t: Vivek has a strong resemblance _________ his grandfather.
e: The preposition "to" is used with "resemblance" for identifying a particular relationship between one person and another. "Resemblance to" is the correct prepositional phrase.

t: In the absence of the Principal, the Vice-Principal _________ for him.
e: Officiates (कार्यभार संभालना) means to act as an official in charge of something — the Vice-Principal acts in the official capacity of the Principal.

t: (Knowledge landscape passage — CPO) There will be a sizeable shift in how we _________ the world's energy, water, food, and sanitation needs.
e: Meet (पूरा करना) means to fulfill or satisfy a need, requirement, or condition — "meeting the world's energy, water, food needs."

t: Our forefathers loved trees and forests so much that they _________ deified and worshipped them as abodes of Vrikshadevata and Vanadevata.
e: Even (यहाँ तक कि) is used to emphasize something surprising — it emphasizes the surprising fact that people actually deified trees.

t: The roads at 15000 feet are not easily navigable and the air is __________ and freezing.
e: Intensified means made stronger in force or degree; it does not collocate naturally with 'air'. Elevated means situated at a higher position - one might say 'elevated ground' but it does not describe the quality of air. Exalted means raised to a higher rank or moral position; not used to describe air scientifically. Rarefied means air that is at lower pressure than usual - thin, with reduced oxygen - the scientifically correct and contextually perfect word for air at high altitude. Grammar Rule: When a blank requires a specific, technical, or domain-specific word, eliminate options that are too vague, general, or used in different contexts.

t: English is more ______ than any single Indian language!
e: The blank requires a verb meaning 'to spread through and be present in every part of.' Pervade means to spread through and be perceived in every part of - correct: English has pervaded the entire world. Persuade means to convince someone - doesn't fit since you persuade a person, not the entire world. Invade means to enter forcefully as an enemy - too aggressive for this context. Saturate means to soak thoroughly - can be used metaphorically, but pervade is more precise and natural here. Vocabulary Tip: Pervade, permeate, and penetrate are related words meaning 'to spread through' - learn them as a cluster.

t: 'She can draw very well and just as ____.'
e: This tests parallelism, a frequently tested SSC grammar rule. 'She can draw very well' uses 'well' as an adverb modifying the verb 'draw'; 'just as ____' must also be an adverb to maintain parallel structure. 'Creative' is an adjective and would incorrectly modify the verb - the correct adverb is 'creatively'. The correlative conjunction 'as...as' requires the same form on both sides; 'very well' and 'as creatively' are parallel. Grammar Rule - Parallelism: In a sentence using correlative conjunctions (both...and, as...as, not only...but also), the grammatical form on both sides must match. Correct Sentence: She can draw very well and just as creatively.

t: 'I am sorry to ____ on you at this late hour.'
e: The context involves someone entering a space/calling on someone at an inconvenient hour, apologising for it. Interrupt means to stop something momentarily - used with events/speeches, not personal time. Instruct means to give formal directions - out of context. Interfere means to involve oneself unhelpfully - does not collocate with 'on'. Intrude on (phrasal verb) means to go into a place/situation where one is not expected - fits the meaning and collocates with 'on'. Key Rule: Always check for preposition collocations; 'intrude on' is a fixed phrase. Correct Sentence: I am sorry to intrude on you at this late hour.

t: They seemed very anxious … her comfort and gave the girl ______ instructions as to where to keep … things, when not to lean out and how to … speaking to strangers.
e: The context describes anxious parents giving instructions before a train journey; anxious parents naturally give thorough, complete instructions, not brief ones. Concise means brief and to the point - contradicts the anxious nature of the parents. Elaborate is close but implies complexity for its own sake. Detailed means containing a lot of information and attention to particular facts - the most natural and fitting word. Unspecified means not clearly identified - the opposite of what anxious parents would give. Context Clue: The phrase 'very anxious' earlier in the passage is the clue - anxious parents give detailed, not concise, instructions.

t: Consistency can never be attained in a sporadic or ______ manner.
e: The blank requires a verb connecting 'being constant' with the activity of 'repeating a task' - the intended meaning is that consistency involves/means repeating a task. Involves means to include or contain as a necessary part - grammatically clean and contextually perfect. Envelops means to surround/cover completely - wrong context. Initiates means to begin something - doesn't convey the ongoing nature of consistency. Key Verb: 'Involves' is a high-frequency word especially when defining or describing what something entails.

t: Select the most appropriate option for the underlined segment in the given sentence: 'Most hotels/ offer for their guests/ complimentary breakfast/ during their stay there.'
e: The verb 'offer' is a transitive verb - it takes a direct object without requiring a preposition. Incorrect: 'offer for their guests' - the preposition 'for' is unnecessary and ungrammatical. Correct: 'offer their guests' - 'guests' is the indirect object, 'complimentary breakfast' is the direct object. Grammar Rule - Transitive vs Intransitive Verbs: Transitive verbs take a direct object without a preposition (offer, give, send, bring, show) - e.g. She offered him tea (correct), not 'She offered for him tea.' Intransitive verbs cannot take a direct object (laugh, arrive, sleep, go). Correct Sentence: Most hotels offer their guests complimentary breakfast during their stay there.

t: Courts are ______ of the Constitution as they are expected to see that it is always respected.
e: The sentence describes courts as entities that watch over and protect the Constitution. 'Sentinels' means people or groups that watch over someone or something, guards, watchers - fits perfectly. 'Masters' implies authority/control over the Constitution, not protection of it. 'Dictators' means people who rule with absolute power - negative connotation, doesn't fit. 'Leaders' means people in charge - too generic, doesn't convey the protective/guardianship role. Vocabulary: Sentinel comes from the Italian sentinella (guard); it connotes vigilance and protection - perfect for describing the judiciary's role. Correct Sentence: Courts are sentinels of the Constitution as they are expected to see that it is always respected.

t: ______ on the banks of the majestic Sardar Sarovar Dam in Gujarat's Kevadia
e: "Situated" (स्थित) — किसी स्थान पर permanently located होने का अर्थ देता है। Statue की position describe करने के लिए यह सबसे सटीक है। "Appeared" (दिखाई दिया) — coming into view suggest करता है। "Found" (पाया गया) — discovering something hidden को indicate करता है। "Established" (स्थापित किया) — abstract है, physical location के लिए उपयुक्त नहीं।

t: ...has ______ a remarkable surge in its annual footfall.
e: "Has witnessed" — Present Perfect Tense की structure है: has/have + V3। यह surge already happen हो चुका है इसलिए past participle "witnessed" सही है। "Witnessing" (present continuous), "Witness" (present), और "Witnesses" (present) — सभी tense के अनुसार गलत हैं।

t: ...this colossal monument has welcomed nearly 16 crore ______.
e: "Visitors" (पर्यटक/दर्शक) — tourists या sightseers को describe करने का सबसे सटीक शब्द है। "Guests" (मेहमान) — social occasions के लिए। "Invitees" (आमंत्रित लोग) — invited events के लिए। "Callers" (कॉल करने वाले) — short visit या phone call के लिए।

t: By ______ a good kill on a particular day, the larger raptor can go without hunting two or three weeks.
e: "Making a killing" (बड़ा शिकार करना) — यह idiom है जिसका अर्थ है to earn a lot of resources in a short time। Context में raptor के शिकार की बात हो रही है। "Taking," "Doing," और "Getting" इस idiom में fit नहीं होते।

t: ...British people can collect in crowds ______ do not turn into mobs.
e: "Which" — relative pronoun जो animals और things को refer करता है। यहाँ "crowds" (noun) को refer किया जा रहा है, people को नहीं। "Who" और "Whom" persons के लिए हैं। "That" भी हो सकता था लेकिन crowds जैसी collective noun के लिए "which" अधिक appropriate है।

t: ...and when the procession finally ______ they cheered whole-heartedly.
e: "Appeared" (प्रकट हुई) — procession का दिखाई देना। "Entered" (प्रवेश किया) — किसी बंद स्थान में प्रवेश के लिए। "Vanished" (गायब हुई) — opposite meaning। "Joined" (शामिल हुई) — procession crowd का हिस्सा नहीं बनती।

t: ...canyons are not as long, but they are ______.
e: "Impressive" (प्रभावशाली) — इन canyons की size और nature को describe करता है। Context में author already mentioned canyons से तुलना कर रहा है। "Exciting" (रोमांचक), "Inspiring" (प्रेरणादायक), और "Intense" (तीव्र) इस descriptive context में कम सटीक हैं।

t: ...can lead to build-up of a ______ toxic chemical called glutamate.
e: "Potentially" (संभावित रूप से) — toxicity की possibility को indicate करता है, certainty को नहीं। Context में glutamate की nature describe हो रही है। "Utterly" (पूर्णतः), "Perpetually" (लगातार), और "Grandly" (शानदार तरीके से) इस context में अनुचित हैं।

t: A recent study that ______ people's brains at different points in their work day...
e: "Scanned" (स्कैन किया) — brain imaging techniques (MRI/CT) के ज़रिए brain को observe करना। "Illuminated" (रोशन किया), "Answered" (उत्तर दिया), और "Buzzed" (भनभनाया) — सभी brain study के context में गलत हैं।

t: One clear ______ from this year's meeting was that climate change...
e: "Takeaway" (मुख्य निष्कर्ष) — meeting से निकाला गया main point या key message। "Standard" (मानक), "Thesis" (शोध-प्रबंध), और "Diffidence" (संकोच) इस context में fit नहीं होते।

t: ______ most individuals in countries where vaccination is widespread have never personally experienced the vaccine-preventable disease.
e: "For instance" (उदाहरण के लिए) — एक example introduce करता है जो previous statement को support करता है। "Therefore" (इसलिए — cause-effect), "In addition" (इसके अलावा), और "Likewise" (इसी तरह) इस context में fit नहीं होते।

t: 'But, mum, I'm almost done,' Gabriella ______.
e: "Protested" (विरोध किया/आपत्ति जताई) — Gabriella ने माँ की बात पर objection किया। "Prevented" (रोका), "Prohibited" (प्रतिबंधित किया), और "Prescribed" (निर्धारित किया) — context में गलत हैं।

t: ...she began to ______ around the house impatiently.
e: "Prowl" (इधर-उधर घूमना) — बिल्ली का restlessly और stealthily घूमना। यह cats के natural behavior को describe करता है। "March" (कदम ताल), "Trot" (तेज़ चलना), और "Sleep" (सोना) इस context में गलत हैं।

t: This was a source of great ______ to the boys.
e: "Irritation" (झुंझलाहट) — boys market नहीं जा सकते थे, इससे वे annoyed थे। "Ebullience" (उत्साह), "Hatred" (घृणा), और "Abhorrence" (विद्वेष) इस mild feeling के लिए too strong हैं।

t: The next Faerie Market was held ______ schedule on the other side of the wall.
e: "On schedule" (निर्धारित समय पर) — यह fixed phrase है। "On time" या "on schedule" — दोनों में "on" प्रयुक्त होता है। "At," "Upon," और "In" इस phrase में नहीं आते।

t: ...gives meaning to the concept of quantification and ______ value for us humans.
e: "Unequivocal" (निर्विवाद/स्पष्ट) — leaving no doubt, giving clear and definite value। Mathematics unambiguous value provide करती है। "Unapparent" (अदृश्य), "Incomprehensible" (अबोधगम्य), और "Undecipherable" (अपठनीय) negative meaning रखते हैं।

t: Similarly, mathematics, the ______ of science, gives meaning...
e: "Bedrock" (आधारशिला) — fundamental principles on which something is based। Mathematics science की foundation है। "Glory" (गौरव), "Secret" (रहस्य), और "Crest" (शिखर/कलगी) इस context में fit नहीं होते।

t: ...isn't it ______ that science appears to be beyond the common mind's comprehension?
e: "Ironic" (विडम्बनापूर्ण) — Science जिस पर हमारी पूरी ज़िन्दगी टिकी है, वही आम लोगों को समझ नहीं आती — यह irony है। "Logical" (तार्किक), "Obvious" (स्पष्ट), और "Gracious" (शिष्ट) context में गलत हैं।

t: ...in response to ______ consumer backlash against the huge amounts of plastic waste...
e: "Growing" (बढ़ती हुई) — consumer backlash बढ़ रहा है। "Believing" (विश्वास करना), "Enlarging" (बड़ा करना), और "Developing" (विकसित करना) इस context में गलत हैं।

t: Grandmere started ______ me from the phone.
e: "Beckoning" (इशारे से बुलाना) — Grandmere phone से hand gesture से बुला रही थी। "Upsetting" (परेशान करना), "Dismissing" (नज़रअंदाज़ करना), और "Disconcerting" (अस्थिर करना) इस physical action को describe नहीं करते।

t: While I was sitting there ______ over my failure...
e: "Sulking" (मुँह फुलाना/खिन्न होना) — failure के कारण silent और bad-tempered रहना। "Grinning" (मुस्कुराना), "Clapping" (ताली बजाना), और "Smirking" (व्यंग्य से मुस्कुराना) positive या inappropriate emotions हैं।

t: People did not seem to ______ or cough...
e: "Fidget" (बेचैनी से हिलना-डुलना) — nervousness या impatience के कारण छोटी-छोटी हरकतें करना। Reading session में लोग fidget या cough नहीं कर रहे थे। "Sleep" (सोना), "Sing" (गाना), और "Distract" (ध्यान भटकाना) context में गलत हैं।

t: He was never in the best of tempers ______ anyway.
e: "Anyway" (वैसे भी/चाहे जो हो) — यह indicate करता है कि Anders का temper हमेशा ही खराब था, circumstances चाहे जो हों। "Somewhat" (कुछ हद तक), "Always" (हमेशा), और "Whenever" (जब भी) इस nuance को capture नहीं करते।

t: Anders — a book critic known for the weary, elegant savagery with which he ______ almost everything he reviewed.
e: "Dispatched" (निपटाया) — to deal with or review promptly and efficiently। Anders ने reviews को swiftly और efficiently handle किया। "Transferred" (स्थानांतरित), "Incorporated" (शामिल किया), और "Conditioned" (अनुकूलित किया) — context में गलत हैं।

t: ...water is life, that it is a precious natural resource and needs to be used ______.
e: "Judiciously" (विवेकपूर्ण तरीके से) — wisely and carefully use करना। Water conservation context में यह सबसे appropriate है। "Effectively" (प्रभावी ढंग से), "Hopefully" (आशा के साथ), और "Carelessly" (लापरवाही से — opposite meaning) गलत हैं।

t: Health and fitness are ______ linked...
e: "Inextricably" (अटूट रूप से) — inseparably linked। Health और fitness को अलग नहीं किया जा सकता। "Diametrically" (पूर्णतः विपरीत रूप से), "Explicitly" (स्पष्ट रूप से), और "Solely" (केवल) इस context में गलत हैं।

t: ...a book that leaves us to ______ what is unsaid.
e: "Interpret" (व्याख्या करना) — unsaid/unstated चीज़ों को समझना और उनकी व्याख्या करना। Literary works में readers को meaning खुद निकालनी होती है। "Deny" (नकारना), "Accept" (स्वीकार करना), और "What is" — context में गलत हैं।

t: ...but circumstances forced him to ______ profession.
e: Context में John को financially मजबूर होकर renowned artists के काम को duplicate करने में specialize करना पड़ा। Complete: "circumstances forced him to specialize in duplicating the work of renowned artists."

t: ...the papers she had ______ on the desk.
e: "Stacked" (ढेर लगाना/व्यवस्थित करना) — papers को orderly pile में arrange करना। "Slacked" (ढीला करना), "Mounded" (ढेर बनाना — informal), और "Tacked" (थोड़ा जोड़ना) इस context में कम appropriate हैं।

t: ...killing indiscriminately ______ cities and towns devastated in its wake.
e: "Leaving" (पीछे छोड़ना) — plague ने devastated cities और towns पीछे छोड़े। "Settling" (बसाना), "Reckoning" (हिसाब करना), और "Keeping" (रखना) इस context में गलत हैं।

t: Modern ______ practices and medicine have greatly subdued the impact...
e: "Sanitary" (स्वच्छता संबंधी) — hygiene और health conditions से related practices। Modern sanitation ने plague के impact को कम किया। "Unhygienic" (अस्वच्छ — opposite), "Ongoing" (जारी), और "Modern" (आधुनिक — redundant यहाँ) गलत हैं।

t: recommending motivational ______ they might undertake that are ______ to Larry's situation and the program's ______ about his attitudes and behaviours.
e: "Interventions" (हस्तक्षेप/उपाय) — motivational steps। "Targeted" (लक्षित) — Larry की specific situation के लिए। "Inferences" (निष्कर्ष) — program के attitudes और behaviors के बारे में conclusions। तीनों मिलकर एक coherent educational context बनाते हैं।

t: He was enjoying himself sitting alone ______ the fireside.
e: "By the fireside" (आग के पास) — fireplace के बगल में बैठना। "By" यहाँ location को indicate करता है। "In" (अंदर), "Over" (ऊपर), और "Near" (पास) — सभी grammatically possible हों लेकिन "by the fireside" एक fixed expression है।

t: The firelight danced on the walls and ______ strange shadows around the room.
e: "Cast shadows" (परछाइयाँ डालना) — यह fixed phrase है। "Firelight cast strange shadows" — standard literary expression। "Made," "Threw," और "Created" — सभी possible हैं पर "cast shadows" idiomatic है।

t: There is a road from Wall, a winding track rising sharply up from the forest, where it is ______ with rocks and small stones.
e: "Lined with rocks" (पत्थरों से भरी/सजी) — road के किनारे rocks और stones हैं। "Lined" यह visual description देता है। "Sequenced" (क्रमबद्ध), "Queued" (कतार में), और "Furnished" (सुसज्जित) इस context में गलत हैं।

t: The town of Wall stands today as it has ______ for six hundred years, on a high ______ of granite slab
e: "Jut" (बाहर निकला होना) — granite slab का forest से ऊपर उठना। "A high jut of granite slab" — यह physical description है। "Trench" (खाई), "Furrow" (नाली), और "Line" (रेखा) इस geographical feature को describe नहीं करते।

t: ...there was much about this young man and what happened to him that was unusual, ______ even he never knew the whole of it.
e: "Although" (यद्यपि) — surprise या contrast introduce करता है। "Although even he never knew the whole" — despite the unusual events, he didn't know everything। "Even though" similar है लेकिन "although" more literary है। "In spite" और "Despite" के बाद noun phrase आती है, not clause।

t: Drown the whole thing in an abnormal, ______ atmosphere...
e: "Dreamy" (स्वप्निल) — lyrical, magical farce के context में dreamy atmosphere appropriate है। "Littered" (कूड़े से भरा), "Hygienic" (स्वच्छ), और "Plentiful" (प्रचुर) इस literary/atmospheric context में गलत हैं।

t: ...your point of view undergoes a ______.
e: "Transformation" (परिवर्तन) — point of view में thorough or dramatic change। Studying से perspective में fundamental change आता है। "Backwardness" (पिछड़ापन), "Enlargement" (विस्तार), और "Succession" (क्रम) इस context में गलत हैं।

t: Water, a substance composed of the chemical elements hydrogen and oxygen ______ in gaseous, liquid, and solid states.
e: "Exists" (विद्यमान है) — Water gaseous, liquid, और solid तीनों states में पाया जाता है। "Exists in" — यह scientific fact को correctly state करता है। "Appears" (दिखता है), "Remains" (बना रहता है), और "Stays" (ठहरता है) less precise हैं।

t: The Young Global Leaders Community is an ______ for a dynamic community...
e: "Accelerator" (त्वरक) — community को drive करने वाला force। "Accelerator for a dynamic community" — यह community के growth को speed करता है। "Impediment" (बाधा — opposite), "Input" (इनपुट), और "Effort" (प्रयास) इस context में गलत हैं।

t: A ______ souvenir will be released on the occasion of the World Meet.
e: "Voluminous" (विशाल/बड़ा) — having great volume or bulk। Context में World Meet जैसे बड़े occasion के लिए large souvenir release होगा। "Generous" (उदार), "Bountiful" (प्रचुर), और "Small" (छोटा) इस context में गलत हैं।

t: He gazed around the room ______ lay hidden a treasure chest.
e: "Wherein" (जिसमें) — referring to a place in which something exists। "The room wherein lay hidden a treasure chest" — formal/literary usage। "Whereof" (जिसका), "Whereas" (जबकि), और "Whereby" (जिसके द्वारा) — अलग-अलग meanings हैं।

t: The workers ______ against the new labour laws.
e: "Remonstrated against" (विरोध करना/शिकायत करना) — to protest against something। "Remonstrate against" एक fixed phrase है। "Opposed" (विरोध किया), "Implicated" (फँसाया), और "Dissented" (असहमत हुए) — "remonstrate against" जितने specific नहीं हैं।

t: Sir, can you reflect on the usefulness or ______ of blocking all the highways?
e: "Futility" (व्यर्थता/निरर्थकता) — pointlessness of an action। "Usefulness or futility" — दोनों contrasting words हैं। "Scorch" (जलाना), "Incompatibility" (असंगति), और "Impotence" (शक्तिहीनता) इस context में गलत हैं।

t: Ram placed her in one of the ______ leather chairs opposite his desk.
e: "Quilted leather chairs" (रजाई जैसी बनावट वाली चमड़े की कुर्सियाँ) — two layers of fabric with padding, stitched in patterns। Furniture को describe करने का appropriate term। "Marinated" (मैरीनेट किया हुआ), "Brewed" (पीसा हुआ), और "Stewed" (उबाला हुआ) — food preparation terms हैं।

t: She knew that to apologize would be ______ to admitting she had failed.
e: "Tantamount" (के बराबर) — having the same effect as something। "Tantamount to admitting failure" — apologizing = failure admit करना। "Tandem" (जोड़ी में), "Tangible" (ठोस/मूर्त), और "Tantalizing" (ललचाने वाला) गलत हैं।

t: It is said that civilized man has ______ about twenty wild animals.
e: "Tamed" (पालतू बनाया) — to bring wild animals under control। "Civilized man has tamed twenty wild animals" — domestication। "Stunned" (चौंका दिया), "Amazed" (हैरान किया), और "Staggered" (डगमगाया) इस context में गलत हैं।

t: Gifting is generally taken to be the easiest act to ______, if only you have the heart to part with something in your ______.
e: "Perform" (करना) — an act को perform करना। "Possession" (स्वामित्व/अधिकार) — जो चीज़ आपकी है उसे देना। "To perform an act...in your possession" — logically coherent। बाकी options context में गलत हैं।

t: We have already said that inconsistency is not a matter of ______ education or lack of logical ______.
e: "Inadequate" (अपर्याप्त) — insufficient education। "Rigour" (कठोरता/सटीकता) — logical rigour की कमी। "Inconsistency is not a matter of inadequate education or lack of logical rigour" — logically coherent। बाकी options context में गलत हैं।

t: A major ______ of modern times is that we have come to assume that all creation is ______ to the material interests of us
e: "Fallacy" (भ्रांति/गलत धारणा) — untrue notion। "Subservient" (अधीन) — acting as subordinate। "Symbiotic" (सहजीवी) — mutual dependence। तीनों मिलकर: "A major fallacy...creation is subservient to material interests...cut the symbiotic relationship" — logical।

t: Select the word that is ANTONYM of TIMOROUS: "Timorous"
e: "Timorous" (डरपोक/साहसहीन) — showing lack of confidence, fearful। इसका antonym है "Brazen" (निडर/बेशर्म) — bold, shameless, unapologetic। "Gutless" (कायर), "Scared" (डरा हुआ), और "Reserved" (संयमित) — सभी similar या related हैं।

t: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the highlighted word: "The government's utilitarian stance was appreciated by all."
e: "Utilitarian" (व्यावहारिक) — designed to be useful or practical। Synonym है "Functional" (प्रायोगिक/व्यावहारिक)। "Fanciful" (काल्पनिक), "Distasteful" (अरुचिकर), और "Necessary" (आवश्यक) अलग meaning रखते हैं।

t: Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order: P. some 81 percent of the reefs in the area had become severely bleached Q. warm seawater were particularly brutal in the northern part of R. Australia's famous Great Barrier Reef, where surveys reported that S. from late 2015 to the middle of 2016, the effects of overly
e: S (time frame: late 2015 to 2016) → Q (effects of warm seawater in northern part of) → R (Australia's Great Barrier Reef, where surveys reported) → P (81% reefs severely bleached). Logical flow: time → location → specific place → result. Correct order: SQRP

t: Choose the correctly spelt word:
e: "DODGE" (बचना/टालना) — correctly spelled। "BRILIANT" → correct: BRILLIANT (दो 'l')। "SIEZE" → correct: SEIZE (ei नहीं, ei के बाद c आती है)। "RECEPROCATE" → correct: RECIPROCATE। इसलिए DODGE सही है।

t: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word: "We should desecrate our national flag."
e: "Desecrate" (अपवित्र करना) — to treat something sacred with violent disrespect। इसका antonym है "Sanctify" (पवित्र करना) — to make something holy or sacred। "Damage" (नुकसान पहुँचाना), "Violate" (उल्लंघन करना), और "Integrate" (एकीकृत करना) antonym नहीं हैं।

t: Parts of the given sentence. Identify which contains the error: "You must avoid riding in a crowded bus or travelling in a metro during rush hour as both are quiet unpleasant experiences."
o: as both are quiet unpleasant experiences
you must avoid riding in a crowded bus
e: "Quiet" (शांत — adjective) गलत है। यहाँ adjective "unpleasant" को modify करने के लिए adverb "quite" (काफी/बिल्कुल) होना चाहिए। Correct: "as both are quite unpleasant experiences."

t: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word:
e: "Voilence" गलत spelling है। Correct spelling है "Violence" (हिंसा)। "Wildernesses" (जंगल), "Exterminated" (नष्ट किया), और "Unmanageable" (अनियंत्रणीय) — सभी correctly spelt हैं।

t: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word: OBJURGATION
e: "Objurgation" (कड़ी फटकार/कठोर आलोचना) — harsh rebuke or criticism। इसका antonym है "Endorsement" (समर्थन/अनुमोदन) — approval or support। "Hamper" (बाधा डालना), "Reproof" (हल्की फटकार), और "Commination" (दंड की धमकी) — different meanings।

t: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word: ADEQUATE
e: "Adequate" (पर्याप्त) — sufficient or satisfactory। इसका antonym है "Wanting" (अपर्याप्त/अभावग्रस्त) — lacking or deficient। "Taunting" (ताना मारना), "Indolent" (आलसी), और "Superficial" (सतही) असंबंधित हैं।

t: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word 'VAULT':
e: "Vault" (तिजोरी/भूमिगत कमरा) — a secure room for valuables, or an underground chamber। इसका synonym है "Crypt" (भूमिगत कक्ष) — an underground room or vault beneath a church। "Raisins" (किशमिश), "Ration" (राशन), और "Monarch" (सम्राट) असंबंधित हैं।

t: Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word. "Sarika's husband had been undergoing vicissitudes in his fortune since 2002."
e: "Vicissitudes" (उतार-चढ़ाव) refers to unwelcome changes and fluctuations in life. "Tribulations" (कष्ट) means great troubles or suffering — the closest in meaning. "Hibernation" (शीतनिद्रा) means a state of inactivity in winter; "Consolations" (सांत्वना) means comfort after a loss.

t: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Procrastination
e: "Procrastination" (टालमटोल) means delaying or postponing something. "Suspension" (स्थगन) refers to the temporary prevention of something from continuing — closely related in meaning to delaying. "Resumption" (पुनः आरम्भ) means restarting.

t: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Prerogative
e: "Prerogative" (विशेषाधिकार) means a right or privilege exclusive to a particular individual or class. "Privilege" (विशेषाधिकार) is a direct synonym. "Bias" (पूर्वाग्रह) means prejudice; "Predisposition" (पूर्वनिर्धारण) means a tendency.

t: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Wanton
e: "Wanton" (निर्दयी / अश्लील) means deliberate and unprovoked; often refers to excessive cruelty or indecency. "Obscene" (अश्लील) means offensive by accepted standards of morality — closely synonymous here. "Abrogation" (उन्मूलन) means repeal.

t: Select the most appropriate synonym for the given word. Recumbent
e: "Recumbent" (लेटा हुआ) means lying down in a position of comfort or rest. "Prostrate" (औंधे मुंह पड़ा हुआ) means lying flat on the ground, often face down — the closest synonym.

t: "Everything in the village was grown organically as the majority of the population indulged in farming for ___."
e: "Sustenance" (जीविका) means the maintaining of someone in life or existence — i.e., earning a living. "Nourishment" means food for health.

t: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Ignoramus
e: "Ignoramus" (मूर्ख) means a person who is ignorant or lacks knowledge. "Stupid" (मूर्ख) means showing a lack of intelligence — making it the closest synonym. "Deceitful" (धोखेबाज) means dishonest.

t: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
e: The correct spelling is "Burglar" (सेंधमार) — a person who enters a building illegally to steal. "Bourgeoisie" (बुर्जुआ वर्ग) and "Burlesque" (नाटकीय व्यंग्य) are correctly spelled.

t: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Inquisitive
e: "Inquisitive" (जिज्ञासु) means having a strong desire to learn or know things. The antonym is "Uninterested" (उदासीन) — having no interest. "Indolent" (आलसी) means lazy.

t: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM to replace the italicised word. "I am astonished to see her mercurial demeanour in making any task a success."
e: "Mercurial" (अस्थिर) means subject to sudden, unpredictable changes of mood. Its antonym is "Invariable" (अपरिवर्तनीय) — meaning unchanging and constant. The other options are synonyms.

t: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word. "Amrit felt a chill run down his spine as Mrityu gazed at him mid-conversation."
e: "Gazed" (टकटकी से देखा) means to look steadily and intently for a long time. The antonym is "Glanced" (एक नज़र डाला) — meaning to take a brief or hurried look.

t: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word. "She looked tired and sallow after the long day she'd had."
e: "Sallow" (पीला / निस्तेज) means having a yellow or pale complexion, indicating illness. The antonym is "Flushed" (गुलाबी) — indicating good health or excitement. "Livid" (नीला / क्रोधित) means very angry or dark bluish.

t: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Languishing
e: "Languishing" (कमजोर पड़ना) means to become weak or feeble. Its antonym is "Flourishing" (फलता-फूलता) — meaning growing or developing in a healthy way. "Diminutive" (लघु) means extremely small.

t: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Latent
e: "Latent" (गुप्त / अव्यक्त) means existing but not yet developed or manifest; hidden. Its antonym is "Manifest" (स्पष्ट) — meaning clear or obvious.

t: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Deplore
e: "Deplore" (निंदा करना) means to feel or express strong disapproval. Its antonym is "Relish" (आनंद लेना) — meaning to enjoy something greatly.

t: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Exaggerate
e: "Exaggerate" (अतिशयोक्ति करना) means to describe something as larger or greater than it is. Its antonym is "Understate" (कम करके कहना). "Embellish" (सजाना) means to add decorative details.

t: Identify the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Fathomable
e: "Fathomable" (समझने योग्य) means something that can be understood. Its antonym is "Incoherent" (असंगत) — meaning unclear and difficult to understand. "Inauspicious" (अशुभ) means not promising.

t: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the sentence. "Do not linger in the corridor."
e: "Linger" (रुकना) means to stay in a place longer than necessary. The antonym is "Hasten" (जल्दी करना) — meaning to move or act swiftly.

t: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the bracketed word to fill in the blank. "My friend is not stubborn with regard to opinions; in fact, she is ___ (intransigent)."
e: "Intransigent" (अड़ियल) means refusing to change one's views. Its antonym is "Subservient" (आज्ञाकारी) — meaning prepared to obey others submissively. The other options mean stubborn.

t: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word "Decipher" from the sentence: "Many sculptures of our history are like the unravelled path as we cannot garble and there is a lot of work that is yet to be interpreted or translated."
e: "Decipher" (अर्थ समझना) means to make out the meaning of something obscure. The antonym is "Garble" (उलझाना) — to confuse or mix up something so its original meaning is hidden.

t: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in the bracket to fill in the blank: "The development of the region depended on the ___ (rapaciousness) of the corporate contribution."
e: "Rapaciousness" (लालच) means aggressively greedy. Its antonym is "Generosity" (उदारता) — the quality of being kind and giving. "Voracity" is a synonym.

t: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Stability
e: "Stability" (स्थिरता) means the state of being stable. Its antonym is "Volatility" (अस्थिरता) — meaning the tendency to change rapidly and unpredictably. "Ambiguity" (अस्पष्टता) means inexactness.

t: Identify the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word. "Dipesh loves to answer his boss's questions in tactful ways."
e: "Tactful" (व्यवहार-कुशल) means having skill and sensitivity in dealing with others. Its antonym is "Undiplomatic" (कूटनीतिहीन) — meaning lacking tact or being blunt.

t: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom. Made his mark
e: "Made his mark" means to achieve something notable. "To distinguish himself" (खुद को अलग करना / पहचान बनाना) captures this meaning perfectly.

t: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom. To have sticky fingers
o: To have a tendency to steal
e: "To have sticky fingers" (चोरी करने की आदत होना) idiomatically means to have a habit of stealing — as if things stick to one's fingers.

t: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom. Loose cannon
o: Someone who is enthusiastic and eager
Someone who is unpredictable and liable to cause problems
e: "Loose cannon" (अनियंत्रित व्यक्ति) describes someone unpredictable who is likely to cause unintended problems or damage.

t: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom. A bird's eye view
o: A clear impression of what is happening
To move into sight from a distance
e: "A bird's eye view" (व्यापक दृष्टिकोण) means a broad, comprehensive perspective of a situation. "A clear impression of what is happening" matches this.

t: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom. Your guess is as good as mine
o: To have no idea of the answer
e: "Your guess is as good as mine" (उत्तर का कोई अंदाज़ा नहीं होना) means neither person knows the answer; both are equally uninformed.

t: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom. Through the grapevine
e: "Through the grapevine" (अफवाह के जरिये) refers to hearing information informally through word-of-mouth or rumors (Via gossip).

t: Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined segment. "Unless sales improve next month, the company will be in a critical position in which failure seems imminent."
e: "Up against the wall" (मुश्किल में होना) means being in a desperate situation with limited options. "A damp squib" (निराशाजनक परिणाम) means something that fails to meet expectations.

t: Select the most suitable idiom to fill in the blank. "Extreme inflation in the country has led to a hike in the price of day-to-day commodity. It has made it difficult to ___."
o: Costs an arm and a leg
e: "Keep body and soul together" (जीवित रहना) means to manage to stay alive with just enough of life's necessities, which fits the context of inflation.

t: Select the idiom that gives the most appropriate meaning of the underlined phrase. "'Honesty is the best policy' does not remain valid in the present times."
e: "Hold good" (वैध रहना) means to remain valid or applicable. So, "does not hold good" matches "does not remain valid".

t: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom. Hang on every word
e: "Hang on every word" (बहुत ध्यान से सुनना) means to listen with complete attention and fascination to what someone is saying.

t: The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. "Villagers / who approached the agriculture officer / are uneducated and poor. / No error"
e: The noun "Villagers" should be preceded by the definite article "The" because we refer to a specific group. Correct: "The villagers who approached..."

t: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. "Though the / global financial crisis, / China's economy continues / to grow at an impressive rate."
o: To grow at an impressive rate
e: "Though" must be followed by a complete clause (subject + verb). The correct preposition here is "Despite" (के बावजूद), which can directly precede a noun phrase.

t: The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them contains an error. "Mr. Unkerton glanced / to the inspector, / who merely snorted / and looked at the ceiling."
e: The verb "glanced" takes the preposition "at," not "to." The correct phrase is "glanced at the inspector."

t: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. "Since 1988, / the people of Rajasthan / have been searching / for 25-year-old man."
e: A singular countable noun requires an article. The correct phrase is "for a 25-year-old man."

t: The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. "(a) The more it rains, / (b) worse / (c) the roads become / (d) No error"
e: In comparative correlative constructions ("the more..."), the corresponding part must also include "the." It should be "the worse."

t: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. "The compensation that the / Government agreed to provide to / the dependents of the / train accident is fairly less."
e: People cannot be dependents of an "accident". The correct, logical phrase is "the dependents of the train accident victims."

t: Identify the segment that contains an error. "One of the great rivers / of China, a Hwang Ho, / originates from the / eastern face of Tibet."
e: "Hwang Ho" is a proper noun (name of a river). Proper nouns do not require an indefinite article ("a"). It should just be "Hwang Ho."

t: Identify the error in the following sentence. "Akash would be staying to his uncle's place during the holidays."
e: "Staying to" is incorrect usage. The correct preposition for a location is "at" (staying at his uncle's place).

t: The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them contains an error. "Let us, at any rate, / give him an outline out the case / and hear what he has to say."
o: Give him an outline out the case
And hear what he has to say
e: "Outline out" uses the wrong preposition. The standard collocation is "outline of" (an outline of the case).

t: "Their plan of acquisition was ___ flawed from the very beginning; it was bound to fail."
e: "Fatally" (घातक रूप से) means causing failure or disaster. "Fatally flawed" means so severely flawed that failure was inevitable.

t: Select the option that can replace the underlined phrase to make the sentence grammatically correct. "Doctor wants Tony to cut back down junk foods."
e: "Cut back on" (कम करना) is the correct phrasal verb meaning to reduce the amount of something.

t: Select the option that can replace the underlined phrase to make the sentence grammatically correct. "After flip through half dozen profiles with the same name, he chance upon Elina's profile, he succeed in zeroing in on her now recognizable face."
o: Flip through half dozen profile... he chance upon, he succeeded
Flipping through half dozen profile... he chance upon, he succeeded
Flipping through half dozen profiles... he chanced upon, he succeed
Flipping through half a dozen profiles... he chanced upon, he succeeded
e: Correct grammar requires: "flipping" (gerund), "half a dozen", "profiles" (plural), and past tense verbs "chanced" and "succeeded".

t: Select the grammatically correct sentence from the options given.
o: An troll, the boy shared on the social media created the big laughter.
The troll, the boy shared on social media created a big laughter.
A troll, a boy shared in on social media created an big laughter.
The troll, a boy shared on an social media created a big laughter.
e: Option B correctly uses specific articles ("The troll", "the boy"), no article for the mass noun "social media", and the correct article "a" for "big laughter".

t: Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts to form a meaningful sentence. (O) arid deserts (P) from lush forests to (Q) hikers encountered diverse ecosystems (R) trekking through the wilderness
e: (R) introduces the action → (Q) states what was encountered → (P) describes the start of the range → (O) completes the range.

t: Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges the parts in the correct sequence. (P) the paintings of Sayed Haider Raza blended (Q) considered as one of the (R) foremost pioneers of Indian modern art (S) Parisian modernism with the colours of Indian Rajput art
e: (P) and (S) form the complete main clause. (Q) and (R) form the descriptive tag attached at the end.

t: Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. The beginning of the sentence is "Zombies are not real". Arrange the remaining parts to form a meaningful sentence. (P) sound effects (Q) make it believable (R) but special (S) and visuals
e: (R) continues the base sentence → (P) is the subject of the new clause → (S) adds to the subject → (Q) is the predicate.

t: Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange them correctly. (P) are not (Q) The initial days of my high school (R) to remember (S) very good
e: (Q) introduces the subject → (P) is the verb → (S) completes the clause → (R) finishes the sentence.

t: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange them correctly. (a) Freedom of thought and expression are fundamental human rights. (b) There are two important human rights. (c) Through good deeds, one can gain dignity. (d) Everyone has the inherent right to be treated with dignity and courtesy at all times.
e: (d) introduces dignity → (c) expands on earning it → (b) transitions to human rights generally → (a) specifies those rights.

t: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences. (A) The Booker is awarded on 17 October... (B) 'If the rocks, caves, lakes... would sound like Alan Garner...' (C) This year Alan Garner became the oldest author ever to be shortlisted... (D) Treacle Walker, a dreamlike fable...
e: (C) introduces the achievement → (A) adds the birthday coincidence → (D) describes the book → (B) gives a concluding poetic thought.

t: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences. (P) Applied arts require an object to be functional, as well as beautiful. (Q) They recognised that their work belonged to the higher social classes... (R) Fine art is categorised as something which only has an aesthetic or conceptual function. (S) There are a number of different categories of objects and processes under the umbrella term of art. (T) In the twentieth century, artists began to challenge the established notion of art. (U) Art is typically divided into two areas: fine art and the applied arts.
o: H, P, S, T, U, Q
S, U, P, Q, R, T
S, U, R, P, T, Q
H, P, S, T, Q, U
e: (S) introduces art broadly → (U) divides it into two areas → (R) defines fine art → (P) defines applied art → (T) mentions artists challenging this → (Q) explains why they challenged it.

t: Proboscis helps ______ the juices of the flowers.
e: "To drink" (पीना) correctly describes the action of consuming liquid through the proboscis; gulp, eat, and gobble are less precise for sucking liquid.

t: and ______ a much broader spectrum than the societal institute of higher education that we frequently communicate ….
e: "Encompasses" (शामिल करता है) means to include or cover something broader, fitting the context of education covering a wide spectrum.

t: ...shock and grief ______ ordinary life.
e: "Shock and grief overcome ordinary life" makes the most sense among the options, meaning grief overwhelms (हावी हो जाना) daily functioning.

t: It's one of the advantages I get from ______ a bachelor and, according to my nearest and dearest, practically a half-witted bachelor … that.
e: "Being a bachelor" correctly uses the present participle of "to be" to describe a continuous state.

t: ...a half-witted bachelor ______ that.
e: "At that" idiomatically completes the sentence, akin to saying "a half-witted bachelor at that" (meaning "in addition" / "ऊपर से").

t: ...mastodons bellowing ______ primaeval swamps.
e: "Bellowing into primaeval swamps" suggests sound spreading throughout the environment, making "into" the best fit.

t: A new ______ was organized by Chhattisgarh Tourism Board in the form of National Tribal Dance Festival.
e: "Initiative" (पहल) best describes an organised activity launched by an authority to achieve a cultural goal.

t: We have ______ great spiritual values contrasted with materialistic progress of the West.
e: "Inherited" (विरासत में मिला) correctly conveys that these values were passed down through generations, linking back to "inheritors" mentioned earlier.

t: Our saints aspired to the ______ of the infinite.
e: "Realisation" (साक्षात्कार) fits the spiritual context of saints striving for enlightenment or understanding of the infinite.

t: We are inheritors of several grand ______ in the fields of music, fine arts, dance, drama etc.
e: "Treasures" (खजाने) best conveys valuable cultural inheritances in music, art and dance.

t: Kumar was ______ by the mayor with a bouquet.
e: "Felicitated" (सम्मानित किया) specifically denotes a ceremonious honouring presentation, matching the bouquet context better than the alternatives.

t: We were also appreciated by other ______ present at the event.
e: "Dignitaries" (गणमान्य व्यक्ति) refers to important officials, fitting the formal event attended by the Chief of Police and Mayor.

t: the sky transformed into a radiant canvas, painted with ______ of orange, pink, and gold.
e: "Hues" (रंग) means shades of colour, fitting the description of the sky's colours.

t: A gentle breeze whispered through the ______ trees, rustling their vibrant leaves.
e: "Lustrous" (चमकदार) describes shiny, vibrant trees, matching the imagery of "rustling their vibrant leaves."

t: Therefore, he became ______ with everyone.
e: "Aloof" (उदासीन / दूर) means emotionally distant, matching the man's withdrawal after frustration.

t: He was a kind man and wanted to join a ______ circus.
e: "Travelling circus" is the standard, idiomatic phrase for a circus that tours from place to place.

t: 'Get me a banana!' The little boy ran … the house and ______ shortly.
e: "Reappeared" (पुनः प्रकट हुआ) fits the context of the boy returning after running into the house.

t: ...while the white youngster walked ______ behind him.
e: "Abjectly" (दीनतापूर्वक) expresses a degraded, submissive manner, contrasting with the dark boy's commanding stride.

t: ...the little dark boy was striding ______ up and down the lawn.
e: "Imperiously" (शासकीय ढंग से) means in a commanding manner, fitting the boy's dominant behaviour.

t: To my utter ______, the little dark boy was striding up and down the lawn.
e: "Astonishment" (आश्चर्य) fits "to my utter astonishment," expressing great surprise at the scene witnessed.

t: One month ago, he had lost his vision in a car crash, his promising career as an F1 racer ended and all his ambitions tied to the sport were ______.
e: "Crushed" (कुचला हुआ / नष्ट हो जाना) conveys that his ambitions were completely shattered by the accident.

t: He was one of the youngest racers to have made it to the F1 ______.
e: "Circuit" (सर्किट) is the technical term for an F1 racetrack.

t: playing outdoor games with friends, which ______ from being immensely enjoyable, also develops teamwork.
e: "Apart from" idiomatically means "in addition to," fitting the sense that the games are enjoyable and also build other skills.

t: ...astounds ______ from the older generation.
e: "Astounds those from the older generation" correctly uses "those" to refer to people of the older generation.

t: kick at their ______ with their clawed hind feet.
e: "Adversary" (शत्रु) means an opponent or attacker, fitting the context of a predator being kicked away.

t: ...kangaroos often ______ for the water.
e: "Head for the water" is the idiomatic phrase meaning to move towards the water.

t: ...their means of ______ being their powerful hind legs.
e: "Locomotion" (संचलन) means the means of movement, correctly describing the function of the hind legs.

t: As the proverb says, 'He who hunts two hares, loses ______.'
e: The proverb conveys that pursuing two goals at once risks losing both hares, making "both" the correct fit.

t: Markets do not work in a fair manner when producers are few and powerful whereas consumers purchase in small amounts and are ______.
e: "Scattered" (बिखरे हुए) contrasts with "few and powerful" producers, describing widely dispersed consumers.

t: It stirs the mind so ______ that it causes great unrest.
e: "Violently" (हिंसक / ज़ोरदार रूप से) conveys the intense, disruptive force that causes "great unrest," matching the sentence's intensity.

t: Necessity is an ______ force that compels a man to do things.
e: "Irresistible" (अनूठा / रोके न जाने वाला) describes a force impossible to resist, fitting necessity's compelling nature.

t: (V) ______ by an A-frame on the side only, the Eye is described as 'the world's tallest cantilevered observation wheel.'
e: "Supported by an A-frame" correctly describes the structural support of the Ferris wheel.

t: Until ______ first by the 160 m Star of Nanchang in 2006.
e: "Surpassed" (पीछे छोड़ दिया) correctly indicates that the London Eye was overtaken in height by later structures.

t: work as the purifying ______ in the system.
e: "Station" (स्टेशन / स्थान) denotes a place where a specific function (purification) occurs, fitting the metaphor.

t: When combined with the ______ provided by the public authority, conventional information by local people can prevent animals from succumbing to floods.
e: "Undertaking" (प्रयास / कार्य) used as a noun here refers to the effort or initiative provided by the authorities, fitting the sentence structure.

t: The education system is ______ more and more frustrations among both students and teachers.
e: "Breeding" (उत्पन्न करना) means generating or producing, fitting the idea that the system is producing increasing frustration.

t: The same voice that … everything suddenly to life also drew them into a world that ______ into eternity.
e: "Stretched out" (फैला हुआ) conveys extending into a vast or boundless space, matching the idea of reaching into eternity.

t: The same voice that ______ everything suddenly to life.
e: "Brought everything suddenly to life" correctly conveys the voice's awakening effect on the scene.

t: A soprano voice floated from the open windows, resonating ______ the darkening greenery.
e: "Resonating over the darkening greenery" correctly conveys the sound spreading across the landscape.

t: All at once it was as if the entire scene was ______ by that voice.
e: "Awakened" (जागृत) conveys the scene being brought to life by the voice.

t: Dr Kurt Lewin found that when subjects made a public … to do something, they were more likely to stay the course than if they ______ their wishes to themselves.
e: "Kept their wishes to themselves" contrasts directly with making a public commitment, matching the sentence's logic.

t: Dr Lewin ______ of an important research finding.
e: "Learned" fits the description of Dr Lewin's research finding, an academic discovery.

t: That is why the newspaper is considered a source of ______.
e: "Power" (शक्ति) fits the newspapers' role in influencing public opinion, as described in the passage.

t: The newspapers are the ______ of day-to-day happenings in the world.
e: "Storehouse" (भंडार) metaphorically conveys newspapers as a vast repository of information.

t: it plays a crucial role in the ______ of species over time.
e: "Diversification" (विविधीकरण) describes the evolutionary outcome of adaptation producing varied species.

t: the ______ of many feudal privileges.
e: "Elimination" (उन्मूलन) means complete removal, fitting the abolition of feudal privileges.

t: It ______ with the storming of the Bastille.
e: "Commenced" (आरंभ हुआ) means began, correctly describing the Revolution starting with the storming of the Bastille.

t: With time, zero became a stepping stone to simplified computations, … the ways for development of algebra, algorithms and calculus, while eventually laying the ______ for computers.
e: "Foundation" (आधार) correctly conveys a base on which something is built, fitting "laying the foundation for computers."

t: ...zero became a stepping stone to simplified computations, ______ the ways for development of algebra.
e: "Paving the ways" correctly uses the present participle form needed for the sentence's active construction.

t: ...zero, the base of the present ______ system.
e: "Numeral system" (अंक प्रणाली) correctly refers to the number system, unlike the unrelated mystical terms.

t: they found Shan's body lying on the floor with arms and legs ______.
e: "Outspread" (फैला हुआ) correctly describes limbs stretched out, fitting the description of the body's position.

t: ...they heard the ______ of porcelain from inside.
e: "Smashing" (टूटने की आवाज़) conveys the violent breaking sound of porcelain, matching the urgency of the scene.

t: ...his sister knocked at the door ______.
e: "Relentlessly" (निरंतर रूप से) means without stopping, matching the sister's continuous, anxious knocking.

t: When he beheld the tears trickling down by the face of Gisippus, he then comforted him, and thanked him for his ______ kindness, refused the benefit that he offered, saying that it were better that a hundred such unkind wretches as he was should perish, than so noble a man as was Gisippus should sustain reproach or damage.
e: Since Gisippus is described as exceptionally noble, "incomparable" (अतुलनीय / बेजोड़) kindness, meaning matchless, best fits the context.

t: Courts help in the resolution of ______ issues.
e: Contentious means causing, involving, or likely to cause disagreement and argument. (Hindi: विवादास्पद / बहसतलब) Courts exist specifically to resolve matters that are disputed and argued — therefore "contentious issues" fits perfectly. Example: The director had a contentious relationship with the eccentric actor. Trap words that sound similar: Conscientious (कर्तव्यनिष्ठ) = putting a lot of effort into one's work; hardworking — not related to disputes; Presumptuous (धृष्ट) = failing to observe the limits of what is appropriate; over-bold; Contemptuous (तिरस्कारपूर्ण) = expressing a lack of respect or strong disapproval.

t: It is a sin against God and humanity to ______ places of religious worship.
e: Desecrate means to treat a sacred place or thing with violent disrespect; to violate or profane something holy. (Hindi: पवित्र स्थान को अपवित्र करना / अपमान करना) The context gives two powerful clues: "sin against God and humanity" + "places of religious worship" — both point to an act of religious violation, which is desecration. Example: Vandals desecrated the ancient temple. Other options fail grammatically or contextually: Upright (adjective/adverb — wrong part of speech for a verb slot); Disapprove = to have an unfavourable opinion (too mild for "sin against God"); Modest = unassuming (completely unrelated).

t: The bus from Haridwar to Delhi ______ at 11:15 a.m.
e: The trigger word is "daily" — indicating a habitual, repeated, or scheduled action. For habitual and scheduled actions, we use Simple Present Tense. The subject "bus" is singular and third person, so the verb must take the third-person singular form with -s: "arrives." Rule: For timetables, schedules, and habits — use Simple Present Tense (e.g., "The train leaves at 6 AM every day"). Why other options are wrong: "Arrived" = Simple Past tense (wrong — we need present); "Come/Arrive" = base form without -s (wrong — singular subject needs "arrives"); Also, in the context of transport/schedules, "arrives" is more precise and appropriate than "comes."

t: In the wake of the recent cross-border tensions, forces have been ______ at strategic locations for immediate action, if required.
e: "Deploy" means to move troops or equipment into position for military action — for example, "They plan to deploy more American soldiers over the next six months." This is the only word that fits the military/strategic context of the sentence. "Deported" means to expel a foreigner from a country, usually due to illegal status or a crime. "Departed" means left, especially to start a journey. "Deposited" means to put or set something down in a specific place. None of these alternatives carry the military positioning sense required here.

t: The ______ needs of the inhabitants seem to be fruit, iced drinks, shiny boots, and lottery tickets.
e: "Principal" का अर्थ है most important; main। यहाँ "principal needs" = मुख्य ज़रूरतें। Correct Sentence: The principal needs of the inhabitants...

t: Problems often ______ when you least expect them.
e: "Arise" का अर्थ है to appear या come up। Problems arise = समस्याएं उत्पन्न होती हैं। Correct Sentence: Problems often arise when you least expect them.

t: If my memory ______ me right, Abhimanyu was not killed by one person but by seven warriors.
e: "If my memory serves me right" एक fixed idiom है जिसका अर्थ है "if I remember correctly — अगर मुझे सही याद है।"

t: Once the interview was over I ______ felt light and free.
e: "Suddenly" का अर्थ है quickly and unexpectedly। Interview खत्म होते ही अचानक हल्का महसूस होना context में सही है। Correct Sentence: ...I suddenly felt light and free.

t: It is better to be prompt (तत्पर) and organised than to be ______.
e: "Reckless" का अर्थ है not thinking about possible bad results। यहाँ prompt और organised का विपरीत concept है। Correct Sentence: ...than to be reckless.

t: She decided to go on a/an ______ vacation.
e: "Recreational" का अर्थ है relating to activity done for enjoyment। Example: She decided to go on a recreational vacation.

t: The boys were tired, but not too tired to examine the little hut ______.
e: "Thoroughly" का अर्थ है in a careful and complete way। Context में hut की पूरी जांच की बात है। Correct Sentence: ...to examine the little hut thoroughly.

t: Crowds of tourists ______ across the square all day long.
e: "Flow across" का अर्थ है to stream or glide across something। Example: Crowds of tourists flowed across the square all day long.

t: driving high performance are encouraged in a ______ environment.
e: Business में high performance के लिए "competitive environment" (प्रतिस्पर्धात्मक माहौल) सबसे उपयुक्त है।

t: The number of ______ to landline phones had gone up from 9.8 million in 1995 to 21.7 million in 2019.
e: Landline phones के "subscribers" (ग्राहक) की संख्या बढ़ी। यह context में सही है।

t: India had only 1.2 million cell phone users in 1999, which grew to an ______ figure of 1161.7 million in 2019.
e: 1.2 million से 1161.7 million — यह वृद्धि चौंका देने वाली है। "Astounding" (अद्भुत, हैरान कर देने वाला) सबसे उपयुक्त है।

t: Mobile phones have also literally ______ phone booths.
e: Phone booths की संख्या 6.2 million से 0.2 million हो गई — mobile phones ने phone booths को literally "destroyed" (नष्ट) कर दिया।

t: IAF for its rapid deployment of assets at forward locations ______ response to the border row with China.
e: "In response to" (के जवाब में) एक fixed phrase है। "In response to the border row" सही है।

t: has sent a strong message to our ______.
e: Border row के context में "adversaries" (प्रतिद्वंद्वी, दुश्मन) सबसे उपयुक्त है।

t: higher soil and air temperatures, which could ______ drought conditions.
e: "Aggravate" का अर्थ है to make a bad situation worse। यहाँ drought conditions को और बिगाड़ना context में सही है।

t: During the past three months, tea prices have shown an ______.
e: Context में prices stabilised at high levels — "uptrend" (बढ़ती हुई प्रवृत्ति) सबसे उपयुक्त है।

t: tea output in the next year may reach to 800 tonnes as ______ 780 tonnes last year.
e: "Against" comparison के लिए उपयुक्त preposition है। "800 tonnes as against 780 tonnes" = पिछले साल की तुलना में।

t: Harry was the only person to have ever (survived) an attack by Voldemort — by somehow ______ the latter's 'killing curse'.
e: "Rebounding" का अर्थ है to bounce back from a negative event — Harry ने curse को वापस Voldemort पर ही लौटा दिया।

t: The plan recognises ______ addresses concerns pertaining to climate changes.
e: दो actions "recognises" और "addresses" को जोड़ने के लिए conjunction "and" सही है।

t: The plan details the importance of ecosystems for food production, health and other aspects of ______ survival.
e: "Human survival and sustainable development" — ecosystems और human wellbeing का relationship context में सही है।

t: The aborigines (आदिवासी) were often ______ as sub-humans with low status.
e: "Perceived" का अर्थ है to notice or realize। यहाँ यह subjective viewpoint दर्शाता है — लोगों ने उन्हें ऐसा समझा।

t: aboriginal Australians who were eventually ______ by the whites.
e: "Subjugated" का अर्थ है brought under control या dominated — colonialism के context में यह सटीक है।

t: Because manure is ______ from animals and plants.
e: "Derived" का अर्थ है obtained or received from। Manure animals और plants से derived होती है।

t: They came to the conclusion that the soil supplied the plants with the nutrients they needed, and that organic remains could aid growth because nutrients could be ______ from decomposing matter.
e: यह ऊपर Q.161 के समान प्रश्न है।

t: The effects of human-caused global warming are ______ for people alive today.
e: "Irreversible" का अर्थ है cannot be changed or undone। Global warming के effects अपरिवर्तनीय हैं।

t: protracted (लंबे समय तक चलने वाले) droughts are putting people at risk of ______.
e: Drought के बाद "famine" (अकाल, भुखमरी) का risk होता है — context में सबसे उपयुक्त।

t: Conditions like the rise in sea-levels have advanced to the point where whole ______ have had to relocate.
e: "Communities" (समुदाय) — groups of people who had to relocate। यह context में सही है।

t: Fountains can ______ also be musical instruments played by obstruction of water jets.
e: "Fountains" plural noun है, इसलिए "themselves" (स्वयं) सही reflexive pronoun है।

t: Posters are ______ to promote a brand or pass important information.
e: "Posters are used to promote" — passive construction में "used" सही है।

t: Without it, our jobs, our free time and our mobility ______ all be very different.
e: Hypothetical situation के लिए "would" (conditional modal) सही है। "Without oil, everything would be different."

t: in 2000, Total ______ with its main French competitor, Elf Aquitaine.
e: "Merged with" (विलय होना) — two companies के एक होने के लिए "merged" सही past tense है।

t: The beginning of the story is ______ in its presentation.
e: "Quaint" का अर्थ है unusual or old-fashioned in a charming way — story की शुरुआत अलग तरह की है।

t: a fine ______ of humour and pathos (करुणा).
e: "A fine blend of humour and pathos" — humour (हास्य) और pathos (करुणा) का सुंदर मिश्रण।

t: A group of researchers has ______ that pleasure and positive states of mind are better for our health.
e: "Demonstrated" का अर्थ है shown through evidence। Researchers ने evidence से prove किया।

t: retiring from a job means retiring from life unless ______ by some other activity.
e: "Supplemented by some other activity" — retirement को किसी नई activity से पूरक बनाना ज़रूरी है।

t: Some scientists believe that retirement to a ______ lifestyle initiates or aggravates medical problems.
e: "Sedentary lifestyle" (निष्क्रिय जीवनशैली) — जहाँ कोई physical activity न हो, वह medical problems बढ़ाती है।

t: the urgent need to disguise the ravages of smallpox, ______ left their faces pitted and scarred.
e: "Which" relative pronoun है जो non-essential additional information देता है। "Smallpox, which left their faces pitted" — सही है।

t: The inter-city transport of parcels from Calcutta ______ Guwahati, Bhubaneswar and Patna.
e: Present simple tense में "comes" — regular route को describe करता है।

t: I ______ the sun sink below the western isles.
e: "Fancied" का अर्थ है imagined या believed। "I fancied I could glimpse" — मुझे लगा मैं देख सकता हूँ।

t: If broadly beneficial immigration (प्रवासन) is to be sustained (बनाए रखा जाए), destination countries must acknowledge and ______ the real risks that it raises.
e: "Address the risks" (जोखिमों का समाधान करना) — यहाँ सबसे उपयुक्त है। Correct Sentence: ...must acknowledge and address the real risks.

t: The chef's culinary creations were infused with a distinctive ___ that set them apart from typical restaurant fare.
e: "Flair" (विशेष शैली) means a distinctive talent or stylish characteristic in performing an activity, fitting the context of unique culinary creations. "Flare" means a sudden burst of light; "Fair" means just or impartial; "Flere" means "some or a few" — none fit this context.

t: The door ___ in the strong wind.
e: "Slammed" (ज़ोर से बंद होना) means to shut with great force and a loud noise, exactly describing a door affected by strong wind. "Slapped" means to hit with an open hand; "Hooted" means to make a horn-like sound; "Sizzled" (छनछनाना) describes the sound of frying food — none fit a door shutting.

t: Some patches of the ___ garden have a rich cover of grass now.
e: "Sprawling" (फैला हुआ) means built or spread over a wide area in an irregular way, fitting the description of a garden. "Stroking" means moving a hand gently over something; "Stretching" means pulling to make wider; "Slouching" (झुकना) means having a drooping posture — none describe a garden's extent.

t: ___ yourself with the new perfume.
e: "Pamper" (आराम और सुख देना) means to indulge oneself with comfort and enjoyment, fitting the sense of treating oneself to a new perfume. "Prosper" means to succeed; "Percolate" means to filter gradually; "Purify" means to remove impurities — a perfume does not literally purify a person.

t: Fill in the blank with the correct option. While I was in the mall, I ___ a friend whom I hadn't met for five years.
e: "Ran into" (अचानक मिल जाना) means to meet someone by chance, perfectly fitting the context of unexpectedly meeting an old friend. "Ran off" means to escape; "Run down" means to reduce in size; "Ran up" refers to a period preceding an event — none mean "to meet by chance."

t: You ought to have ___ yourself of this golden opportunity.
e: "Availed" (लाभ उठाया) means to make use of something, especially an opportunity, and is used with a reflexive pronoun ("availed himself/yourself"). "Seized" and "Grabbed" mean to take hold of something but don't typically pair with a reflexive structure here; "Claimed" means to assert something is true.

t: I was sorry to hear that he is ___ with arthritis.
e: "Afflicted" (पीड़ित) means caused pain or trouble to, especially regarding illness, fitting the context of suffering from arthritis. "Altered" means changed; "Adapted" means modified for new use; "Affected" means influenced — "afflicted with" is the standard idiomatic collocation for an illness.

t: Suzerainty is having political control over a ___ state.
e: "Suzerainty" (अधिराज्यता) means the right of a country to partly control another while allowing it internal autonomy. "Dependent" (आश्रित) fits because the controlled state relies on the controlling power, matching the definition of suzerainty.

t: We should never ___ with the rules of driving.
e: "Tamper" (हेरफेर करना) means to interfere with something improperly, fitting the warning against meddling with driving rules. "Reckon" means to consider; "Trifle" means to treat without seriousness; "Temper" relates to mood — none fit the sense of interference here.

t: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate word. The committee members were in ___ over the budget for the function.
e: "Dissent" (असहमति) means a strong difference of opinion on a subject, fitting the context of disagreement over budget. "Difference" is too generic; "Deference" (आदर) means respect and politeness; "Descent" means movement downward — none fit a disagreement.

t: I am quite satisfied that I have not been ___ in doing whatever was needful for building up their character.
e: "Negligent" (लापरवाह) means failing to take proper care, fitting the sentence's sense that the speaker was satisfied at not having failed in their duties. "Affectionate," "Caring," and "Devoted" describe positive qualities and don't fit the structure "satisfied that I have not been ___."

t: It is hard to conceive of a more ___ route than the one that this determined traveler chose to follow.
e: "Daunting" (भयभीत करने वाला) means intimidating or difficult to deal with in prospect, fitting a difficult route requiring determination. "Provoking" means causing a reaction; "Stimulating" means arousing interest; "Dashing" means attractive and stylish — none fit a challenging route.

t: The owner of the house was ___ at the watchman for letting in a stranger.
e: "Indignant" (क्रोधित) means feeling or showing anger at something perceived as unfair, fitting the owner's reaction to a security lapse. "Indulgent" means lenient; "Indifferent" means unconcerned; "Impatient" means easily irritated by delay — none fit anger at the watchman's mistake.

t: Through the …, lonely years of my childhood, when my father's palace … to tighten its grip … me until I couldn't ______, I would go to my nurse and ask for a story.
e: The sentence describes a difficult childhood situation where the palace's grip made it hard for the narrator to do something basic. "Breathe" is needed in its infinitive form here (not requiring an auxiliary verb), making it the only grammatically correct option. "Breath" is a noun, "breathed" is past participle, and "breathing" is present participle — none fit the infinitive construction required.

t: An unpardonable ______, but it was now too late to make amends for it.
