e: "Lapse" (चूक) means a brief slip or mistake, which fits the context of forgetting an essential item like a rifle. "Yearn" means to long for something; "Reward" means something given for good behaviour; "Crime" is too severe a word for the small forgetfulness described.

t: Elders are the ______ force for any family and hence the love and respect for elders comes from … and is not artificial.
e: "Driving force" (प्रेरक शक्ति) is a fixed phrase meaning the main motivating power behind something, fitting the description of elders as central to family unity. "Caring" means feeling concern; "Diverting" means causing to change direction; "Deriving" means obtaining from a source — none form a standard phrase with "force" in this context.

t: Indian culture treats guests as God and serves them and takes care of them as if they are a part and ______ of the family itself.
e: "Part and parcel" (अभिन्न अंग) is a common fixed idiom meaning an essential or integral component, exactly fitting the description of guests being treated as part of the family. "Member," "Mate," and "Colleague" do not complete this fixed idiomatic phrase.

t: So, clearly, death was something that the surviving Europeans had on their mind, and it is not surprising that they ______ an image to represent it.
e: "Conjured" (कल्पना से प्रकट करना) means to bring to mind or create through imagination, fitting the idea of inventing an image (the Grim Reaper) to represent death. "Desired" means wanted; "Forced" and "Compelled" mean to make someone do something against their will — none capture the act of imaginatively creating a symbol.

t: It is not surprising that the surviving Europeans ______ an image to represent death.
e: "Perished" (नष्ट हो जाना/मरना) means to die or come to an end, fitting the context of population dying due to the Black Death pandemic. "Shriveled" means to shrink and wrinkle; "Vanished" means to disappear suddenly; "Moldered" means to decay over time — none specifically describe mass death from a pandemic.

t: The function began with the ______ of the lamp, followed by the distribution of certificates in a very systematic way.
e: "Lighting" (रोशनी करना) refers to the act of using light to begin a ceremony, exactly fitting the traditional Indian custom of lighting a lamp at the start of a function. "Lightening" means making lighter or brighter; "Sparking" means producing flashes; "Glittering" means shining brightly — none fit the action of beginning a ceremony with a lamp.

t: In 1927 he got his wish, ______ a deal with Universal to produce a new series based on the adventures of a character called Oswald the Lucky Rabbit.
e: "Striking a deal" (समझौता करना) is a common fixed phrase meaning to reach an agreement, fitting the context of Disney entering a business partnership with Universal. "Crossing" refers to going across; "Bewitching" means enchanting; "Possessing" means owning — none fit the act of finalizing a business agreement.

t: We use turmeric on wounds, also to dye ______ and it is added extensively in our cooking.
e: "Locally" (स्थानीय रूप से) means with reference to a particular nearby area, fitting the context of farm produce coming from the local area. "Closely" refers to a close relationship; "Nearby" is an adjective, not fitting the adverbial position needed here; "Nearly" means almost — "locally" correctly conveys the idea of area-specific production.

t: ______ these people were not scholars, but looters and grave robbers looking to make money
e: "Often" (अक्सर) is an adverb meaning many times on different occasions, fitting the context that the people digging up monuments were frequently looters and grave robbers. "Regularly" implies fixed intervals; "Seldom" means rarely, which contradicts the meaning; "Commonly" means by most people, which is less precise here than "often."

t: Agra's marble-marvel has such an overwhelming presence ______ other monuments in the town have been relegated … oblivion.
e: "Such...that..." is a correlative conjunction used to give a reason or result, fitting the structure of the sentence describing the Taj Mahal's overwhelming presence causing other monuments to fade into obscurity. "Than," "but," and "for" do not complete this correlative structure correctly.

t: 'A stitch in time saves nine!' This wise saying suggests that an (1) action taken on time to rectify an error rules … the possibility of accumulation of such errors and future ______.
e: "Damages" (नुकसान) refers to physical or other harm caused, fitting the context of the saying about preventing future harm by acting promptly. "Qualities," "Advantages," and "Facilities" do not fit the negative consequence implied by failing to act on time.

t: There is no point in allowing the ______ to grow and then take hasty actions to set things right.
e: "Discovered" (खोजा गया) means found unexpectedly, fitting the context of correcting an error as soon as it is found. "Proposed" means suggested for consideration; "Invented" means newly created; "Managed" relates to running or coping with something — none fit the act of noticing an error.

t: There is no point in allowing the ______ to grow before taking hasty action to set things right.
e: "Remedy" (उपचार) means a solution or treatment for a problem, fitting the context of correcting an error before it grows unmanageable. "Malady" means a disease; "Melody" means a tune; "Parody" means an exaggerated imitation — none fit the idea of a corrective solution.

t: Every time we switch … the television we find some product or the other ______ pushed towards us.
e: Since the sentence is in the present continuous passive sense, "being" (the present participle form of "be") fits correctly to describe products being continuously pushed onto viewers. "Be" is the base form, "been" is past participle, and "to be" doesn't fit the grammatical construction needed here.

t: Believe it … not, the first recorded watermelon harvest ______ nearly 5000 years ago in Egypt and is … in Egyptian hieroglyphics on the walls of their … buildings.
e: "Occurred" (हुआ) means happened or took place, fitting the context of describing when the first watermelon harvest happened in history. "Contained" means held inside; "Discovered" means found for the first time; "Produced" means made or created — none describe an event taking place at a point in time.

t: In order to attract more tourists, ______ resorts are built which take neither the local architecture … the ecology into consideration.
e: "Sprawling" (फैला हुआ) means spreading out untidily over a large area, fitting the description of resorts built carelessly across the landscape. "Scheming" relates to secret planning; "Stretching" relates to elasticity — neither fits describing built structures, while "sprawling resorts" is a standard, natural collocation.

t: The causes of pollution are quite ______, such as contamination of water, cutting of trees and forests, emission of toxic gases etc.
e: "Numerous" (अनेक) means great in number, fitting the description of many different causes of pollution being listed. "Plenty" and "Many" are roughly synonymous but make the sentence grammatically awkward in this construction; "Enough" means sufficient, which doesn't fit the meaning of "many different causes."

t: Others are disastrous and the damage is ______.
e: "Extensive" (विस्तृत) means great in amount or scope, fitting the description of significant earthquake damage. "Rampant" describes something unchecked and spreading; "Plentiful" and "Profuse" describe abundance but are less fitting for describing the scale of physical damage from a disaster.

t: Some earthquakes are ______ felt and cause little damage.
e: "Barely" (मुश्किल से) means almost not at all, fitting the context that some earthquakes are barely felt and cause little damage, implying minimal impact. "Easily," "Strongly," and "Weakly" do not correctly convey the sense of an earthquake being almost imperceptible.

t: You may try to ______ insults at him but he will remain polite even in the face of grave provocation.
e: "Hurl insults" (अपमान करना/गालियां फेंकना) is a fixed phrasal collocation meaning to shout offensive words at someone, fitting the context of trying to provoke a polite flatterer. "Haul" means to pull or transport; "Haze" refers to obscured atmosphere; "Hurt" means to cause pain — none fit this standard collocation with "insults."

t: A glib … with tremendous reserves of patience is ______ to be successful.
e: "Certain to be successful" means strongly believed to succeed without doubt, fitting the context of a patient orator's guaranteed success in flattery. "Fixed," "Clear," and "Sure" do not form the precise idiomatic collocation "certain to" expressing confident prediction here.

t: Sometimes, the ______ is so wide that there hardly … to be any possibility of bridging it.
e: "Gulf" (गहरी खाई/अंतर) means an important difference between the ideas or situations of two groups, exactly fitting the context of the wide generational divide between young and old. "Bay" and "Coast" refer to geographical land-sea features; "Crater" refers to a volcanic hole — none fit the metaphorical sense of "difference."

t: The ______ years of a man's life are spent in the lap of his mother.
e: "Formative" (विकासशील, संरचना-निर्माणक) means relating to a person's development, fitting the context of the years that shape a person's character early in life. "Forthcoming" and "Imminent" mean about to happen; "Anticipated" means expected — none specifically describe a developmental period of life.

t: Once, Hercules ______ to hold it for Atlas while the latter went looking for golden apples.
e: "Offered" (पेशकश की) means to express willingness to do something for someone, fitting the context that Hercules volunteered to hold the sky for Atlas. "Ordered" implies giving a command to someone else; "Afforded" relates to being able to bear a cost; "Extended" does not pair correctly with "to" in this construction.

t: Atlas did not want to ______ a job as arduous as holding up the sky.
e: "Take back" (फिर से ले लेना) means to resume responsibility for something previously given to someone else, fitting the context that Atlas, seeing how exhausting the task was, did not want to resume holding the sky himself. "Take out," "take away," and "take in" do not fit the meaning of reclaiming a burden.

t: Portia claims that even if she … to live as long as Sibylla, she would die as … as Diana because she can only be claimed ______ the manner specified by her father's will.
e: The preposition "in" sets the precise condition under which Portia can be claimed, matching the legal context of being bound "in the manner specified by her father's will." "From" indicates a starting point; "Through" indicates means; "At" indicates a specific time — none fit describing a binding condition or manner.

t: The unfortunate results of ______ too far are obvious in the environmental degradation.
e: "Venturing" (जोखिम भरा कार्य करना) means undertaking a risky or daring course of action, fitting the context that taking unbalanced risks led to environmental degradation. "Pioneering" means introducing new methods; "Risking" means exposing to danger but doesn't fit grammatically as "venturing too far" does; "Climbing" means ascending — none fit as precisely.

t: Perhaps India should listen to her ______ sages who taught the importance of balance.
e: "Ancient" (प्राचीन) means belonging to the distant past, fitting the description of sages who lived long ago and taught wisdom. "Initial" means existing at the beginning of something specific; "Antique" describes valuable old objects; "Extinct" means no longer existing — none fit describing wise figures from history.

t: Sedimentation ______ the plains of silt, a natural fertilizer.
e: "Deprived" (वंचित किया) means to take something away from someone or something, fitting the context that sedimentation prevented the plains from receiving the fertile silt they needed. "Destroyed" means demolished; "Distributed" means given out; "Disabled" means impaired — none precisely capture taking away a resource.

t: It's dinner time for the 25-year-old tusker and he's ______ balls made of steamed ragi flour
e: The sentence uses passive voice describing a general routine, so "fed" (the past participle, used passively) is correct: "he's fed balls of ragi flour..." "Feed," "feeds," and "feeding" don't fit the passive construction needed here.

t: In fact, … was sweeping the piazza in front of the … church in preparation for market day, ______ the deputy mayor
e: "Alongside" (के साथ-साथ) means next to or close to someone, fitting the description of the mayor sweeping next to the deputy mayor's father and another councilor. "Also" means in addition; "Along" means in a line with something long; "Above" means at a higher position — none fit this collaborative physical positioning.

t: … the earlier wars, the civilian populations were … not involved and the casualties were mostly ______ to the warring armies.
e: "Confined" (सीमित) means limited to a specific scope, fitting the context that earlier wars' casualties were limited mainly to soldiers rather than civilians. "Bound" means extremely likely; "Belonged" means being part of something suitable; "Attained" means achieved — none fit the sense of being restricted to a specific group.

t: It's running a two-week campaign calling on people to keep their eyes ______ for text in English, Japanese, and Chinese.
e: "There's a particular focus" means a specific, singled-out emphasis, fitting the context that the campaign especially targets public transport signs, maps, and historic site information. "Important," "Signifying," and "Meticulous" do not fit the sense of singling out specific types of signs for attention.

t: It's running … two-week campaign calling on Koreans and foreigners … to keep their eyes peeled for ______ in English, Japanese and Chinese text.
e: "Mistake" fits naturally as a general term for an error in translation that the campaign is looking for, while "blunder," "guffaws," and "oversight" carry connotations that are either too severe or unrelated to ordinary translation errors.

t: It left a legacy of instant and ______ death.
e: "Deferred" (विलंबित) means delayed or postponed, fitting the context that some deaths from the disaster occurred immediately while others happened after a long delay due to lingering poisoning effects. "Averted" means prevented; "Momentary" means lasting only a moment; "Detained" means held back — none capture the idea of delayed consequence.

t: When she … refuge with him from a bad dream, nothing could lull ______ back to sleep better than Mo
e: "Inherited" (विरासत में मिला) means to receive traits passed down from a parent, fitting the context that Meggie's love of books came from her father, Mo, who is also a reader. "Gained," "extracted," and "procured" describe acquiring something through effort, not naturally receiving a trait from a parent.

t: When she sought refuge from a bad dream, nothing could ______ her back to sleep better than his calm breathing.
e: "Beside" (के पास/बगल में) means next to, fitting the context that Meggie was sitting near Mo to hear his calm breathing while falling asleep. "Around," "behind," and "under" do not logically describe a position from which one could closely hear someone's breathing.

t: India comes second in the list of countries ______ most English speakers, albeit not as the first language.
e: "With" is used to include something within a group, fitting the context that India ranks second among countries "with" the most English speakers. "At" indicates a particular time; "By" indicates a method or agent; "From" indicates origin — none fit the meaning of inclusion in a ranked group.

t: They grow to about two feet in …, and reportedly mate at around 1000 kilometers from the ______.
e: "Anjarle" fits since the passage specifically discusses the festival held at Anjarle beach, and the turtles are described as mating about 1000 kilometres away from this specific named location. "Festival," "sand," and "sea" do not refer to the specific named place required.

t: Brick ______ tempted him with … of water and he loved the palm pith that was used as … for baking bricks.
e: "Kilns" (भट्टियाँ) refers to furnaces used for baking bricks or pottery, exactly matching the context of brick-making mentioned in the passage. "Jar" and "tub" are containers unrelated to brick-baking, while "factory" is too general compared to the specific term "kilns."

t: Competitions can be lucrative for ______ owners, with some prizes amounting to tens of thousands of dollars.
e: Since the following noun "owners" is plural, the modifying noun before it must be in its singular form to function correctly as an adjective phrase, fitting "bird owners." "Pigeons," "animal," and "people" either create grammatical mismatch or are less precise in context.

t: Regardless of what may or may not be true of my scholastic rigour, ______ I suspect the school-stress dream is quite common.
e: "Consistently" (निरंतर रूप से) means happening the same way over time, fitting the context of the narrator regularly dissatisfying themselves in their dreams about academic failure. "Conflictingly," "Unpredictably," and "Clumsily" do not capture the sense of a regular, repeated pattern of self-disappointment.

t: In 1901, Edward Henry set up fingerprints records for all the criminals a sentence ______ of more than one month's imprisonment.
e: "Completing" fits the standard collocation describing someone undergoing a prison sentence over a period of time, similar to the phrase "serve a sentence." "Passing" and "Finishing" do not fit this fixed collocation as naturally, while the context calls for a word describing duration of imprisonment.

t: In the 1870s, William Herschel, a British official in India, began experimenting with fingerprints as a ______.
e: "Hobby" (शौक) fits because the phrase "experimenting with" suggests a more casual, passionate engagement rather than formal "duty" or "job." "Pastime" suggests merely passing time without deeper passion, whereas "hobby" better reflects genuine personal interest in the activity.

t: India is already full of ______ pegs in round holes, who are unfit for their roles and are doing more harm than good.
e: "Square pegs in round holes" (अनुपयुक्त व्यक्ति) is a fixed idiomatic expression meaning people placed in roles unsuitable for them, exactly matching the context describing people unfit for their professional roles. "Large," "small," and "circular" do not complete this fixed idiom.

t: … for centuries, the harbour town was an important trading post ______ both a seaport and as the north-western terminus of a caravan … route stretching across the desert to Timbuktu … in Africa's interior.
e: The blank needs a preposition to refer to the function or character of the harbour town, which is best represented by "as," fitting the structure "trading post as both a seaport and as a terminus." "At" refers to specific time; "By" indicates the agent performing an action; "From" indicates a starting point — none fit describing dual function or role.

t: She's been off work with ___ stomach.
e: Upset (परेशान/गड़बड़) when used with stomach means having disturbed digestion. Overset (भावनात्मक रूप से परेशान) refers to emotional disturbance. Agitated (बेचैन) and Perturbed (चिंतित) describe mental states, not physical stomach conditions. Correct sentence: She's been off work with an upset stomach.

t: She was laughing from the ___ exuberance of the performance.
e: "Sheer" (बिल्कुल/पूर्ण) means not mixed with anything else; used to create emphasis on completeness. "Utter" (चरम) and "Total" (सम्पूर्ण) also mean extreme but are less idiomatic in this context. "Perfect" (परिपूर्ण) doesn't fit naturally here. Correct sentence: She was laughing from the sheer exuberance of the performance.

t: Fill in the blank with the most suitable word. ___ on the silver tray like a white snake, the wedding garland was as thick as my forearm.
e: "Coiled" (कुंडलित) means wound or twisted in a spiral — exactly like a snake would rest on a tray. "Repeated" (दोहराया) means done again. "Circulated" (प्रसारित) means moved through a system. "Bartered" (वस्तु-विनिमय) means exchanged without money. Correct sentence: Coiled on the silver tray like a white snake, the wedding garland was as thick as my forearm.

t: Fill in the blank with the most suitable word. He was rewarded for his meekness ___ and understanding heart.
e: "With" (के साथ) is a preposition showing manner. "A wise" (एक बुद्धिमान) is an adjective correctly modifying "understanding heart." "Wisely" is an adverb and cannot modify a noun. "Wiser" is comparative and implies an unnecessary comparison. Correct sentence: He was rewarded for his meekness with a wise and understanding heart.

t: Fill in the blank with an appropriate option. Earwax is a helpful and ___ part of your body's defenses.
e: "Natural" (प्राकृतिक) means existing in or derived from nature, not made by humankind — perfectly describing earwax as a bodily product. Transparent (पारदर्शी) means allowing light through. Flowing (प्रवाहमान) means moving continuously. Tedious (उबाऊ) means slow and boring.

t: Fill in the blank with an appropriate option. Pandavas returned to Hastinapur after their thirteen years of ___.
e: In the Mahabharata, the Pandavas were banished from Hastinapur for thirteen years. Exile (निर्वासन) means being forced to leave one's home or country as punishment — perfectly fitting the context.

t: Fill in the blank with an appropriate option. My heart ___ hard, bumping the broken glass, nicked by sharp edges.
e: "Thumped" (जोर से धड़का) conveys a strong, rhythmic pounding — exactly describing a rapidly beating heart. Lifted means raised higher. Inhibited means restrained. Thundered implies a loud external sound, not a heartbeat.

t: Shekhar Gupta is one of the ___ journalists of India.
e: Eminent (प्रतिष्ठित) means famous, important, and well-respected in one's profession. Imminent (आसन्न) means something unpleasant about to happen soon — wrong context. Exponent means one who advocates an idea. Pertinent means closely connected to the subject.

t: People of the older generation ___ over the good old school days.
e: "Reminisces over" (पुरानी यादों में खोना) means to indulge in enjoyable recollections of past events. "Remember" and "remind" cannot be combined with "over" to carry this meaning. "Retribute" means to pay back and is contextually wrong.

t: The committee reached ___ decision regarding the appointment of the chairman.
e: Unanimous (सर्वसम्मत) means fully in agreement — all members agreed on one decision. Exemplary means serving as an example. Compatible means able to exist together. Agreeable means pleasurable. Only "unanimous" fits the context of a committee decision.

t: Fill in the blank with an appropriate option. The ___ of revenge demanded a life for a life.
e: Obligations (दायित्व/कर्तव्य) refers to duties one is bound to perform morally or legally. In the context of a revenge code demanding equal retribution, "obligations" perfectly fits the serious tone. Cheering, Moaning, and Crowning are all contextually inappropriate.

t: Fill in the blank with an appropriate option. Wash, rinse and drain water from quinoa and ___.
e: "Set aside" (अलग रखना) means to put something to the side for later use — perfectly fitting the cooking instruction context. "Set upon" means to attack. "Set off" means to trigger or start. "Set in" means to become established.

t: Fill in the blank with the most suitable word. We won an unprecedented pardon from ___ President Karzai, and Gulnaz was freed.
e: "Then-President" (तत्कालीन राष्ट्रपति) means the person who was president at that specific time in the past. "Then" is used as an adjective before a title to indicate a past holder of that position. "Those" is a pronoun. "At time" lacks specificity. "Later" implies future.

t: I had a stroke at an early age, but what I thought was a great _____ at that time changed my life for the better.
e: "Injustice" (अन्याय) means an unjust act. The sentence implies the writer felt what happened was wrong, but it changed his life for the better. Only "injustice" fits this meaning.

t: The thick smoke _____ out of the landfill site is making the city's polluted air even more toxic.
e: "Billowing" (लहराते हुए) means moving outward with an undulating motion — perfectly describing smoke rising from a landfill. Other options do not fit the context.

t: She raced _____ towards the train.
e: "Frantically" (बेचैनी से) means in a hurried and disorderly manner. The context of racing toward a train implies urgency and panic, making "frantically" the best fit.

t: The young king tried to speak, but his tongue seemed to _____ the roof of his mouth.
e: "Cleave to" (चिपक जाना) means to stick or adhere firmly. The phrase "tongue clove to the roof of the mouth" is a well-known expression describing difficulty speaking.

t: By accelerating digitisation and leveraging next-generation technologies, the life insurance sector can double its _____ to Rupees 70 lakh crores.
e: "Assets" (संपत्ति/संसाधन) means resources with economic value. Doubling assets is the logical outcome of improved technology and digitisation in the insurance sector.

t: after thousands of hectares of fish enclosures were made ______, free
e: "Encroachment" (अतिक्रमण) means illegal occupation of land/water. Fish enclosures were removed after encroachment was cleared, giving dolphins unobstructed space.

t: His wealth ______ only by Jeff Bezos
e: The sentence requires passive voice in present tense. "Is surpassed" (पीछे छोड़ा जाता है) correctly shows that Gates's wealth is surpassed only by Jeff Bezos.

t: only by Jeff Bezos, ______ has a current net worth of $116 billion.
e: "Who" is used for people as subject of a relative clause. Jeff Bezos is a person and is the subject of "has a net worth" — so "who" is correct.

t: crowned by the chhattri, a parasol-like ______ symbolizing high rank.
e: The chhattri is a parasol-like "structure" (संरचना) symbolizing high rank. "Conduit" means a channel, "bridge" and "umbrella" do not fit architecturally.

t: date back about 1,500 years ago, and ______ the epitome of Indian rock-cut architecture.
e: The sentence uses past tense context ("date back"). "Were" (थे) correctly shows that the caves were considered the epitome of Indian rock-cut architecture historically.

t: Women must be ______ equal rights.
e: "Accorded" (प्रदान किया गया) means to be given or granted something officially. "Women must be accorded equal rights" is the most formal and appropriate phrasing here.

t: complete free, equitable and quality primary and secondary education ______ to relevant and effective learning outcomes.
e: "Leading to" is a participial phrase modifying "education." It correctly shows that the education should lead to relevant learning outcomes without changing the sentence's tense.

t: an overarching programme has been, therefore, ______.
e: The sentence uses passive voice in present perfect tense: "has been prepared" (तैयार किया गया है). "Prepared" as past participle correctly completes this structure.

t: are opting to ______ from Delhi driven by the increasing air pollution.
e: Families are "migrating" (पलायन करना) away from Delhi due to air pollution. The context of moving away from a polluted city strongly suggests "migrate" or "move away."

t: ______ richly diverse area is also home to rare animals.
e: "This" (यह) is used to refer to a specific singular noun just mentioned (the Valley of Flowers National Park). "These" is plural, "That" is more distant, "Which" is relative.

t: announcing his presence by letting ______ ear-piercing shrieks every 45 seconds.
e: "Letting out shrieks" (चीखना) is the correct phrase — meaning to produce or release sounds. "Letting loose" also works but "letting out" is more standard for sounds.

t: Corruption is an evil generally more _______ in the underdeveloped and developing countries of the world.
e: Rampant means flourishing or spreading in an uncontrolled way; unchecked and widespread. (Hindi: अनियंत्रित / बेलगाम) Corruption being "rampant" means it is widespread, difficult to control, and present in large amounts. Example: Corruption is rampant in many developing nations. Other options: Reluctant (अनिच्छुक) = unwilling or hesitant — wrong context entirely; Distant (दूर) = far away in space or time — makes no sense here; Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च) = lacking restraint in spending — different meaning and context.

t: Select the word that best completes the given sentence (collocation). Varun, the chef, _____ up a delicious meal in just 30 minutes.
e: "Whipped up" एक colloquial expression है जिसका अर्थ है to quickly prepare a meal। Example: Varun whipped up a delicious meal in just 30 minutes.

t: Select the word that best completes the given sentence (collocation). Marz would describe it in _____ detail.
e: "In great detail" (बड़े विस्तार से) एक common collocation है। "Great detail" का अर्थ है extensive या thorough detail। Correct Sentence: Marz would describe it in great detail.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
  After weeks of hard work, they finally had a ________ of success.
e: A) In this question, we are asked to select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. The context implies that after weeks of hard work, the individuals have experienced a small or initial indication of success. Therefore, the word 'glimmer' (a faint or brief indication of something) best fits the context.

t:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate word that can be used here based on the given context. 
 Macaulay _________ the western education system in India.
e: A) 'introduced'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि इतिहास में, Macaulay ने पश्चिमी शिक्षा प्रणाली को भारत में प्रवर्धित किया था। यहाँ पर बाकी विकल्प 'improvising', 'accepting', और 'revisiting' संदर्भ से सही नहीं हैं। इसलिए, "introduced" सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प होगा।

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 The company's new strategy helped them ________ in a highly competitive market.
e: B) flourish

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank 
 The constant noise from the construction site made it difficult for her to ________ on her studies.
e: a) concentrate

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 Their conviction and determination helped Kimirica overcome ________ odds and become India’s largest manufacturer of luxury hotel toiletries and guest room amenities
e: C) insurmountable'का use होगा क्योंकि "insurmountable" का अर्थ होता है कोई ऐसी समस्या या कठिनाई जिसे पार करना नामुमकिन हो। Sentence में mention किया गया है कि Kimirica ने अपनी दृढ़ निश्चय और संकल्प के बल पर ऐसी कठिनाइयों को पार किया और भारत का सबसे बड़ा लक्जरी होटल टॉयलेट्री और गेस्ट रूम एमेनिटीज का निर्माता बना, इसलिए 'insurmountable' यहाँ सही है। 'Undefeated', 'Inviolable', और 'Unstoppable' का यहाँ पर use होना सही नहीं है क्योंकि इनका अर्थ context के हिसाब से मौकूफ नहीं है।

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank 
 Despite the cold weather, they decided to go for a hike to __________ their spirits.
e: B) In this question, we are asked to select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. The context suggests that the individuals want to improve their mood or spirits by going for a hike despite the cold weather. Among the options, 'elevate' (to lift or raise up) best fits the context and conveys the intended meaning.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank 
 If the anesthesia is not _____ properly, he might wake up in the ______ of the surgery
e: D) administered'और 'middle' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि पूरे संदर्भ में, sentence अनेस्थेसिया के सही तरीके से देने और सर्जरी के दौरान जागने की संभावना की चर्चा कर रहा है। यहाँ "If the anesthesia is not ___ properly" के माध्यम से अनेस्थेसिया को सही तरीके से देने की महत्वपूर्णता को बताया जा रहा है, और "he might wake up in the ___ of the surgery" से सर्जरी के बीच में जागने की संभावना को दर्शाया जा रहा है। इसलिए, "administered" और "middle" सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प होगा।

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank 
 As a preliminary to negotiation the government was required to __ all the obnoxious measures
e: A) Rescind'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि पूरे संदर्भ में, sentence सरकार के द्वारा अप्रिय उपायों को वापस लेने की चर्चा कर रहा है। "As a preliminary to negotiation" यह दर्शाता है कि सरकार को वार्ता की पूर्व-स्थिति में कुछ कार्रवाई करनी थी। 'Rescind' का अर्थ होता है 'रद्द करना' जो इस संदर्भ में उपयुक्त है। इसलिए, "rescind" सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प होगा।

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 She couldn't help but feel a sense of __________ after finishing the challenging puzzle
e: A) In this question, we are asked to select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. The context suggests that the individual feels positively about completing the challenging puzzle. Among the options, 'exhilaration' (a feeling of excitement or elation) best fits the context and conveys the intended emotion.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 The chef's culinary skills were so impressive that even the most discerning critics were left __________.
e: A) In this question, we are asked to select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. The context implies that the chef's skills were so impressive that they managed to please even the most critical individuals. Among the options, 'satiated' (fully satisfied or gratified) best fits the context and conveys the intended meaning.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 Despite his illness, he decided to ________ with his work.
e: A) persevere

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 The weather report shows the _____ of rainfall.
e: D) 'Probability'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि मौसम की रिपोर्ट में वर्षा की संभावना की चर्चा की जाती है। "The weather report shows the _____ of rainfall." इस वाक्य में वर्षा की संभावित होने की स्थिति को दर्शाया जा रहा है। इसलिए, "probability" सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प होगा।

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 Rome grew from a small town on the Tiber River in central Italy into a _______ empire that ultimately embraced England.
e: A) Vast'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि यह शब्द विस्तार की अधिकता और बड़ापन को दर्शाता है। "Rome grew from a small town" इस संदर्भ में, हम बात कर रहे हैं कि कैसे रोम एक छोटे से शहर से एक बड़ी साम्राज्य में बदल गया। "Vast" उस साम्राज्य के विशाल विस्तार को सबसे अच्छा प्रकट करता है। इसलिए, "vast" सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प होगा।

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 The Thar desert is _____________ in the state of Rajasthan.
e: C) 'Situated'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'Thar desert' का स्थानिकता का वर्णन करते समय, हम उसकी स्थिति को संदर्भित करते हैं। "Situated" इस संदर्भ में उस रेगिस्तान की स्थिति को सटीक रूप से व्यक्त करता है। बाकी विकल्पों में, 'bounded' सीमा का संदर्भ देता है, 'seen' दर्शन का संदर्भ देता है, और 'placed' एक वस्तु को रखने का संदर्भ देता है, जो इस संदर्भ में सही नहीं होते। इसलिए, "situated" सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प होगा।

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 Tropical forests have _________ greenery.
e: B) Lush'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि पूरे संदर्भ में, sentence उष्णकटिबंधीय वनों की हरियाली और संपन्नता की चर्चा कर रहा है। "Tropical forests have _________ greenery." में हमें वनों की घनी और संपन्न हरियाली को दर्शाने वाला शब्द चुनना है। इसलिए, "lush" सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प होगा।

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 Time management is essential for a ________ life and career.
e: B) 'Successful'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि पूरे संदर्भ में, sentence समय प्रबंधन के महत्व की चर्चा कर रहा है और कैसे यह जीवन और करियर में सफलता प्राप्त करने में मदद करता है। इसलिए, "successful" सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प होगा।

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 All desire wealth and some will _________ it.
e: B) 'acquire'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि पूरे संदर्भ में, sentence धन प्राप्त करने की चाह की चर्चा कर रहा है। "some will _________ it" वाक्यांश से यह संदेश प्रदान किया जा रहा है कि कुछ लोग वास्तव में धन प्राप्त करेंगे। इसलिए, "acquire" सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प होगा।

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 That night the dinner was special, and the _________ himself came out to read out the menu list
e: D) Chef'का use होगा क्योंकि "chef" का अर्थ होता है वह व्यक्ति जो खाना बनाता है और होटल या रेस्तरां में उसकी जिम्मेदारी होती है। sentence में बताया गया है कि रात का खाना विशेष था और _________ स्वयं मेन्यू लिस्ट पढ़ने के लिए बाहर आए, इसलिए 'Chef' यहाँ सही है। 'Servant' का अर्थ होता है नौकर, 'Public' का अर्थ होता है जनता, और 'Guest' का अर्थ होता है मेहमान, जो इस context में सही नहीं है।

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 Plastic pollution is _________ the oceans’ ecosystem, but humanity doesn’t take serious action against it.
e: D) 'Affecting' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि "affecting" का प्रयोग तब किया जाता है जब किसी चीज़ पर प्रभाव पड़ रहा हो। दिए गए वाक्य में, "Plastic pollution" समुद्र के ecosystem पर प्रभाव डाल रहा है, इसलिए हम इसके पहले 'affecting' का उपयोग करेंगे!

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 Every cloud has a ______ lining.
e: B) Silver lining (phrase) – an advantage that comes from a difficult or unpleasant situation उम्मीद की किरण

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 It is only a rope, she ______ herself, though it looked very much like a snake.
e: D) 'reassured'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि पूरे संदर्भ में, sentence उस व्यक्ति की भावनाओं और उसके डर को दर्शा रहा है, जो सोच रही है कि रस्सी सांप जैसी दिखती है। "she ______ herself" के माध्यम से यह दिखाया जा रहा है कि वह व्यक्ति अपने आप को शांत कर रही है और खुद को यकीन दिला रही है कि यह सिर्फ रस्सी है। इसलिए, "reassured" सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प होगा

t:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate word that can be used here based on the given context. 
 We as human beings usually tend to forget that life itself is an accumulated process of _________.
e: A) 'learning' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि जीवन को समझाने वाले प्रक्रिया के रूप में, हम अनुभव और ज्ञान अर्जित करते रहते हैं। जीवन में, हम नई चीजें सीखते रहते हैं और हर चीज से कुछ नई सीखते हैं। इसलिए 'learning' सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द है।

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 The sky is quite overcast. We’re ______ to have rain today.
e: A) "likely,"is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank because it conveys a sense of probability without being too certain. The given sentence, "The sky is quite overcast," provides evidence that rain may occur but doesn't guarantee it. "Likely" captures this nuance well by indicating that there is a high chance of rain, but it's not absolutely certainOption D, "probably," is similar to "likely" in conveying a sense of probability. However, "likely" is a more suitable choice because it is more commonly used in the context of weather predictions and is less casual in tone.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 I have visited several places in India, but I ______ the Andaman and Nicobar Islands yet.
e: C) haven’t visited'का use होगा क्योंकि sentence में बात करी गई है कि मैंने अब तक Andaman और Nicobar Islands नहीं देखा है, इसलिए present perfect tense 'haven’t visited' यहाँ सही है। 'haven’t been visiting' continuous form है, जो यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं है। 'didn’t visit' simple past tense है, जो एक specific time के लिए होता है, और 'don’t visit' present simple tense है, जो एक general action या state को दर्शाता है, जो यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं है

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 The rescue team dug out a soldier from the snow ______ how he could have survived for seven days buried under it.
e: A) Wondering'का use होगा क्योंकि 'wondering' का अर्थ होता है सोचना या चिंतित होना। Sentence में rescue team एक soldier को बर्फ से बाहर निकाल रही है और सोच रही है कि वह सात दिनों तक कैसे जिन्दा रह सकता है, इसलिए 'wondering' यहाँ सही है। 'Wondered', 'to wonder' और 'Wonder' context में grammatically incorrect हैं क्योंकि वे इस specific situation में continuous action को नहीं बता सकते।

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 The girl was ________ as she was drenched in the rain
e:

t:

Therefore, the use of 'smarter and stronger' is the right phrase for the blank. The complete sentence is- 'Tia wanted a dog that was smarter and stronger than Larry's dog.' Hence, option (c) is correct. NOTE/- · The Positive Degree is used to denote the mere existence of some quality of what we speak about. It is used when no comparison is made. · The Comparative degree denotes a higher degree of quality than the positive and is used when two things are compared. · The Superlative degree indicates the highest degree of quality and is used when more than two things (or sets of things) are compared.

t:
Select the correct homonym from the given options to fill in the blank.
The wind _______ so powerfully that the door closed.
e:
Option (b), 'blew' can fill the blank. Options (c) and (d), 'blue' and 'blues' denote colours, but the blank requires a verb to denote the action done by the wind. So, these two options are negated. Option (a), 'blow' if used might lead to error in subject verb agreement because, 'wind' is a singular noun and 'blow' corresponds to a plural noun and so, it is also negated. Option (b), 'blew' is the grammatically and contextually correct word to fill the given blank.
Hence, the correct answer is option (b).
Note:
Subject-Verb Agreement: Matching up singular or plural subjects with singular or plural forms of a verb is part of the process called agreement. This can be understood better by the examples given: - "She likes cooking." [singular subject and verb] -- "They like to cook vegetables." [plural subject and verb]

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
Meenakshi sweeps the ball excellently when she _____ an off-spin delivery.
e:
The most appropriate option to fill in the blank is 'gets'. This option is correct because it is in the simple present tense, which is commonly used to express habitual actions or general truths. In the given context, "gets" indicates the action of Meenakshi sweeping the ball excellently as a response to an off-spin delivery.
Option (a) uses the future tense ("will get"), which suggests that the action of sweeping the ball excellently will occur in the future. But the sentence describes a habitual or general action that Meenakshi performs when faced with an off-spin delivery. The simple present tense is more appropriate for expressing habitual actions or general truths.
Option (b) uses the present perfect tense ("has got"), which indicates an action that started in the past and has relevance to the present moment. The present perfect tense is not suitable in the given context because the sentence does not emphasise the completion of the action, but rather the habit of sweeping the ball excellently in response to an off-spin delivery.
Option (c) uses the simple past tense ("got"), which indicates an action that occurred in the past. But the sentence does not describe a specific past event. Accordingly, this option is incorrect. Hence, (d) is the correct answer.

 ' और 'a' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'The road to Taj Mahal' एक विशेष सड़क को संदर्भित करता है, इसलिए यहाँ 'The' का प्रयोग करना उचित है। दूसरी ओर, 'a forest' का प्रयोग इसलिए किया जाएगा क्योंकि यहाँ कोई विशेष जंगल का उल्लेख नहीं है, बल्कि सामान्य रूप से एक जंगल की बात हो रही है। जैसे— The road to Taj Mahal passes through a forest.

t:

e:
C) 'Amidst'का use होगा क्योंकि "amidst" का अर्थ होता है 'के बीच में'। इस sentence में, श्रद्धा अपने विचारों की भूलभुलैया में स्पष्टता खोज रही है, और यह स्पष्टता chaos (अराजकता) के बीच में पाई जा रही है, इसलिए 'amidst' सही है। जबकि 'for' का अर्थ होता है 'के लिए', 'down' का अर्थ है 'नीचे', और 'upstairs' का अर्थ है 'ऊपर की मंजिल', जो इस context में सही नहीं है। 
 'Amidst' will be used because it means 'in the middle of'. In this sentence, Shraddha is seeking clarity within a chaotic situation, making 'amidst' the correct choice. Whereas 'for' means 'for the purpose of', 'down' means 'toward a lower place', and 'upstairs' means 'to the upper floor', which do not fit in this context.

t:

 Hasn't'should be used because the sentence is in the present perfect tense, as indicated by "has been discharged". In questions and negatives, we use "hasn't" to match the tense and subject (the Health Minister, which is third person singular)

t:

 'Aggrandize'should be used because it means to increase the power or importance of something, especially in a grand or significant manner. The sentence implies that what customs officials are asking for does not serve to enhance their personal positions, making 'aggrandize' the correct choice here. On the other hand, 'Accede' means to agree or to accept, 'Acerbic' implies being sharp or bitter, and 'Advocate' means to support or to be in favor of, which don't fit in this context

 Order'should be used because it means to request something to be brought or bought.  Turn down'should be used because it means to refuse an offer or proposal.  issued'should be used because the context is in the past tense. t:

 Can we reschedule the meeting? I _____
e:
A) Have a headache'का use होगा क्योंकि "have a headache" का अर्थ होता है सिरदर्द होना। Sentence में पूछा गया है कि क्या हम मीटिंग को दोबारा schedule कर सकते हैं क्योंकि मुझे सिरदर्द है, इसलिए 'have a headache' यहाँ सही है। जबकि 'Take a headache' गलत प्रयोग है क्योंकि सिरदर्द 'लेना' संभव नहीं है, 'Get a headache' का अर्थ हो सकता है सिरदर्द होना पर यहाँ 'have' अधिक सही है क्योंकि व्यक्ति पहले से सिरदर्द से पीड़ित है, और 'Give a headache' का अर्थ होता है किसी को सिरदर्द का कारण बनना, जो इस context में सही नहीं है 
 Have a headache'should be used because it means to experience a headache. The sentence asks if we can reschedule the meeting because the speaker has a headache, making 'have a headache' the correct choice. Whereas, 'Take a headache' is an incorrect expression because one cannot "take" a headache, 'Get a headache' could imply developing a headache but 'have' is more appropriate here as the individual is already suffering from it, and 'Give a headache' means to cause a headache to someone, which doesn't fit in this context

 Grate'should be used because it means to rub something into small pieces, such as removing the peel or making something finer by rubbing.  ______in biotechnology and medicine have resulted in tugher expeccancy rate and lower mortality rate.
e:
B) Advancements'का use होगा क्योंकि "advancements" का अर्थ होता है प्रगति या विकास, जो कि इस संदर्भ में बिल्कुल उपयुक्त है। Sentence में कहा गया है कि जैव प्रौद्योगिकी और चिकित्सा में की गई प्रगति से जीवन प्रत्याशा में वृद्धि और मृत्यु दर में कमी हुई है, इसलिए 'Advancements' यहाँ सही विकल्प है। 'Arrogate' का अर्थ है अनुचित तरीके से कुछ दावा करना, 'Aversions' का अर्थ है घृणा या विरोध, और 'Saturation' का अर्थ है पूर्णता या अत्यधिक भराव, जो इस संदर्भ में फिट नहीं बैठते। 
 Advancements'should be used because it signifies progress or development, which perfectly fits in this context. The sentence mentions that advancements in biotechnology and medicine have led to an increased life expectancy rate and a reduced mortality rate, making 'Advancements' the correct choice here. 'Arrogate' means to claim or take without justification, 'Aversions' means a strong dislike or opposition, and 'Saturation' refers to the state of being saturated or filled to excess, which do not align with this context

t:

e:
B)Derived'(from) का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि पूरे संदर्भ में, sentence नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा और उसके स्रोतों के बारे में चर्चा कर रहा है। यहाँ "renewable energy is energy that is environment-friendly because it is (9) ______ from renewable resources" के माध्यम से यह दिखाया जा रहा है कि नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा ऐसे स्रोतों से प्राप्त होती है जो स्वाभाविक रूप से पुनःपूर्ति किए जाते हैं। इसलिए, "derived" सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प होगा। 
 ‘Derived' (from)should be used because in the entire context, the sentence is discussing renewable energy and its sources. Here, through "renewable energy is energy that is environment-friendly because it is (9) ______ from renewable resources," it shows that renewable energy is obtained from sources that are naturally replenished. Thus, "derived" would be the most appropriate choice.

t:

 'Necessity'should be used because in the entire context, the sentence is discussing the need for harmony between the environment, society, and economy. Here, through "Many societies throughout history have understood the ______ for harmony between the environment, society, and economy", it portrays that essential element of maintaining balance among the environment, society, and economy. t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 The chairman apprised the members ______ the company’s current financial status
e:
A) of'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि पूरे संदर्भ में, sentence एक व्यक्ति द्वारा दूसरों को जानकारी देने की चर्चा कर रहा है। यहाँ "The chairman apprised the members (10)__________ the company’s current financial status" के माध्यम से उस जानकारी देने के क्रिया को दर्शाया जा रहा है, जिसमें एक व्यक्ति कंपनी की वर्तमान वित्तीय स्थिति के बारे में जानकारी दे रहा है। इसलिए, "of" सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प होगा। 
 ‘Of'should be used because in the entire context, the sentence is discussing the act of informing others. Here, through "The chairman apprised the members (10)__________ the company’s current financial status", it portrays that act of providing information about the company’s current financial status. t:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank 
 The country decided to place an economic __________ on its neighboring nation due to its involvement in unlawful activities.
e:
A) Embargo'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'embargo' का अर्थ है किसी देश पर आर्थिक प्रतिबंध लगाना। वाक्य में यह कहा गया है कि देश ने अपने पड़ोसी राष्ट्र पर अवैध गतिविधियों में शामिल होने के कारण आर्थिक __________ लगाया। इसलिए 'embargo' यहाँ सही उत्तर है। जबकि 'Encomium' का अर्थ है प्रशंसा, 'Zeal' का अर्थ है उत्साह, और 'Foray' का अर्थ है छापा या आक्रमण, जो इस संदर्भ में उपयुक्त नहीं हैं। 
 Embargo' will be used because it means an economic restriction or ban on another country. The sentence states that the country imposed an economic __________ on its neighboring nation due to involvement in unlawful activities, making 'embargo' the correct choice. On the other hand, 'Encomium' means praise, 'Zeal' means enthusiasm, and 'Foray' means a sudden attack or raid, which are not suitable for this context.

t:
Select the most appropriate degree of comparison to fill in the blank. 
 Many ornithologists believe that the northern mocking birds are __________ wild birds in the jungle.
e:
A)'The noisiest'का use होगा क्योंकि यह "noisy" का superlative degree है, और sentence में सभी जंगली पक्षियों के बीच तुलना की जा रही है। sentence में mention है कि उत्तरी मॉकिंग बर्ड्स सभी जंगली पक्षियों में सबसे ज्यादा शोर मचाने वाले हैं, इसलिए 'the noisiest' यहां सही है। जबकि: 'Noisy' केवल एक सामान्य गुण को दर्शाता है और तुलना की भावना व्यक्त नहीं करता। 'Noisier' comparative degree है, जो केवल दो पक्षियों के बीच तुलना के लिए उपयोग होता है, लेकिन यहां सभी पक्षियों की तुलना हो रही है। 'The noisy' का उपयोग superlative के रूप में नहीं किया जा सकता। 
 The noisiest' will be used because it is the superlative degree of "noisy," and the sentence compares northern mockingbirds with all other wild birds in the jungle. This makes 'the noisiest' contextually and grammatically correct. Whereas: 'Noisy' simply describes a characteristic and does not imply comparison.'Noisier' is the comparative degree used for comparison between two entities, but here the comparison involves all birds. 'The noisy' cannot serve as a superlative in this context.

t:

 'Menace' will be used because it means a threat or source of danger. The sentence mentions that increasing pollution levels have become a significant threat to the health of the city's residents, making 'menace' appropriate here. Whereas, 'Remedy' means a cure, 'Panacea' means a solution to all problems, and 'Jubilee' implies a celebration, which do not fit in this context.

 'Beleaguered'will be used because it means being in a difficult situation due to problems or pressures. The sentence mentions that the department is struggling to cope with the increasing workload and employee grievances, making 'beleaguered' fitting here. Whereas, 'Resourceful' means having the ability to find quick and clever solutions, 'Dynamic' means active or energetic, and 'Optimistic' means hopeful, which don't fit in this context.

t:

 The novel’s intricate plot and vibrant characters successfully ________ the harsh realities of life in an urban ________, where individuals constantly struggle against overwhelming ________.
e:
A)depict, milieu, odds 
 Depict'का use होगा क्योंकि "depict" का अर्थ होता है किसी वस्तु या स्थिति का चित्रण करना। sentence में यह दर्शाया गया है कि उपन्यास की जटिल कहानी और जीवंत पात्र शहरी क्षेत्र में जीवन की कठोर वास्तविकताओं का सफलतापूर्वक चित्रण (depict) करते हैं। 'Milieu' का अर्थ है वातावरण या सामाजिक परिवेश, जो यहाँ "urban milieu" को सही तरीके से दर्शाता है। 'Odds' का अर्थ है प्रतिकूल परिस्थितियाँ, जो लोगों के संघर्ष का सटीक वर्णन करता है। 'Describe' का अर्थ है वर्णन करना, लेकिन 'describe' से जटिल कहानी और पात्रों का वर्णन (depict) जैसा प्रभावशाली अर्थ नहीं निकलता। 'Outline' का अर्थ है रूपरेखा तैयार करना, जो यहाँ के संदर्भ में उपयुक्त नहीं है क्योंकि यह केवल सामान्य विवरण देता है। 'Portray' का अर्थ है चित्रण करना, लेकिन 'context' और 'opportunities' शब्द इस वाक्य के लिए उपयुक्त नहीं हैं क्योंकि यह शहरी क्षेत्र की कठिनाइयों को नहीं दर्शाते। 
 'Portray' means to illustrate, but 'context' and 'opportunities' don't match the context of urban struggles.

t:

e:
B) 'Indoctrinate'का use होगा क्योंकि "indoctrinate" का अर्थ होता है किसी विचारधारा को किसी के मन में बार-बार डालना या उसे प्रभावित करना। वाक्य में कहा गया है कि शासन ने युवाओं के दिमाग में अपनी पक्षपाती विचारधारा को शिक्षा और प्रचार के माध्यम से भरने की कोशिश की, इसलिए 'indoctrinate' यहाँ सही है। जबकि 'Intrigue' का अर्थ है किसी में जिज्ञासा उत्पन्न करना, 'Persecute' का अर्थ है किसी को सताना, और 'Implicate' का अर्थ है किसी को दोषी ठहराना, जो इस context में सही नहीं है। 
 'Indoctrinate' will be used because it means to inculcate a particular ideology or belief system in someone's mind repeatedly or forcefully. The sentence states that the regime tried to influence young minds with its biased ideology through controlled education and propaganda, making 'indoctrinate' fitting here. Whereas, 'Intrigue' means to arouse curiosity, 'Persecute' means to oppress, and 'Implicate' means to accuse or involve someone in a crime, which don't fit in this context.

A) Lofty'का use होगा क्योंकि "lofty" का अर्थ है महान, उच्च या आदर्शवादी दृष्टिकोण। वाक्य में यह दर्शाया गया है कि नेता की दृष्टि ने लोगों में आशा और उत्साह पैदा किया, जोकि एक महान और उच्च दृष्टिकोण के कारण ही संभव है। जबकि 'Mundane' का अर्थ है साधारण या सामान्य, 'Banal' का अर्थ है साधारण, जो प्रभावी या प्रेरणादायक नहीं है, और 'Grimy' का अर्थ है गंदा या धूल से भरा, जो इस context में बिलकुल भी सही नहीं बैठता। 
 Lofty'will be used because it means having a great, idealistic, or noble vision. 'Thrive' means to prosper, 'Persist' means to continue steadfastly, and 'Engage' means to involve or attract, which are not suitable for this context.

t:

t:

 The manager’s decision to cut bonuses provoked widespread _____________  among the employees.

t:

t:

 It took considerable __________ for the young journalist to question the corrupt official in a public forum.
e:
C) ‘Audacity'का use होगा क्योंकि "audacity" का अर्थ होता है साहस या निर्भीकता से किसी चुनौतीपूर्ण स्थिति का सामना करना। वाक्य में उल्लेख किया गया है कि एक युवा पत्रकार ने सार्वजनिक मंच पर भ्रष्ट अधिकारी से सवाल किए, जो उसके साहस को दर्शाता है, इसलिए 'audacity' यहाँ सही है। जबकि 'Ambivalence' का अर्थ है दोहरे विचार या असमंजस, 'Subtlety' का अर्थ है सूक्ष्मता या चतुराई, और 'Hesitancy' का अर्थ है झिझक या संकोच, जो इस संदर्भ में उपयुक्त नहीं हैं। 
 Audacity' will be used because "audacity" means the courage or boldness to confront a challenging situation. The sentence mentions that the young journalist questioned the corrupt official in a public forum, which indicates his bravery, making 'audacity' fitting here.Whereas, 'Ambivalence' means having mixed feelings, 'Subtlety' means being delicate or tactful, and 'Hesitancy' means reluctance, which are not appropriate in this context

t:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank 
 The team members worked in a __________ manner, ensuring that each individual's ideas were valued and seamlessly integrated into the project.
e:
C) Harmonious'का use होगा क्योंकि "harmonious" का अर्थ होता है समन्वयपूर्ण या सामंजस्यपूर्ण। वाक्य में यह बताया गया है कि टीम के सदस्य इस प्रकार काम कर रहे थे कि प्रत्येक व्यक्ति के विचारों को महत्व दिया गया और उन्हें प्रोजेक्ट में सहजता से जोड़ा गया। इसलिए 'harmonious' यहाँ सही है। जबकि 'Intuitive' का अर्थ है सहज ज्ञान पर आधारित, 'Deliberate' का अर्थ है जान-बूझकर किया गया, और 'Spontaneous' का अर्थ है स्वाभाविक रूप से या बिना योजना के किया गया, जो इस context में सही नहीं है। 
 'Harmonious'will be used because it means coordinated or in agreement. The sentence indicates that team members worked in a way that ensured each individual's ideas were valued and smoothly integrated into the project, making 'harmonious' the appropriate choice here. Whereas, 'Intuitive' means based on instinct, 'Deliberate' means done intentionally, and 'Spontaneous' means done without planning, which do not fit in this context.

t:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank 
 During the emergency meeting, the spokesperson ________ the members to take immediate action to prevent further losses.
e:
A) 'Implored'का use होगा क्योंकि "implore" का अर्थ है किसी से भावनात्मक रूप से आग्रह या विनती करना। Sentence में बताया गया है कि प्रवक्ता ने सदस्यों से तुरंत कार्रवाई करने के लिए आग्रह किया ताकि और नुकसान को रोका जा सके, इसलिए 'implored' सही है। जबकि 'Denounced' का अर्थ है किसी चीज की निंदा करना, 'Evaded' का अर्थ है बचना या टालना, और 'Alleviated' का अर्थ है किसी समस्या या पीड़ा को कम करना, जो इस context में सही नहीं है। 
 'Implored'will be used because it means to emotionally urge or plead with someone. The sentence mentions that the spokesperson urged the members to take immediate action to prevent further losses, making 'implored' fitting here. Whereas, 'Denounced' means to criticize something, 'Evaded' means to avoid, and 'Alleviated' means to reduce or lessen a problem or suffering, which don't fit in this context

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 He hasn’t _______ any attention to my miserable state
e:
D) 'paid' का प्रयोग सही है क्योंकि सही वाक्यांश है 'paid attention,' जिसका अर्थ है "ध्यान देना।" यह एक सामान्य collocation है, और इस संदर्भ में सबसे उपयुक्त है। 
 'paid' is the correct choice because the proper phrase is 'paid attention,' which means "to give attention." This is a common collocation and is the most appropriate in this context.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 The bride had a big villa in comparison to the bridegroom’s ______ house
e: C) Small'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि पूरे संदर्भ में, sentence दूल्हे के घर और दुल्हन के बड़े विला के बीच के तुलना की चर्चा कर रहा है। यहाँ "the bride had a big villa in comparison to the bridegroom’s (3)________ house" के माध्यम से उस भौतिक अंतर को दर्शाया जा रहा है, जिसमें दुल्हन का विला बड़ा है और दूल्हे का घर छोटा। इसलिए, "small" सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प होगा।

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 The grass on my lawn is glistening with the morning__________.
e: D) dew'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'dew' का अर्थ 'ओस' होता है, और इस वाक्य में लॉन पर सुबह की ओस का वर्णन किया जा रहा है; जैसे— The grass on my lawn is glistening with the morning dew.

t:
Select the option to fill in the blank with the most appropriate collocation. 
 In boarding schools, students need to ________ by themselves
e: A)'make the bed' का प्रयोग किया जाएगा क्योंकि यह सही collocation है जो यह दर्शाता है कि छात्रों को अपने बिस्तर को स्वयं ठीक करना पड़ता है। 'Make the bed' एक सामान्य English expression है, जिसका अर्थ होता है बिस्तर को सही तरीके से व्यवस्थित करना, जैसे चादरें सीधी करना और तकियों को ठीक से रखना।

t:
Select the most appropriate adverb to fill in the blank.
He comes here ________.
e:
The sentence requires an adverb that describes the frequency or manner of the action "comes here."
• Option 1: "Quickly" describes the speed of the action, not the frequency, and is inappropriate here.
• Option 2: "Formerly" means "in the past" and does not fit the context of regular occurrence.
• Option 3: "Daily" is an adverb of frequency, indicating that he comes every day, which fits the context perfectly.
• Option 4: "Lately" means "recently" and implies a change in behavior, which is not suggested by the sentence.
Thus, the correct option is 3) daily.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 Rosy and Nicky couldn’t provide any evidence to support ________ arguments
e:
B)'Their'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि पूरे संदर्भ में, वाक्य रोज़ी और निकी की तर्क की चर्चा कर रहा है। यहाँ "Rosy and Nicky couldn’t provide any evidence to support ________ arguments" के माध्यम से यह बताया जा रहा है कि उनके तर्क को समर्थन देने के लिए कोई प्रमाण नहीं था। इसलिए, "their" सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प होगा। 
 ‘Their'should be used because in the entire context, the sentence is discussing the arguments of Rosy and Nicky. Here, through "Rosy and Nicky couldn’t provide any evidence to support ________ arguments", it indicates that there was no evidence to support their arguments. Thus, "their" would be the most appropriate choice.

t:
Select the most appropriate connotation to fill in the blank. 
 Raju is such a _________always prying into other people's business!
e: B) Nosy'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि पूरे संदर्भ में, sentence एक ऐसे व्यक्ति की चर्चा कर रहा है जो हमेशा दूसरों के मामलों में टांग अड़ाता रहता है। यहाँ "Raju is such a _________always prying into other people's business!" के माध्यम से उस व्यक्ति को दर्शाया जा रहा है जो अत्यधिक जिज्ञासु और दूसरों के मामलों में हस्तक्षेप करने वाला है। इसलिए, "nosy" सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प होगा।

t:
Select the most appropriate homophone to fill in the blank. 
 The hospital is ________ the river
e: B)'by'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि पूरे संदर्भ में, वाक्य नदी के समीप स्थित अस्पताल की चर्चा कर रहा है। यहाँ "The hospital is ________ the river" के माध्यम से उस भौगोलिक संबंध को दर्शाया जा रहा है, जिसमें अस्पताल नदी के पास स्थित है। इसलिए, "by" सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प होगा।

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 Adult Education is a great step that must be taken by all the countries as it will__________ a lot of issues. The third world countries must especially work to make this happen so they can prosper.
e:
D)Resolve'का use होगा क्योंकि "resolve" का अर्थ है किसी समस्या या मुद्दे को हल करना। sentence में mention है कि वयस्क शिक्षा एक महान कदम है जिसे सभी देशों को उठाना चाहिए क्योंकि यह कई मुद्दों को हल करेगा। इसलिए, 'resolve' यहाँ सही है। जबकि 'contradict' का अर्थ है विरोधाभास करना, 'permeate' का अर्थ है फैल जाना या प्रवेश करना, और 'stagnate' का अर्थ है ठहराव में आना, जो इस संदर्भ में सही नहीं हैं। 
 Resolve'will be used because it means to solve or settle a problem or issue. The sentence states that adult education is a significant step that must be taken by all countries as it will address and resolve a lot of issues. Therefore, 'resolve' is the correct answer here. Whereas, 'contradict' means to oppose or deny, 'permeate' means to spread or penetrate, and 'stagnate' means to come to a standstill, none of which fit in this context.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 Spending quality time with friends and family is also _________ to have a healthy daily routine. These happy moments release happy hormones in the body.
e:
D)Obligatory'का उपयोग किया जाएगा क्योंकि "obligatory" का अर्थ है अनिवार्य या आवश्यक। वाक्य में कहा गया है कि परिवार और दोस्तों के साथ गुणवत्तापूर्ण समय बिताना स्वस्थ दिनचर्या के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है, इसलिए 'obligatory' सही विकल्प है। जबकि 'sceptical' का अर्थ है संदिग्ध होना, 'derogatory' का अर्थ है अपमानजनक, और 'unseasonable' का अर्थ है अनुचित समय पर कुछ होना। ये विकल्प वाक्य के संदर्भ में सही नहीं बैठते। 
 'Obligatory'will be used because it means something that is mandatory or essential. The sentence states that spending quality time with family and friends is important for maintaining a healthy daily routine, making 'obligatory' the correct choice. On the other hand, 'sceptical' means doubtful, 'derogatory' means disrespectful, and 'unseasonable' refers to something occurring at an inappropriate time. These do not fit in the context of the sentence.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 The tree lost many of its ___________ in the heavy rain and storm.
e:
B)'Branches'का उपयोग किया जाएगा क्योंकि 'branches' का अर्थ है पेड़ की शाखाएँ, और वाक्य में यह बताया गया है कि भारी बारिश और तूफान के दौरान पेड़ ने अपनी कई शाखाएँ खो दीं। यह संदर्भ स्पष्ट रूप से पेड़ के हिस्सों की बात करता है जो तूफान में टूट सकते हैं, जैसे कि शाखाएँ। जबकि: 'Creepers' का अर्थ है बेलें, जो पेड़ की शाखाओं का हिस्सा नहीं होतीं। 'Root' का अर्थ है जड़ें, जो आमतौर पर तूफान में नष्ट नहीं होतीं क्योंकि वे जमीन के अंदर होती हैं। 'Bark' का अर्थ है पेड़ की छाल, जो टूटने की बजाय छिलती है। 
 'Branches'will be used because it refers to the limbs or parts of a tree that can break off during a heavy rain or storm. The sentence specifies that the tree lost parts of itself, and 'branches' appropriately fits the context Whereas: 'Creepers' are climbing plants and are not parts of the tree itself. 'Root' refers to the base of the tree underground, which is unlikely to be lost in a storm. 'Bark' is the outer covering of the tree, which peels rather than breaks off.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 Our crops depend on the rainy season. Before the monsoon begins, farmers in communities begin their work in the fields. They irrigate their grounds and grow avariety of crops __________ for this season using the natural water supply.
e:
B)Appropriate'का उपयोग किया जाएगा क्योंकि इसका अर्थ है "उपयुक्त" या "सटीक," जो यहां दर्शाता है कि किसान इस मौसम के लिए उपयुक्त फसलें उगाते हैं। वाक्य में उल्लेख है कि किसान मानसून से पहले खेतों में काम शुरू करते हैं और प्राकृतिक जल आपूर्ति का उपयोग करके फसलें उगाते हैं। इसलिए 'appropriate' सही शब्द है।जबकि 'Inadequate' का अर्थ है "अपर्याप्त," जो इस संदर्भ में गलत है क्योंकि यह किसानों द्वारा उगाई गई फसलों को "अपर्याप्त" नहीं दर्शाता।'Incompatible' का अर्थ है "असंगत" या "मेल न खाने वाला," जो यहां किसानों की फसलों के लिए उपयुक्त नहीं है।'Manipulating' का अर्थ है "हेरफेर करना" या "चालाकी से कुछ संभालना," जो इस संदर्भ में बिलकुल सही नहीं है। 
 Appropriate'will be used because it means "suitable" or "exact," which fits the context that farmers grow crops suitable for the season. The sentence mentions that farmers begin their fieldwork and grow crops using the natural water supply, making 'appropriate' the correct word. 
 'Inadequate' means "insufficient," which does not make sense here as it implies the crops are insufficient. 'Incompatible' means "not suitable" or "not matching," which does not fit the context of crops grown by farmers. 'Manipulating' means "to handle something cleverly or skillfully," which is not relevant to the context of growing crops.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 A dam is a barrier that stops the flow of water and results in the creation of a___________
e:
C)Reservoir'का उपयोग होगा क्योंकि "reservoir" का अर्थ है पानी को संचित करने के लिए बनाया गया एक जलाशय। वाक्य में उल्लेख किया गया है कि बांध पानी के प्रवाह को रोककर एक संरचना बनाता है, जो 'reservoir' के अर्थ के साथ पूरी तरह मेल खाता है। जबकि 'barricade' का अर्थ है रुकावट या बाधा, जो पानी को रोकने के लिए होता है, लेकिन वह स्थायी जलाशय नहीं बनाता। 'Tunnel' का अर्थ है सुरंग, जो पानी को रोकने के संदर्भ में नहीं आता। 'Blockade' का अर्थ है रुकावट या नाकाबंदी, जो सैन्य या यातायात के लिए उपयोग में आता है, परंतु जल संरचना के लिए सही विकल्प नहीं है। 
 Reservoir'will be used because it refers to a storage space for water created by stopping its flow, which matches the context where a dam creates a storage area for water. 'Barricade' means an obstruction or barrier, but it does not indicate a permanent water storage area. 
 'Tunnel' refers to a passage, often underground, which is unrelated to storing water. 
 'Blockade' implies a restriction or obstruction, often in military or traffic contexts, and is unsuitable for describing a water structure.

t:
Select the most appropriate form of the bracketed verb in the following sentence to fill in the blank. 
 If only we ________(has) started earlier, we would be there now
e:
C)had’का use सही है क्योंकि वाक्य का पहला भाग ‘If only we ________ started earlier’ एक unreal स्थिति को दर्शाता है। जब कल्पना की जाती है कि कुछ भूतकाल में हो सकता था लेकिन नहीं हुआ, तब Past Perfect Tense का प्रयोग किया जाता है। वाक्य का दूसरा भाग ‘we would be there now’ वर्तमान में अप्राप्त स्थिति को इंगित करता है। 
 ‘had’ is the correct answer because the clause ‘If only we ________ started earlier’ refers to an unreal or imaginary condition in the past. When imagining something that could have happened but didn’t, we use the Past Perfect Tense. The second part of the sentence, ‘we would be there now’, reflects the current unreal outcome. Therefore, the correct answer is ‘had’.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 Siraj threw a stone to destroy the _______ built by the bird in a tree.
e:
B)Nest'का उपयोग सही है क्योंकि "nest" का अर्थ होता है पक्षियों का घोंसला। वाक्य में कहा गया है कि सिराज ने एक पत्थर फेंका ताकि पेड़ पर पक्षी द्वारा बनाया गया कुछ नष्ट हो जाए। यहां, पक्षियों का घोंसला ही उपयुक्त विकल्प है। 'Home' का अर्थ है घर, जो मनुष्यों के रहने की जगह के लिए अधिक उपयुक्त है। 'Roof' का अर्थ है छत, जो पक्षी के घोंसले के संदर्भ में उचित नहीं है। 'House' का अर्थ है मकान, लेकिन यह पक्षियों के लिए उपयुक्त नहीं है। 
 'Nest'is the correct option because it refers to the structure built by birds in trees for laying eggs and raising their young ones. The sentence mentions that Siraj threw a stone to destroy something built by a bird in a tree, making 'nest' the appropriate choice. 'Home' refers to a dwelling or residence, more commonly associated with humans. 'Roof' means the top covering of a structure, which is not suitable in this context. 'House' means a building for human habitation, which doesn’t fit the context of something built by a bird.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 Our environment is facing a severe crisis like never before. Any recklessness in this regard could prove ________ to life on Earth.
e:
C) The correct answer is'fatal'because "fatal" का अर्थ है "घातक" या "जानलेवा," जो इस संदर्भ में सही है। वाक्य में पर्यावरणीय संकट के गंभीर परिणामों की बात की जा रही है, और किसी भी लापरवाही के जीवन के लिए घातक साबित होने की संभावना है, इसलिए 'fatal' यहाँ सही उत्तर है।'Innocuous' का अर्थ है "हानिरहित," जो वाक्य के गंभीर स्वरूप के अनुरूप नहीं है।'Bland' का अर्थ है "फीका" या "उबाऊ," जो इस संदर्भ में फिट नहीं बैठता।'Harmless' का अर्थ है "बिना नुकसान का," जो वाक्य के चेतावनी वाले स्वरूप के विपरीत है। इसलिए, 'Fatal' ही सही उत्तर है। 
 Fatal' will be used because it means "causing death or destruction," which fits the context of the sentence. The sentence discusses a severe environmental crisis, highlighting the life-threatening consequences of recklessness, making 'fatal' the appropriate choice.  'Revitalisation'will be used because it means bringing new life or energy to something.  The word "persists" will be used because it means "to continue to exist" or "to remain for a long time."  Above'will be used because it correctly fits the idiomatic expression "over and above," which means "in addition to" or "besides." t:

 'Resourceful'will be chosen because it means the ability to handle situations efficiently and effectively. t:

 D.Textually'will be used because it means "in written form or through text."  Recognisable'will be used because it refers to the qualities or things that make you identifiable, which is the core idea of the sentence.  'Apparent'will be used because it means "clear" or "easily understood." The sentence mentions that the train stopped suddenly without any clear reason, which caused panic among passengers.  Quite' will be used because it means "very" or "a lot." In the sentence, "I am _________ busy," it emphasizes the level of busyness. 'Quite' fits perfectly as it strengthens the statement.  The blank is preceded by the article "a," which is used before singular, countable nouns beginning with a consonant sound.  'As soon as' will be used because it means "immediately after." The sentence conveys that the students stood up right after the teacher entered the classroom, making 'As soon as' the most appropriate choice. Whereas: 'Rather' means "instead," which is not suitable in this context.

 Personally, Ramesh was ____________ to his villagers than his elder brother.
e:
A) ‘More helpful'का use सही है क्योंकि वाक्य में दो व्यक्तियों (Ramesh और उसके बड़े भाई) की तुलना की जा रही है। Comparative degree (more helpful) का उपयोग तुलना के लिए किया जाता है। 'Helped' (सहायता की) सही नहीं है क्योंकि यह verb है, जबकि यहाँ adjective की आवश्यकता है। 'Helpfuller' अत्यधिक सहायक गलत है क्योंकि यह एक गलत शब्द है; comparative degree बनाने के लिए "more" का उपयोग होता है। 'Most helpful' सबसे सहायक superlative degree है, जो तब use होती है जब तीन या अधिक की तुलना की जाती है, लेकिन यहाँ केवल दो की तुलना हो रही है। 
 'More helpful'is correct because the sentence is comparing two individuals (Ramesh and his elder brother). The comparative degree ('more helpful') is used for such comparisons. 'Helped' is incorrect as it is a verb, but an adjective is required here. 'Helpfuller' is incorrect because it is not a valid word; "more" is used to form the comparative degree. 'Most helpful' is incorrect as it is the superlative degree used for comparisons among three or more, but here only two are being compared.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 I always believe that ________ is the best policy.
e:
D)Honesty'का use किया जाएगा क्योंकि "Honesty is the best policy" एक प्रसिद्ध कहावत है, जिसका अर्थ है कि ईमानदारी हमेशा सबसे अच्छा विकल्प है। यह sentence में संदर्भ के अनुरूप है। 'Sanctity' का अर्थ है पवित्रता, जो इस संदर्भ में उपयुक्त नहीं है। 'Immorality' का अर्थ है अनैतिकता, जो कि "Honesty" के विपरीत है और यहां गलत है। 'Complexity' का अर्थ है जटिलता, जो इस संदर्भ में कोई अर्थ नहीं बनाती है। 
 Honesty'will be used because "Honesty is the best policy" is a well-known proverb that emphasizes the importance of being truthful. It aligns perfectly with the context of the sentence. 'Sanctity' means sacredness, which is irrelevant here. 'Immorality' means unethical behavior, which is contrary to honesty and incorrect in this context. 'Complexity' refers to intricacy or difficulty, which does not fit in the given sentence.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 The athlete's performance was __________, earning him a standing ovation.
e:
A)Exceptional'का use होगा क्योंकि इसका अर्थ है "असाधारण" या "सर्वश्रेष्ठ।" sentence में mention है कि एथलीट का प्रदर्शन इतना अच्छा था कि उसे दर्शकों से standing ovation मिली। यह दर्शाता है कि प्रदर्शन असाधारण स्तर का था। 'Moderate' का अर्थ है "सामान्य" या "औसत से थोड़ा बेहतर," जो standing ovation जैसे असाधारण प्रतिक्रिया के लिए उपयुक्त नहीं है। 'Mediocre' का अर्थ है "सामान्य से भी कमजोर" या "औसत से नीचे," जो इस संदर्भ में बिल्कुल उपयुक्त नहीं है क्योंकि यह अच्छे प्रदर्शन का संकेत नहीं देता। 'Average' का अर्थ है "औसत," और यह भी standing ovation जैसे प्रतिक्रिया को सही ठहराने के लिए उपयुक्त नहीं है। 
 'Exceptional'will be used because it means "extraordinary" or "outstanding." The sentence indicates that the athlete's performance was so remarkable that it earned a standing ovation from the audience, signifying an exceptional level of achievement. 'Moderate' means "average" or "slightly better than average," which does not justify the extraordinary reaction of a standing ovation. 'Mediocre' implies "below average" or "of poor quality," which is inappropriate as it contradicts the positive tone of the sentence. 'Average' simply means "ordinary" and cannot justify a standing ovation, which is reserved for exceptional performances.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 The Great wall of China was built to link existing fortifications into a united__________ system and to keep the invading Mongol tribes out of China
e:
C)'Defence'का use होगा क्योंकि 'defence system' का अर्थ है रक्षा प्रणाली, और वाक्य में यह संदर्भ दिया गया है कि चीन की महान दीवार को आक्रमणकारी मंगोल जनजातियों को चीन से बाहर रखने के लिए बनाया गया था।'Irrigation' का अर्थ है सिंचाई, जो इस संदर्भ में अनुपयुक्त है।'Ecological' का अर्थ है पर्यावरणीय, जो यहां फिट नहीं होता।'Corporate' का अर्थ है व्यवसाय या संगठन से संबंधित, जो वाक्य के अनुसार सही नहीं है 
 'Defence'will be used because "defence system" refers to a protective system, and the sentence mentions that the Great Wall of China was constructed to keep invading Mongol tribes out of China.' Irrigation' means water management, which is irrelevant here. 'Ecological' refers to environmental concerns, which does not fit in this context. 'Corporate' pertains to businesses or organizations, which is not suitable for the sentence.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 The Indian Government has launched the National Rural Livelihoods Mission, a _________ programme aimed at reducing rural poverty.
e:
A)'Flagship'का use होगा क्योंकि 'flagship' का अर्थ है "किसी संगठन या सरकार का सबसे प्रमुख या महत्वपूर्ण कार्यक्रम"। sentence में यह स्पष्ट है कि राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण आजीविका मिशन एक महत्वपूर्ण और मुख्य कार्यक्रम है जो ग्रामीण गरीबी को कम करने के उद्देश्य से शुरू किया गया है। 'Designer' का अर्थ है "डिजाइन किया गया" या "फैशन से संबंधित", जो इस संदर्भ में सही नहीं है। 'Regressive' का अर्थ है "प्रतिक्रियावादी" या "विकास को पीछे ले जाने वाला", जो इस सकारात्मक पहल के लिए उपयुक्त नहीं है। 'Controversial' का अर्थ है "विवादास्पद", जो इस संदर्भ में गलत है क्योंकि वाक्य कार्यक्रम को विवादास्पद नहीं दिखाता। 
 Flagship'will be the correct as it means "the most important or prominent program of an organization or government." The sentence clearly conveys that the National Rural Livelihoods Mission is a significant and main program aimed at reducing rural poverty. 'Designer' means "created by a designer" or "related to fashion," which doesn't fit this context. 'Regressive' means "moving backward or counterproductive," which is inappropriate for this positive initiative. 
 'Controversial' means "causing public disagreement or debate," which is incorrect as the sentence does not indicate any controversy.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 The manager swiftly overtook him, ____________ effortlessly past the skinny Englishman, with a practiced ease.
e:
