A)Slidingका use होगा क्योंकि "sliding" का अर्थ होता है चुपचाप या आसानी से सरकना, जो इस sentence में contextually सही है। sentence में mention है कि प्रबंधक ने अपनी कुशलता से "skinny Englishman" को आसानी से पार किया, इसलिए 'sliding' यहाँ सही है। Dawdling (धीरे-धीरे चलना या समय बर्बाद करना) इस context में गलत है क्योंकि प्रबंधक का कार्य कुशलता और तेजी से किया गया है, न कि धीमी गति से। Kindling (जलाना या प्रज्वलित करना) का इस वाक्य के संदर्भ में कोई अर्थ नहीं बनता है। Rendering (प्रस्तुत करना या बनाना) का भी इस संदर्भ में उपयोग अनुचित है क्योंकि यहाँ प्रबंधक का कार्य गति और सहजता से सरकने का है। 
 Slidingis grammatically correct because it implies moving smoothly and easily, which matches the context where the manager moves past with practiced ease. The verb aligns with the sentence's depiction of fluid and skilled motion. Dawdling means wasting time or moving slowly, which contradicts the quick and efficient motion described in the sentence. Kindling refers to starting a fire or igniting something, which is irrelevant here. Rendering means to provide or depict something, which doesn't align with the context of physical motion.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 Our chemistry teacher taught us how, through a chemical reaction, milk ________ intocurd.
e:
D) ‘Converts'का use होगा क्योंकि "converts" का अर्थ होता है किसी चीज़ को एक रूप से दूसरे रूप में बदलना। इस sentence में यह बताया गया है कि हमारे केमिस्ट्री शिक्षक ने सिखाया कि एक रासायनिक प्रतिक्रिया के माध्यम से दूध दही में कैसे बदलता है। इसलिए 'Converts' यहाँ सही उत्तर है। 'Diverts' का अर्थ है दिशा बदलना, जो इस संदर्भ में सही नहीं है। 'Happens' का अर्थ है घटना या होना, लेकिन यह sentence के साथ contextually फिट नहीं बैठता। 'Progresses' का अर्थ है प्रगति करना, जो यहां उपयुक्त नहीं है। 
 'Converts'will be used because it means to transform something from one form to another. In this sentence, it explains how, through a chemical reaction, milk transforms into curd, making 'Converts' the most appropriate choice. 'Diverts' means to change direction, which doesn’t fit this context. 'Happens' means to occur, but it doesn’t convey the intended transformation. 
 'Progresses' means to make progress, which is not suitable here.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 As technology evolves, consumers increasingly _______________ products with enhanced features and greater efficiency.
e:
A)Demand'का use सही है क्योंकि यह एक सामान्य सत्य (general truth) और वर्तमान आदत (present habit) को व्यक्त करता है, जिसमें बताया गया है कि जैसे-जैसे तकनीक विकसित होती है, उपभोक्ता बेहतर सुविधाओं और अधिक कार्यक्षमता वाले उत्पादों की मांग करते हैं। 'Has demanded' गलत है क्योंकि यह वर्तमान आदत के बजाय अतीत में पूरी हुई क्रिया (completed action in the past) को व्यक्त करता है। 'Were demanding' गलत है क्योंकि यह अतीत में जारी प्रक्रिया (past continuous action) को व्यक्त करता है, जो यहाँ प्रासंगिक नहीं है।'Might demand' गलत है क्योंकि यह संभाव्यता (possibility) को व्यक्त करता है, जबकि वाक्य एक सामान्य सत्य को व्यक्त करता है। 
 Demand'is correct because it expresses a general truth or present habit, indicating that as technology evolves, consumers seek products with better features and efficiency. 
 'Has demanded' is incorrect because it refers to a completed action in the past, which does not align with the ongoing trend described. 'Were demanding' is incorrect as it denotes a past continuous action, which is irrelevant here. 'Might demand' is incorrect because it implies possibility rather than a general truth.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 The CEO came up with a groundbreaking strategy to _______________ new markets and capitalise on emerging trends
e:
B) “Break into"सही है क्योंकि इसका अर्थ है किसी नए बाजार या क्षेत्र में प्रवेश करना, जो इस sentence के संदर्भ में CEO की नई रणनीति के साथ मेल खाता है। "Break out" का अर्थ है अचानक उभरना या भाग जाना, जो यहाँ सही संदर्भ नहीं है। "Break down" का अर्थ है खराब हो जाना या असफल होना, जो इस सकारात्मक और रणनीतिक sentence के अनुकूल नहीं है। "Break off" का अर्थ है समाप्त करना या तोड़ना, जो नए बाजार में प्रवेश करने की रणनीति से संबंधित नहीं है 
 "Break into" is the correct option because it means to enter or penetrate a new market or area, which aligns with the context of the CEO devising a strategy to explore new markets and capitalize on trends. "Break out" means to escape or emerge suddenly, which is not contextually suitable here. "Break down" means to stop functioning or fail, which does not fit in the positive and strategic context of the sentence. "Break off" means to terminate or end, which is unrelated to the idea of entering new markets

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 There ______ been too many incidents of thefts lately.
e:
A) ‘Have'का use होगा क्योंकि sentence present perfect tense में है, और 'too many incidents' एक plural subject है। 'Have' plural subject के साथ सही auxiliary verb है। 'Has not' का उपयोग singular subject के साथ होता है, लेकिन यहाँ subject plural है। 'Was' past tense को दर्शाता है, जो वाक्य के context में सही नहीं है क्योंकि यह वर्तमान घटनाओं के बारे में है।'Has' singular subject के साथ use होता है, लेकिन 'incidents' plural है, इसलिए यह गलत है। 
 'Have'will be used because the sentence is in the present perfect tense, and 'too many incidents' is a plural subject. 'Have' is the correct auxiliary verb for a plural subject. 'Has not' is used with singular subjects, but the subject here is plural. 'Was' indicates the past tense, which doesn't fit as the sentence refers to recent events. 'Has' is used with singular subjects, but 'incidents' is plural, making it incorrect.

t:
Select the most appropriate adverb to fill in the blank. 
 Good books should be read again and _________
e:
A)Again'का use होगा क्योंकि इसका अर्थ होता है "फिर से," और यह इस वाक्य में सही अर्थ देता है। वाक्य यह कह रहा है कि अच्छी किताबों को बार-बार पढ़ा जाना चाहिए, इसलिए 'again' सही है। 
 'ever' का अर्थ है "हमेशा" या "कभी-कभी," जो इस संदर्भ में फिट नहीं होता। 'never' का अर्थ है "कभी नहीं," जो वाक्य के उद्देश्य से विपरीत है। 'After' का अर्थ है "के बाद," जो इस वाक्य में व्याकरण और संदर्भ के अनुसार उपयुक्त नहीं है। 
 Again'is appropriate because it means "once more," fitting the context of the sentence, which suggests that good books should be read repeatedly. 'Ever' means "always" or "at any time," which doesn't align with the context. 'Never' means "not ever," which contradicts the sentence's intended meaning. 'After' means "following," which is not grammatically or contextually correct here.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 She was barking up the wrong _______ when she filed a complaint against ragging with the students' union instead of the university administration.
e:
B) tree 
 Barking up the wrong tree(phrase)- be pursuing a mistaken or misguided line of thought or course of action. किसी वस्तु के बारे में ग़लतफ़हमी होना, या उसे प्राप्त करने के लिए गलत रास्ता अपनाना। 
 यह idiom इस स्थिति में उपयुक्त है क्योंकि वाक्य बताता है कि उसने गलत जगह (छात्र संघ) शिकायत दर्ज की जबकि उसे विश्वविद्यालय प्रशासन से संपर्क करना चाहिए था। 
 Tree'is correct because "barking up the wrong tree" is an idiom meaning to look for a solution in the wrong place or blame the wrong person. It fits the context where the sentence implies she complained to the student union instead of the appropriate authority, the university administration.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks. 
 If 2023 was ___ year consumers helped stave off a recession with an unexpected surge in spending, many economists _________ 2024 will be the time shoppers finally tighten their belts.
e:
D)'Thepredict'का Use होगा क्योंकि "the" का उपयोग एक विशेष (specific) वर्ष के संदर्भ में किया गया है, जो "2023" है। वाक्य में "2023" को पहले ही स्पष्ट रूप से संदर्भित किया गया है, इसलिए 'the' सही उत्तर है। जबकि 'An' और 'A' अनिश्चित (non-specific) चीजों के लिए उपयोग किए जाते हैं, जो इस वाक्य में फिट नहीं होता।'Predict'का use होगा क्योंकि यह भविष्य (future) की ओर इशारा करता है। वाक्य का दूसरा भाग यह दर्शाता है कि अर्थशास्त्री अनुमान लगा रहे हैं कि 2024 में क्या होगा, इसलिए 'predict' उपयुक्त है। 'Thought' भूतकाल (past tense) में है, जबकि यहाँ भविष्य की बात की जा रही है। 'Wanted' इच्छा का संकेत देता है, जो संदर्भ में सही नहीं है। 'See' वर्तमान (present tense) में है, जो इस संदर्भ में फिट नहीं होता। 
 'Thepredict' will be used because it refers to a specific year, "2023," already mentioned in the sentence. It specifies "2023," making 'the' correct. 'An' and 'A' are used for non-specific references, which do not suit this context. 'Predict' will be used as it refers to a forecast about the future, aligning with the idea that economists are speculating about 2024. 'Thought' is in the past tense, but the sentence discusses future speculation. 'Wanted' indicates desire, which is irrelevant here. 'See' is in the present tense and does not fit the context of prediction about 2024

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 Technology hasn’t left anything behind, it has _________ almost everything. From the phones we use to the medicines we consume; it is all a product of technology.
e:
B)Affected" का use होगाक्योंकि इसका अर्थ होता है "प्रभाव डालना।" sentence में mention है कि प्रौद्योगिकी ने लगभग हर चीज को प्रभावित किया है, जैसे कि हमारे द्वारा उपयोग किए जाने वाले फोन से लेकर हमारे द्वारा उपभोग की जाने वाली दवाओं तक। इसलिए 'affected' यहाँ सही है। जबकि: "Evicted" का अर्थ है "निकालना" या "विस्थापित करना," जो इस संदर्भ में सही नहीं है। "Effected" का अर्थ है "लागू करना" या "उत्पन्न करना," लेकिन यहाँ केवल 'प्रभाव डालने' की बात की गई है। "Dislodged" का अर्थ है "स्थान से हटाना," जो इस संदर्भ में भी उपयुक्त नहीं है। 
 "Affected" will be used because it means "to influence or have an impact on something." The sentence mentions that technology has influenced almost everything, from the phones we use to the medicines we consume, making "affected" the most appropriate choice. Whereas: "Evicted" means "to remove or expel," which doesn't fit the context. "Effected" means "to bring about or implement," but here the focus is on "influencing" rather than "implementing." 
 "Dislodged" means "to remove from a position," which is also not suitable in this context.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 The seven ________ for accreditation were presented in a seminar organised by the university.
e:
A) ‘Criteria’ सही है क्योंकि यह ‘criterion’ का plural form है, जिसका अर्थ है निर्णय लेने या मूल्यांकन करने के लिए उपयोग किए जाने वाले मानक या सिद्धांत। वाक्य में “seven” से संकेत मिलता है कि कई मानदंडों का उल्लेख किया गया है, इसलिए plural form ‘criteria’ उपयुक्त है। 
 ‘Criterions’ गलत है क्योंकि यह “criterion” का मान्य plural form नहीं है। ‘Criterion’ singular है और “seven” के कारण उपयुक्त नहीं है। ‘Criterias’ व्याकरण के दृष्टिकोण से गलत है क्योंकि “criteria” पहले से ही plural form है, और “s” जोड़ना अनावश्यक है। 
 Criteria'will be used because it means standards or principles (plural form). The sentence mentions 'seven,' indicating that the standards are plural. 'Criterions' is incorrect as it is an obsolete and incorrect plural form. 'Criterion' is singular and does not fit the plural requirement of the sentence. 'Criterias' is also incorrect as 'criteria' is already plural and cannot be pluralized further.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 It may seem __________ that the hours of women’s chores at home have not declined inspite of the availability of many appliances (gas, electric ranges, washing machines,etc)
e:
B) ‘Perplexing'का use होगा क्योंकि इसका अर्थ है "जटिल या भ्रमित करने वाला।" वाक्य में mention है कि महिलाओं के घरेलू काम के घंटे कई उपकरणों की उपलब्धता के बावजूद कम नहीं हुए हैं, जो एक जटिल और असामान्य स्थिति की ओर इशारा करता है। इसलिए 'Perplexing' यहाँ सही है। 'Persisting' का अर्थ है "लंबे समय तक बने रहना," लेकिन यह स्थिति के भाव को व्यक्त नहीं करता।'Promising' का अर्थ है "आशाजनक," लेकिन वाक्य में ऐसा कुछ नहीं है जो सकारात्मक या आशाजनक हो।'Perceiving' का अर्थ है "ध्यान देना या समझना," जो संदर्भ में सही नहीं बैठता। 
 Perplexing'will be used because it means "confusing or difficult to understand." The sentence highlights that despite the availability of modern appliances, the hours of women's chores at home haven't decreased, pointing towards a puzzling situation. 'Persisting' means "continuing over time," but it does not express the idea of complexity or confusion. 'Promising' means "hopeful or encouraging," which does not align with the negative tone of the sentence. 
 Perceiving' means "noticing or becoming aware of," which is irrelevant in this context.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 His friends disagreed _________ him on Undiplomatic that point
e:
B)With'का use होगा क्योंकि 'disagree' के साथ 'with' का use किसी व्यक्ति के साथ असहमति प्रकट करने के लिए किया जाता है। यह sentence indicate करता है कि उसके दोस्तों ने उस विषय पर उससे असहमति व्यक्त की। 'To' का अर्थ है 'की ओर' या 'के लिए', जो इस संदर्भ में सही नहीं है। 'For' का अर्थ है 'के लिए', जो किसी कारण या उद्देश्य को इंगित करता है। 'On' का अर्थ है 'पर', जो इस वाक्य में असहमति व्यक्त करने के लिए उपयुक्त नहीं है। 
 With'is used because 'disagree with' is the correct phrase to express disagreement with a person. The sentence indicates that his friends disagreed with him on that specific point. 
 'To' implies direction or purpose, which is incorrect in this context. 'For' denotes purpose or reason, which doesn't align here. 'On' indicates a surface or topic but is not suitable to express disagreement with a person.

t:
Select the most appropriate adjective to fill in the blank. 
 They needed a ___________ answer for every question.
e:
B) ‘Precise'का use होगा क्योंकि sentence सामान्य रूप से यह कहता है कि उन्हें हर प्रश्न का स्पष्ट और सही उत्तर चाहिए। यहाँ कोई तुलना नहीं की गई है, इसलिए 'more precise' और 'most precise' का उपयोग गलत होगा। 'Preciser' एक गलत है क्योंकि comparative adjective के लिए 'more' का उपयोग होता है। 'Preciser' व्याकरणिक रूप से गलत है क्योंकि 'precise' का कोई comparative रूप नहीं होता। 
 'Precise'will be used because the sentence generally states the need for a clear and accurate answer for every question. There is no comparison being made, so 'more precise' and 'most precise' are inappropriate here. 'Preciser' is grammatically incorrect, as English uses 'more' to form the comparative adjective. Hence, 'precise' is the correct choice. 'Preciser' is grammatically incorrect as 'precise' does not have a comparative form.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 The old man shared his __________ wisdom with the young generation.
e:
C)'Sagacious'का use होगा क्योंकि "sagacious" का अर्थ है बुद्धिमान और विवेकशील, जो sentence के context में फिट बैठता है। यहाँ उल्लेख किया गया है कि बूढ़े आदमी ने अपनी बुद्धिमत्ता और विवेकशीलता को युवा पीढ़ी के साथ साझा किया, इसलिए 'sagacious' सही है। Ephemeral' का अर्थ होता है क्षणिक या अल्पकालिक, जो यहाँ सही नहीं है क्योंकि बुद्धिमत्ता को अल्पकालिक नहीं कहा जा सकता। 'Trivial' का अर्थ है तुच्छ या महत्वहीन, जो इस संदर्भ में फिट नहीं होता क्योंकि बुद्धिमत्ता को महत्वहीन नहीं माना जाता। 'Frivolous' का अर्थ है हल्का-फुल्का या असंगत, जो कि इस sentence के serious tone के विपरीत है। 
 Sagacious' is chosen because it means wise and prudent, which fits the context of the sentence. The old man is described as sharing his wisdom with the younger generation, making 'sagacious' the most appropriate option. 'Ephemeral' means fleeting or short-lived, which does not apply here since wisdom is not a temporary attribute. 'Trivial' means unimportant or insignificant, which is inappropriate as wisdom is considered valuable. 'Frivolous' implies lighthearted or unimportant, which contradicts the serious tone of the sentence.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 The Warrens are __________ their house by the end of this month
e:
B)going to shift'का उपयोग किया जाएगा क्योंकि "going to" future intention या pre-planned action को दर्शाता है। वाक्य में बताया गया है कि Warrens इस महीने के अंत तक अपने घर को बदलने वाले हैं, जो एक निश्चित योजना का संकेत है। 'been shifting' का अर्थ होता है कि कुछ समय से प्रverb चल रही है, जो इस वाक्य में संदर्भित नहीं है। 'will shift' भविष्य की एक सामान्य संभावना को दर्शाता है, लेकिन यहां एक निर्धारित योजना का जिक्र है। 'shifted' भूतकाल को दर्शाता है, जबकि वाक्य भविष्यकाल के बारे में है। 
 ‘going to shift' will be used because "going to" indicates a future intention or a pre-planned action. The sentence states that the Warrens will change their house by the end of this month, which suggests a definite plan. 'been shifting' implies an ongoing process, which is not referenced in this sentence. 'will shift' denotes a general possibility in the future, but here a pre-determined action is mentioned. 'shifted' refers to the past, whereas the sentence concerns the future.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 I could make out from my son's voice that he was _____ as his exam did not go well
e:
A)Sad'का use सही है क्योंकि यह भावनात्मक स्थिति को व्यक्त करता है जब कोई निराश या दुःखी होता है। वाक्य में संकेत दिया गया है कि बेटे का स्वर उसकी परीक्षा ठीक न होने के कारण उसकी निराशा को दर्शाता है। 'Rejected' का अर्थ होता है अस्वीकृत करना, जो इस वाक्य के भाव से मेल नहीं खाता। 'Abrogated' का अर्थ है रद्द करना या समाप्त करना, जो भावनात्मक स्थिति के लिए उपयोग नहीं होता। 'Confused' का अर्थ है भ्रमित, लेकिन यहाँ बेटे की भावना स्पष्ट रूप से दुःख को दर्शा रही है, न कि भ्रम। 
 The use of'sad'is appropriate as it conveys an emotional state of being unhappy or disappointed. The sentence implies that the son's tone indicated disappointment due to his exam not going well. 'Rejected' means to be dismissed or not accepted, which does not fit the context of emotional expression. 'Abrogated' means to abolish or annul, which is unrelated to emotional states. 'Confused' implies being uncertain or unclear, but the son's tone clearly reflects sadness, not confusion.

t: The bat flew silently through the night, searching for insects to eat. The bat in this context refers to _______.
o: mammal known for nocturnal flight and insect consumption
a measurement unit in digital information systems
a wooden tool utilised in sports like baseball or cricket
the act of delivering a forceful strike or hit
e:
A) ‘mammal known for nocturnal flight and insect consumption'का use होगा क्योंकि "bat" का अर्थ एक स्तनधारी प्राणी होता है जो रात में उड़ता है और कीड़े खाता है। वाक्य में बताया गया है कि "The bat flew silently through the night, searching for insects to eat," जो इस प्राणी के संदर्भ में है। 
 mammal known for nocturnal flight and insect consumption'will be used because the word "bat" refers to a mammal that flies at night and feeds on insects. The sentence mentions "The bat flew silently through the night, searching for insects to eat," which clearly refers to the animal, making A the correct choice.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 The coaches decided to _____ the regulations more strictly because the candidates were not paying attention during their training sessions.
e:
C)'Enforce'सही answer है क्योंकि इसका अर्थ है नियमों या कानूनों का पालन सुनिश्चित करना। वाक्य में संदर्भ यह है कि कोच ने नियमों को सख्ती से लागू करने का निर्णय लिया क्योंकि उम्मीदवार प्रशिक्षण सत्रों के दौरान ध्यान नहीं दे रहे थे। 'Provide' का अर्थ है देना या उपलब्ध कराना, जो यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं है। 'Enjoy' का अर्थ है आनंद लेना, जो इस संदर्भ में अप्रासंगिक है। 'Supply' का अर्थ है कुछ उपलब्ध कराना, जो नियम लागू करने की भावना के अनुरूप नहीं है। 
 Enforce'is correct because it means to ensure compliance with laws, rules, or regulations. The context indicates that the coaches decided to implement the rules more strictly as the candidates were not paying attention during training sessions. 'Provide' means to give or supply, which does not fit as the sentence refers to implementing rules. 'Enjoy' means to take pleasure in something, which is irrelevant here. 'Supply' means to make something available, which does not align with the idea of implementing or imposing regulations.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 I checked the ____________ to see if it will be rain or sunshine.
e:
D)Weather'सही answer है क्योंकि यह "मौसम की स्थिति" को दर्शाता है, जैसे बारिश या धूप। 'Wither' का अर्थ है "मुरझाना," 'Whether' conjunction है, और 'Wether' एक बधिया भेड़ के लिए प्रयुक्त होता है, जो यहाँ अप्रासंगिक है। 'Wither': यह verb है और यहाँ noun की आवश्यकता है। 'Whether': यह conjunction है और यहाँ noun की जगह पर fit नहीं होगा। 'Wether': यह noun है लेकिन इसका अर्थ वाक्य से मेल नहीं खाता। 
 'Weather'is correct because it refers to the condition of the atmosphere, such as rain or sunshine, which the speaker wants to check. 'Wither' means to dry up, 'Whether' is a conjunction indicating choices, and 'Wether' is a term for a castrated ram, all of which are irrelevant to the context Wither': This is a verb, while the sentence requires a noun, making it grammatically incorrect. 'Whether': This is a conjunction and does not function as a noun. 
 'Wether': Although it is a noun, it refers to an animal and is contextually incorrect.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 The student received an __________ for his outstanding performance.
e:
A)'Accolade'का use होगा क्योंकि "accolade" का अर्थ होता है सम्मान या प्रशंसा। sentence में mention है कि छात्र को उसकी उत्कृष्ट प्रदर्शन के लिए कुछ प्राप्त हुआ, इसलिए 'accolade' सही है। Accolade एक सामान्य शब्द है जो प्रशंसा या सम्मान देने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है। जबकि 'Acolayd', 'Acolade', और 'Accolad' spelling errors हैं । 
 Accolade'will be used because it means praise or honor. The sentence mentions that the student received recognition for his outstanding performance, making 'Accolade' the correct choice. Accolade is a proper English word used to denote praise or award. On the other hand, 'Acolayd', 'Acolade', and 'Accolad' are incorrect spellings and not valid words in English.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 The library books were long __________________, their pages bearing the weight of the passage of time.
e:
B)'Overdue'का use होगा क्योंकि "overdue" का अर्थ होता है जो समय पर नहीं हुआ हो, जैसे किसी चीज़ का समय पूरा हो चुका हो। यहाँ पर यह संदर्भ पुस्तकें हैं जो समय पर नहीं लौटाई गईं और उनका पृष्ठ समय की दबाव को सहन कर रहा है, इसलिए 'overdue' सही है। जबकि 'Overdate' का कोई अर्थ नहीं है, 'Overdrew' का अर्थ है अधिक पैसे खींचना, और 'Overdo' का अर्थ है अधिक करना, जो इस संदर्भ में उपयुक्त नहीं हैं। 
 'Overdue'will be used because it means something that is past its expected time, like books that were not returned on time, and their pages are bearing the weight of time. In this context, 'overdue' fits best. 'Overdate' has no meaning, 'Overdrew' means to take out more money than is available, and 'Overdo' means to do something excessively, which is not applicable here.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 I have a __________ for reading and want to become a writer when I grow up.
e:
C)Passion'का use होगा। क्योंकि "passion" का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ के प्रति गहरी रुचि या उत्साह। sentence में यह बताया गया है कि व्यक्ति को पढ़ने में रुचि है और वह लेखक बनना चाहता है। यह दर्शाता है कि व्यक्ति में गहरी रुचि या जुनून है, इसलिए 'passion' सही है। 'Tallow' का अर्थ होता है पशु वसा, जो इस संदर्भ में अप्रासंगिक है। 'Unity' का अर्थ है एकता, जो यहां फिट नहीं बैठता क्योंकि यह किसी व्यक्तिगत रुचि को व्यक्त नहीं करता। 'Dream' का अर्थ है सपना, लेकिन यह यहां फिट नहीं बैठता क्योंकि 'dream' में गहरी रुचि या जुनून नहीं दिखता, जबकि 'passion' करता है। 
 'Passion'is grammatically and contextually correct because it refers to a strong interest or enthusiasm for something. The sentence mentions a deep interest in reading and a desire to become a writer, which aligns with the meaning of 'passion.' 'Tallow' means animal fat, irrelevant in this context. 'Unity' means togetherness, which doesn't align with the idea of personal interest. 'Dream' refers to an aspiration but lacks the depth of strong interest or enthusiasm that 'passion' conveys, making it less suitable here.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
His family lives __ Mahu in Madhya Pradesh.
e:
The blank requires a preposition to indicate the location where "his family lives." The place name is "Mahu in Madhya Pradesh," and the preposition must correctly describe residence in a specific place.
In English, "at" is used for specific locations or smaller places (e.g., "lives at [village/town]").
"Mahu" is likely a small town or village, making "at" appropriate.
Checking the options:
Option 1: "of" is incorrect for indicating location.
Option 2: "by" suggests proximity (e.g., near Mahu), not residence.
Option 3: "at" correctly indicates living in a specific place.
Option 4: "on" is used for surfaces or larger areas, not specific towns.
The completed sentence is: "His family lives at Mahu in Madhya Pradesh."
Thus, option 3 is correct.

t:
Select the most appropriate word from the options to fill in the blank. 
 Adithya ordered a juicy _________________ cooked to perfection at the highway restaurant.
e:
A)'Steak'का use होगा क्योंकि "steak" का अर्थ है मांस का एक मोटा टुकड़ा, जिसे आमतौर पर ग्रिल या फ्राई किया जाता है। sentence में बताया गया है कि आदित्य ने एक जूसी (रसदार) और परफेक्शन से पकाया हुआ ऑर्डर दिया, जो खाने की चीज की ओर इशारा करता है।Stakeका अर्थ है किसी चीज़ में दांव लगाना या हिस्सा।Stokeका अर्थ है किसी चीज़ को जलाए रखना या उत्साह बढ़ाना। यह खाना या ऑर्डर से संबंधित नहीं है।Stinkका अर्थ है बदबू आना। वाक्य में यह अर्थ बिलकुल भी फिट नहीं होता है। 
 'Steak'will be used because it refers to a thick slice of meat, typically grilled or fried. The sentence mentions that Adithya ordered something juicy and perfectly cooked, indicating food. Hence, 'steak' is the correct choice.'Stake'means a risk or share in something, not related to food, and does not fit the sentence context.Stoke'means to fuel or encourage something, not related to food or ordering.'Stink'means a bad smell, which does not fit the context of the sentence at all.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 He had always wanted to work for himself; so, last year he _________ his job at the bank and is now running a tool business.
e:
A) ‘Left'का use सही होगा क्योंकि 'left' का अर्थ होता है छोड़ना या त्याग करना। इस sentence में संदर्भ यह है कि व्यक्ति ने अपने बैंक की नौकरी छोड़ी ताकि वह अपने लिए काम कर सके और अब वह एक टूल व्यवसाय चला रहा है। वाक्य का संदर्भ अतीत में नौकरी छोड़ने के कार्य को दर्शाता है, जो 'left' से सही ढंग से व्यक्त होता है। 'Halted' (रोकना) का उपयोग संदर्भ में गलत है क्योंकि यह अस्थायी रोक को दर्शाता है। 'Bereft' (वंचित) का उपयोग भी गलत है क्योंकि यह भावनात्मक या भौतिक हानि का संदर्भ देता है। Cleft' (विभाजित करना) का उपयोग भी गलत है क्योंकि यह संदर्भ में किसी नौकरी छोड़ने का तात्पर्य नहीं देता। 
 'Left'is grammatically correct because it refers to leaving or resigning from a position. 
 The sentence context implies that the person quit their bank job to pursue their own business, which is correctly expressed by 'left.' 'Halted' (means to stop) is incorrect as it implies a temporary pause, not permanently leaving a job. 'Bereft' (means deprived) is also incorrect as it indicates a loss or deprivation, which doesn’t fit the context of willingly resigning. 'Cleft' (means split) is incorrect as it doesn’t convey the act of resigning.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 There are rows of chairs on either side of the ________
e: D) Aisle(noun) – a passage between rows of seats in a building such as a church or theatre, an aircraft, or train.गलियारा

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
Keats and Shelly were poets of the same period; in other words, they were _______.
e: The most appropriate option to fill in the blank is 'contemporaries'. The term "contemporaries" fits best to describe the relationship between Keats and Shelly. It refers to individuals who lived or worked in the same time period, especially in the context of being of similar age or time of life. This term signifies that Keats and Shelly were poets who were active during the same era or time period, indicating a shared timeline in their literary contributions. On the other hand, "co-writers", "colleagues", and "associates" do not precisely convey the intended meaning of existing in the same period. Hence, (a) is the correct answer.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
She could easily eat the ___ biryani by herself.
e: The most suitable option to fill in the blank is 'whole'. In the given sentence, the word 'whole' is the most appropriate choice because it denotes the entire amount or entirety of the biryani that the subject is capable of consuming. 'Whole' in this context emphasises that the individual is capable of consuming the entire portion of the biryani. On the other hand, the other options, 'haul' (to pull something with a lot of effort or difficulty), 'hall' (a building or large room in which meetings, concerts, dances, etc. can be held), and 'hole' (an opening; an empty space in something solid), do not make sense in this context, as they do not convey the idea of consuming food. Hence, (b) is the correct answer.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 A _________ is a female horse.
e: C)Mare'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि पूरे संदर्भ में, sentence महिला घोड़ी को वर्णन कर रहा है। 'Mare' शब्द महिला घोड़ी को दर्शाने वाला शब्द है, जबकि 'Vixen' महिला लोमड़ी को, 'Doe' महिला हिरण को, और 'Rooster' मुर्गा को दर्शाने वाले शब्द हैं। इसलिए, "mare" सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प होगा।

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 We _________ off old clothes and bought new ones for Diwali.
e: D)'cast'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकी पूरे संदर्भ में, sentence दिवाली के लिए पुराने कपड़ों को त्याग कर और नए कपड़े खरीदने की बात कर रहा है। "cast off" एक सामान्य शीर्षक है जिसका अर्थ है पुरानी चीजें छोड़ देना या त्याग देना। इसलिए, "cast" सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प होगा।

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 Eshwar Chandra Vidyasagar fought hard against ______practices which affected Indian society of his time.
e: A)'Many evil'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि यहाँ पर उन सभी बुरी प्रथाओं की चर्चा की जा रही है जिस पर Eshwar Chandra Vidyasagarने विरोध किया। 'Many evil' यहाँ पर उन अनेक बुरी प्रथाओं को दर्शाने के लिए सही विकल्प होता है जिसका वह विरोधी था।

t:
Select the most appropriate phrasal verb to fill in the blank.
The details were<u> ___ </u>from one person to the other within no time.
e: The most appropriate phrasal verb to fill in the blank in the given sentence is 'passed down'. The sentence suggests that information or details were transmitted or conveyed from one person to another. 'Passed down' is the most suitable phrasal verb for this context, as it implies the act of transmitting or handing down information or knowledge from one generation to the next or from one person to another. The other options do not appropriately convey the idea of transferring information from one person to another: Passed away- typically refers to someone's death. Passed in-does not convey the intended meaning of transmitting information. "Passed cut" is not a commonly used phrasal verb and does not convey the intended meaning of transferring information. Hence, (c) is the correct answer. NOTE: Phrasal verb: A phrase that consists of a verb with a preposition or adverb or both, the meaning of which is different from the meaning of its separate parts. Example: She has always looked down on me. Here, the phrasal verb 'to look down on someone' doesn't mean that you are looking down from a higher place at someone who is below you; it means that you think that you are better than someone.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 The termites were just the tip of the _________, but the house was near collapsing in reality.
e: B)'Iceberg' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि "tip of the iceberg" एक प्रचलित मुहावरा है जिसका अर्थ है किसी बड़ी समस्या या परिस्थिति का छोटा भाग दिखाई देना। जबकि 'Mountain', 'Shoe', और 'Heel' इस संदर्भ में सही नहीं हैं।

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 _________ in population is a hindrance to a country’s growth.
e: D)'Increase' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि "increase" का अर्थ होता है बढ़ना। जबकि 'Contract' का अर्थ है संकुचित होना या अनुबंध करना, 'Reduce' का अर्थ है कम करना, और 'Decrease' का अर्थ है घटना, जो इस संदर्भ में सही नहीं है।

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
She is _________ a peacock in the blue satin saree.
e:
Options (a) and (b) are negated because 'so' (to such a great extent) and 'very' (in a high degree) lay more stress on the adjective 'beautiful' rather than comparing the person and a peacock. Option (d) is negated because it means to state that the peacock is in a blue saree, which is not the context of the sentence.
Option (c) correctly establishes the comparison between the person (who is compared) and a peacock (with what/whom the person is compared) and so, it can fill in the given blank.
The complete sentence is: She is as beautiful as a peacock in the blue satin saree.
Hence, the correct answer is option (c).

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
'Habitual' may be replaced by '_____'
e: The most appropriate option to fill in the blank is 'continual'. "Habitual" and "continual" both imply something that occurs regularly or repeatedly over time. 'Stagnant' means characterised by lack of activity, growth, or development. 'Temperate' means mild, moderate, or restrained. 'Holistic' means characterised by the belief that the parts of something are intimately interconnected and explicable only by reference to the whole. Hence, (b) is the correct answer.

t:
Select the most appropriate phrasal verb to fill in the blank. 
 Mohan ____________ the charge of Centre for Life Skills from Mustafa.
e: D)'took over'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि पूरे संदर्भ में, sentence मोहन का Centre for Life Skills की जिम्मेदारी Mustafa से संभालने का संकेत कर रहा है। "took over" इस प्रकार के परिप्रेक्ष्य में किसी अधिकृत पद या जिम्मेदारी को संभालने का अर्थ होता है। इसलिए, "took over" सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प होगा।

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 The sermon of the priest was very short and _______.
e: C)Concise'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि पूरे संदर्भ में, sentence पुजारी के प्रवचन की लघुता और स्पष्टता की चर्चा कर रहा है। 'Concise' शब्द उस प्रवचन को संक्षेप में और सारगर्भित रूप में देने का अभिप्रेत है, जो प्रवचन के लघु और स्पष्ट होने का अर्थ है। इसलिए, "concise" सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प होगा।

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 Raghav had a good ______ for stage plays
e:
D)'Troupe'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि पूरे संदर्भ में, sentence रघव की रंगमंच पर नाटक के लिए एक समूह या टोली की चर्चा कर रहा है। "Troupe" एक नाटकीय समूह को दर्शाता है, जो एक विशेष नाटक के प्रदर्शन के लिए मिलकर काम करता है। इसलिए, "troupe" सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प होगा। 
 'Troupe'should be used because in the entire context, the sentence is discussing Raghav's group or team for stage plays. "Troupe" denotes a theatrical group that collaborates for the performance of a particular play. Thus, "troupe" would be the most appropriate choice.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
The ______ day is longer than ours, about thirty hours instead of twenty-four, with that divided evenly between day and night.
e:
Here, the blank is to be filled by an adjective qualifying the noun 'day'. Options (a) and (c) are negated as these are adverbs and option (d) is negated as it is a noun. 'Standard' satisfies the grammatical condition mentioned above and brings out a meaningfully coherent sentence.
Hence, (b) is correct.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
All students should express their ______ views in the group discussion without any fear.
e:
'Outspoken' means frank in stating one's opinions, especially if they are shocking or controversial. 'Guarded' means secured. 'Candid' means honest/truthful/straight forward. 'Secluded' means not seen or visited by many people; sheltered and private.
The sentence says that students should present their views fearlessly, so 'candid' is the right word to describe the straightforward and truthful thoughts.
Hence, option (c) is correct.

t:
Select the correct homonym from the given options to fill in the blank. 
Elephants are used in some countries for ______ timber.
e: Let's look at the meanings of the given options. Howling: producing a long, doleful cry or wailing sound. Hauling: pull or drag with effort or force. Holing: make a hole or holes in. Halling: an acrobatic Norwegian dance in duple measure for one to three single dancers. After observing the meanings of each option, we can say that 'hauling' is the most appropriate choice. The correct sentence is: Elephants are used in some countries for hauling timber. Hence, option (b) is the correct answer.

t:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate phrasal verb.
I ______ my friend at the airport yesterday.
e:
The phrasal verb "pick up" means to collect or fetch someone or something from a particular place. In this context, the speaker collected his or her friend from the airport. Hence, (d) is the correct answer. 
'Carry out' means to perform or complete a task, action, or plan.
'Go over' means to review, examine, or discuss something in detail.
'Set up' means to establish, organize, or arrange something.

t: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. After months of hard work and dedication, she finally ________ her degree and walked across the stage to receive her diploma.
e: The verb in the blank and 'walked' are joined by using 'and'. Here we need to follow parallelism to maintain the structure of the sentence. Since the verb 'walked' is in the simple past tense, 'earned' is the most appropriate choice among the given options. Hence, option (d) is the correct answer. The correct sentence is: After months of hard work and dedication, she finally earned her degree and walked across the stage to receive her diploma.

t:
Select the most appropriate homonym of the underlined word to fill in the blank.
She felt a <u>draft</u> as the wind blew through the open window. She quickly closed the curtains to block the _______.
e:
In the sentence, "draft" refers to a current of air. The context suggests that the blank needs to be filled with a word that describes the thing that she was trying to block by closing the curtains. 
"Droit" is not the correct choice. It's a French term that refers to a legal right or privilege. It doesn't fit the context of the sentence.
"Draught" is the correct choice. It refers to a current of air. It fits the context of the wind blowing through the open window and causing a sensation of air movement.
"Trout" is not the correct choice. It's a type of fish. It doesn't fit the context of the sentence, which is about blocking something related to air movement.
"Drought" is not the correct choice. It's a noun that refers to a prolonged period of abnormally low rainfall, leading to a shortage of water. It doesn't fit the context of the sentence.
Hence, option (b) is the correct answer.

t:
Select the most appropriate homophones to fill the blanks.
The _____ of the story _____ me.
e:
"Moral" refers to the lesson or message conveyed by a story, fable, or event. "Bores" is the third person singular of the verb "bore," meaning to cause (someone) to feel weary and uninterested in dull talk or behaviour. In this context, it suggests that the lesson or moral of the story was uninteresting or dull to the speaker.
Morale - confidence
Morel - a type of fungus
Morsel - a small piece/amount
Boar - drill/hole
Boor - ill-mannered person
Other options are contextually incorrect.
The complete sentence is "The moral of the story bore me."
Hence, option (b) is correct.

t:
Select the most appropriate homophones to fill in the blanks.
She withdrew her ___________ from the ___________ when he agreed to pay off the debt.
e: Option (a) is the correct choice. A sale is the exchange of a commodity for money or the action of selling something. A sail is a sailing ship. The sentence is about a person who withdrew from selling her ship.

t: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks. Though our team ____ agreed to the new terms, the opposite team ____ different opinions.
e:
In the given sentence, 'team' is a collective noun taken as a single unit which takes singular verb after it. So, both the blanks will take singular verb 'has'.
Hence, option (b) is the correct answer.

t:
Select the most appropriate homophone to fill in the blank. 
Authorities conducted a _____ on the illegal gambling den last night.
e:
Raid: A "raid" is a sudden and surprise attack or assault, typically carried out by law enforcement or other authorities.
Red: "Red" is a colour.
Read: "Read" is the past tense of the verb "to read," which means to interpret and understand written or printed material.
Ride: "Ride" refers to the action of sitting on and controlling the movement of an animal, vehicle, or device.
In the given sentence, the context is about authorities taking action against an illegal gambling den, and the appropriate term to fill in the blank is the action of a sudden and surprise attack, which is a "raid." Hence, (a) is the correct answer. 
The sentence would read: "Authorities conducted a raid on the illegal gambling den last night."

t:
Select the most appropriate phrasal verb to fill in the blank.
The teacher asked the students to ____ their ideas during the class discussion.
e:
The context suggests the teacher wants students to introduce or share their ideas during the discussion. "Bring up" means to introduce a topic or idea for discussion, fitting the sentence perfectly. The other phrasal verbs have meanings that do not suit the context.
"Get on" means to continue or make progress, not to share or introduce ideas.
"Put off" means to delay or discourage, which is unrelated to sharing ideas.
"Bring about" means to cause or make something happen, not to introduce ideas for discussion.
The complete sentence: The teacher asked the students to bring up their ideas during the class discussion.
Hence, the correct answer is option (c).

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
The entrepreneur's innovative approach to business management __________ a paradigm shift in the industry.
e:
Precipitated: To cause (a substance) to be deposited in solid form from a solution; to cause it to happen suddenly or unexpectedly.
Perpetuated: To make something continue indefinitely; to prolong the existence of something.
Promulgated: To formally announce or make known; to officially put a law or decree into effect.
Propagated: To spread or promote widely; to reproduce or multiply.
In the context of the given sentence, the entrepreneur's innovative approach is not merely causing or spreading a paradigm shift, instead, it is actively promoting a new way of thinking in the industry. Therefore, among the given options, the word 'promulgated' is the most suitable choice.
The complete sentence is: The entrepreneur's innovative approach to business management promulgated a paradigm shift in the industry.
Hence, the correct answer is option (c).

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
The blueberries in the basket are blue. The denotation of the word 'blue' is ______.
e:
The denotation of "blue" is its literal meaning, which is "a colour." Other options refer to connotative or figurative meanings.
Gloominess- a state of unhappiness, low spirits, or a feeling of being dark and depressing, often associated with a lack of hope or cheerfulness.
The complete sentence: The blueberries in the basket are blue. The denotation of the word 'blue' is a colour.
Hence, the correct answer is option (c).

t:
Select the most appropriate homophone to fill in the blank.
He ________ his bike as fast as he could to reach home.
e:
· "Rode" is the past tense of "ride" (correct in this context).
· "Road" is a path or street.

t:
Select the correct homonym from the given options to fill in the blank. 
The manager will be angry if you ______ him when he's in conference.
e: Let's look at the meanings of the given options. Face: confront and deal with or accept a difficult or unpleasant task, fact, or situation. Phase: carry out (something) in gradual stages. Fays: a fairy. Faze: disturb or disconcert (someone). After observing the meanings of each option, 'faze' is the most appropriate choice among the given options. The complete sentence is: The manager will be angry if you faze him when he's in conference. Hence, option (d) is the correct answer.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
The preamble ____ that India is a secular country.
e: The blank requires a verb that follows the subject "The preamble" which is singular. Therefore, it must be a singular verb. The only singular verb in the given options is option a). Since option b) includes a plural verb, it can be eliminated. Options c) and d) are adjectives. They can also be eliminated as the blank requires a verb to tell what it does with respect to India. 'States' and 'State' are nouns as well. In the given sentence, 'states' (as a verb) means 'to say or write something, especially formally'. Therefore, the correct answer is option a). Note: Subject-Verb Agreement: Matching up singular or plural subjects with singular or plural forms of a verb is part of the process called agreement. This can be understood better by the examples given: - "She likes cooking." [singular subject and verb] -- "They like to cook vegetables." [plural subject and verb]

t:
Select the most appropriate homophone of the underlined word to fill in the blank.
She was <u>allowed</u> to go to the party. She told her friends _______ about the same.
e:
The most appropriate homophone of the underlined word to fill in the blank is 'aloud'. This word means out loud or audibly. The other options are not suitable homophones of 'allowed', which means to permit or give permission. 'Elated' means very happy or excited, 'allude' means to hint or refer to something indirectly, and 'elude' means to escape or avoid.
Hence, option (a) is the correct answer.

t: I am expected to finalize the compliance report by evening, ______?
e: The Correct Ans is Option (B) - “aren’t I”. 📌 Rule / Concept: The “I am” Exception in Question Tags When the main clause is: I am + complement The correct question tag is: aren’t I? This is a fixed grammatical exception in English. ✅ More Examples for Clarity Example 1 ✅- I am eligible for the promotion, aren’t I? Example 2 ✅ - I am responsible for the delay, aren’t I? Example 3 ✅ - I am scheduled to attend the meeting, aren’t I? 🧠 Things to Remember “I am” → always “aren’t I?” Fixed exception — memorize it.

t:
Select the most appropriate verb/verb phrase to fill in the blank.
They ________________ their house for the past two months, and it's finally starting to look fantastic.
e:
• The phrase "for the past two months" indicates an action that started in the past and is still ongoing, requiring the present perfect continuous tense.
• Correct form: "have been renovating"

t:
Select the most appropriate collocating word to fill in the blank.
The investigation team decided to __________ the crime scene for further evidence.
e: Among the given options, "look over" is the best fit because it means to carefully examine or inspect something, which is appropriate when investigating a crime scene for further evidence. The complete sentence is: The investigation team decided to look over the crime scene for further evidence. Hence, (a) is the correct answer. Look out: Means to be vigilant or watchful, especially for danger. Look up: Refers to searching for information (e.g., in a dictionary or online) or visiting someone after a long time. Look away: Means to avert your gaze or turn your eyes away from something.

t:
Select the correct homonym from the given options to fill in the blanks. 
She picked the ____ and placed it over her left ear.
e:
The given sentence talks about how a female picked something and placed it over her left ear. Among the given options, 'flower' fits in the blank appropriately as it is used for aesthetic purposes. Hence, (c) is the correct answer.
The correct sentence is: She picked the flower and placed it over her left ear.
'Flour' means the powder obtained by grinding or milling cereal grains.
'Floor' means the interior bottom or surface of a house or building.
'Flyover' means a high-level overpass built above the main overpass lanes.

t:
Select the correct homonym from the given options to fill in the blank. 
She strummed the guitar, producing a beautiful ____ that filled the room.
e: Among the given options, 'chord' fits in the blank appropriately as its usage conveys the ability of a well-played set of notes by a female to create a captivating and immersive musical experience within the surrounding environment. The word 'chord' means any harmonic set of pitches/frequencies consisting of multiple notes. The complete sentence is: She strummed the guitar, producing a beautiful chord that filled the room. Hence, (b) is the correct answer. 'Cord' means thin, flexible string or rope made from several twisted strands. 'Card' means a piece of thick, stiff paper or thin pasteboard, in particular one used for writing or printing. 'Curd' means a soft, white substance formed when milk sours, and is used as the basis for cheese.

t:
Select the most appropriate homophones to fill in the blanks. 
His ____ in the play required him to ____ a giant prop onto the stage.
e: The first blank requires a part that a person played in the play. This is commonly referred to as a "role." A "role" in a play or performance is the character or part that an actor portrays. The second blank requires the action of moving a giant prop onto the stage. This action is commonly described as "rolling". "Roll" in this context means to move something by turning it over and over, typically on wheels or by pushing it. The complete sentence is: His role in the play required him to roll a giant prop onto the stage. Hence, (a) is the correct answer. Note: Option c) is incorrect as the infinitive marker 'to' is to be followed by the base verb only, whereas 'rolles' is the third person singular form of the verb. Infinitive marker: A word or affix attached to the stem of a verb in order to form the full infinitive. In English, to is the infinitive marker.

t:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the word in brackets to fill in the blanks.
She accepted both the good and the bad with ___ (AGITATION).
e:
Agitation: a feeling of aggravation, annoyance, restlessness, or nervousness
Equanimity: mental or emotional stability or composure, especially under tension or strain
So, the two words can be used as antonyms of each other. Hence, (c) is the correct answer.
Remorse: deep and painful regret for wrongdoing

t:
Select the most appropriate homophones to fill the blanks.
She had to ___________ the ___________ to stop the water from leaking.
e:
"Seal" is the verb that means to close off or block something to prevent the passage of air or water. "Ceiling" refers to the overhead surface that covers the top of a room. In this context, the person needs to seal something (like a crack or gap) in the ceiling to stop the water from leaking through it.
Other options are contextually incorrect.
The complete sentence is "She had to seal the ceiling to stop the water from leaking."
Hence, option (a) is correct.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
The ability to impart knowledge and ______ respect is the essential qualification for teachers.
e: A base verb would fit in the blank to follow parallelism with another base verb 'impart' placed before the conjunction 'and'. So, the noun 'disappearance' is eliminated. The sentence intends to convey that giving knowledge and respect is the basic requirement in any teacher. Since, 'respect' can be either given or received so the words 'improve' and worsen' cannot fit in. Thus, 'command(give)' is the correct choice. Hence, option (d) is correct. Note: Parallelism: In grammar, parallelism, also known as parallel structure or parallel construction, is a balance within one or more sentences of similar phrases or clauses that have the same grammatical structure. Given below is an example which shows a sentence in two forms (parallel in structure and lacking parallelism): Lacking parallelism: Prerna likes cooking, dancing and to sing. Parallel: Prerna likes cooking, dancing and singing.

t:
Select the most appropriate homophone of the underlined word to fill in the blank.
She decided to <u>wear</u> her new jewellery. It is made of silver ______.
e:
The most appropriate homophone of the underlined word to fill in the blank is 'ware'. This word means manufactured articles of a specified type. The other options are not suitable homophones of the verb 'wear', which means to have on one's body or part of one's body as clothing, decoration, protection, or for some other purpose. 'Were' means second person singular past, plural past, and past subjunctive of be, 'weir' means a low dam built across a river to raise the level of water upstream or regulate its flow, and 'where' means in or to what place or position.
Hence, option (b) is the correct answer.

t:
Select the most appropriate homonym of the underlined word to fill in the blank.
He <u>bowed</u> to the audience after his performance. His performance ______ well for the future of the organization.
e:
In this sentence, the context suggests that the blank needs to be filled with a word that describes the gesture he received from the audience after bowing.
"Board" is not the correct choice. It's a verb that refers to get on or into (a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle). It doesn't fit the context of a performance and audience appreciation. "Board" as a noun also does not fit in the sentence contextually.
"Bald" is not the correct choice. It's an adjective that describes a lack of hair. It doesn't fit the context of the sentence.
"Bough" is not the correct choice. It's a noun that refers to a main branch of a tree. It doesn't fit the context of the sentence.
"Bode" is the correct choice. In this context, "bode" means to be a sign of something good or bad for the future. The sentence indicates that he received a positive response from the audience, which matches the context of appreciation after a performance.
Hence, option (d) is the correct answer.

t: Select the most appropriate phrasal verb to fill in the blank. When the primary strategy failed, the company had to __________ its emergency reserves to sustain operations.
e: Explanation: The correct answer is option (2). English Explanation: “Fall back on” means to rely on something as a backup option when the original plan fails. In the sentence, when the primary strategy failed, the company relied on its emergency reserves to continue operations. Therefore, “fall back on” correctly conveys the idea of using a reserve or alternative resource in times of difficulty. “Fall through” means to fail to happen. “Fall apart” means to break into pieces or collapse emotionally. “Fall out” means to quarrel or to become detached. Since the context refers to depending on emergency reserves as a backup, “fall back on” is the most appropriate fit. 1. Fall through (विफल हो जाना) Meaning in Hindi: किसी योजना का पूरा न हो पाना। Example: The deal fell through at the last minute. (सौदा आखिरी समय पर विफल हो गया।) 2. Fall back on (सहारा लेना / बैकअप के रूप में निर्भर होना) Meaning in Hindi: अन्य विकल्प विफल होने पर किसी चीज़ पर निर्भर होना। Example 1: When his main plan failed, he fell back on his savings to continue his preparation. (मुख्य योजना विफल होने पर उसने अपनी बचत का सहारा लिया।) Example 2: She always falls back on her experience during tough situations. (कठिन परिस्थितियों में वह हमेशा अपने अनुभव का सहारा लेती है।) 3. Fall apart (टूट जाना / बिखर जाना) Meaning in Hindi: किसी चीज़ का टूट जाना या व्यक्ति का भावनात्मक रूप से टूट जाना। Example: The old building began to fall apart. (पुरानी इमारत टूटने लगी।) 4. Fall out (झगड़ा होना / अलग हो जाना) Meaning in Hindi: किसी से विवाद हो जाना या अलग हो जाना। Example: They fell out over a minor issue. (वे एक छोटी सी बात पर झगड़ पड़े।)

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
Poonam used a rubber <u>band</u> to keep the pencils together. 'Band' here means ____________.
o: a long rigid piece of wood or metal
a thin ring of rubber used for holding things together
a range of values or frequencies within a series
e:
The word "band" in the context of holding pencils together refers to a rubber band, specifically a thin ring of rubber used for bundling items. 'Band' here means a thin ring of rubber used for holding things together.
A long rigid piece of wood or metal- Refers to a rigid strip, unsuitable for holding pencils flexibly.
A tube filled with water-Unrelated to holding objects together.
A range of values or frequencies within a series-Refers to an abstract concept, not a physical object.
Hence, the correct answer is option (c).

t:
Select the most appropriate homonyms from the given alternatives to fill in the blanks.
The judge decided to ________ the case to ________ it.
A. close (shut)
B. clause (provision in legal text)
C. close (end/conclude)
e:
First blank: The verb "close" (C) fits correctly as it refers to ending or concluding the case.
Second blank: The verb "close" (A) refers to shutting or finishing something, which aligns with the meaning in this context.
The judge is performing an action (verb), so the appropriate homonyms must align logically to form a meaningful sentence.
The complete sentence is: The judge decided to close the case to close it.
Hence, the correct answer is option (d).

t:
Select the most appropriate homophone of the underlined word to fill in the blank.
The bookstore had a huge <u>sale</u> on musical books, so he bought one to learn the ______ on his guitar.
e:
The most appropriate homophone of the underlined word to fill in the blank is 'scale'. This word means an arrangement of the notes in any system of music in ascending or descending order of pitch. The other options are not suitable homophones of 'sale', which means a period during which a shop or dealer sells goods at reduced prices. 'Sail' means a piece of material extended on a mast to catch the wind and propel a boat or ship or other vessel, 'gale' means a very strong wind, and 'seal' means a marine mammal or a device that prevents leakage.
Hence, option (d) is the correct answer.

t:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.
Rajvir asked his son not to __________ him in front of the guests.
e: Among the given options, "abash" fits the context of the sentence. It gives us the idea that Rajvir requested that his son refrains from embarrassing him in front of the guests. Abash: make (someone) feel embarrassed or disconcerted. The word that must fit the blank should be a verb as Rajvir requested his son not to do something (in this case, embarrass him). 'Aberration' is a noun and thus, it is an incorrect option. 'Elucidate' and 'expedite' are contextual misfits as per their meanings. Thus, the correct option is (a), abash. Thus, the correct sentence should be: Rajvir asked his son not to abash him in front of the guests. Additional Information: The respective meanings of the other options are given below in the table:WordMeaningAberrationa departure from what is normal, usual, or expectedElucidateexplainExpediteaccelerate

t:
In the following passage, a word has been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
Manpower exporters and overseas recruiter's commonly________ in illegal business practices for short-term______ gain.
e: The given sentence mentions a few exporters and recruiters related with illegal business practices. The first blank would represent the action by the subject 'exporters and recruiters' with respect to illegal business practices. So, 'honoured' will not fit in contextually. Hence, option (a) is negated. The verb 'regulated' requires the object to denote what is controlled by the subject, which is absent in the given sentence. So, option (c) is incorrect as well. 'Devotional gain' and 'illegal business practices' have no relation. So, option (d) is incorrect as well. Filling the blanks with 'indulged' (means 'to take unrestrained pleasure in') and 'monetary' (means 'of or relating to money') gives the meaning that such people engage in illegal practices to earn money illegally. Hence, option (b) is the answer. The correct sentence is: Manpower exporters and overseas recruiters commonly indulged in illegal business practices for short-term monetary gain.

t:
Select the most appropriate homophone to fill in the blank. 
The breathtaking mountain view was a mesmerizing _____ that left us in awe of nature's beauty.
e:
Sight: "Sight" refers to the ability to see or the act of seeing. It can also be used to describe a visually pleasing or impressive view.
Cite: "Cite" is a verb that means to quote or refer to a source as evidence or justification.
Side: a position to the left or right of an object, place, or central point.
Kite: "Kite" is a noun that describes a toy or object flown in the air, typically tethered to a string.
In the given sentence, the context is about a breathtaking mountain view that is mesmerizing and leaves people in awe of nature's beauty. The appropriate term to fill in the blank is something visually impressive, which is "sight." Hence, (a) is the correct answer. 
The sentence would read: "The breathtaking mountain view was a mesmerizing sight that left us in awe of nature's beauty."

t:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.
Leif Erikson is a Viking ________ believed to have sailed from the Green Lands to Vinland. Vinland is now thought to be the northern tip of Canada's Newfoundland island where ________ found evidence of Erikson's ________ in 1960s.
e:
Option a: "astronomer; sculptors; colony"-Leif Erikson was not an astronomer (studying stars), sculptors create art (not relevant to finding evidence), and while "colony" is plausible, it is less precise than "settlement."
Option b: "explorer; archaeologists; settlement"-Leif Erikson was a Viking explorer, archaeologists found evidence (correct profession), and "settlement" accurately describes what was discovered in Newfoundland.
Option c: "sailor; excavators; packed"-While Erikson was a sailor, "explorer" is more specific. Excavators are similar to archaeologists but less precise, and "packed" is irrelevant.
Option d: "calligrapher; historians; community"- A calligrapher (writing artist) is irrelevant, historians study but don't typically find physical evidence, and "community" is less precise than "settlement."

t:
Select the most appropriate homonym of the underlined word to fill in the blank.
He <u>ate</u> his lunch quickly. He was very hungry after his morning ______.
e:
In this sentence, the context suggests that the blank needs to be filled with a word that describes an activity or situation that he experienced in the morning. 
"Eight" is not the correct choice. It's a numeral that represents the number 8. It doesn't fit the context of an activity or situation in the morning.
"Bate" is not the correct choice. The word means "an angry mood". It doesn't fit in the context. 
"Weight" is not the correct choice. It's a noun that refers to the measure of the heaviness of an object. It doesn't fit the context of an activity or situation in the morning.
"Wait" is the correct choice. In this context, "wait" is a noun that refers to the period of time when he was waiting, possibly for his lunch or for some other activity. The sentence suggests that he was very hungry after waiting in the morning.
Hence, option (d) is the correct answer.

t:
Select the most appropriate homonyms to fill in the blanks.
The rowing instructor commanded them to ________ in a ________.
A. row (verb)
B. roe
C. row(sequence)
e:
• Row (verb) - To move a boat using oars.
• Row (noun, sequence) - A line of objects or people.
• Roe (noun) - Fish eggs (incorrect here).
The correct sentence:
"The rowing instructor commanded them to row in a row."
Thus, Option 4 (A, C) is correct.

t:
A sentence is given with a blank to be filled in with appropriate word. Four alternatives are suggested. Choose the correct option.
The ________ between the Indian and Pakistani armies still continues.
e: Dual means two. Match means competition. Duel means a prearranged contest with deadly weapons between two people in order to settle a dispute. Deal means agreement. Hence the suitable filler for the given sentence is 'duel'.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
She behaves ________ she were the queen of the entire world.
e: The sentence describes someone's behaviour by comparing it to an unreal or hypothetical situation. The use of "were" (subjunctive mood) indicates that the situation is imaginary - she is not actually the queen. The blank requires a conjunction that can introduce such a hypothetical or unreal comparison. The correct option is "as if". This conjunction is used to talk about an imaginary situation or a situation that may not be true. It is correctly paired with the subjunctive mood ("were") to describe her behaviour. The other options do not fit: · "like" is often used informally in this way, but in formal grammar, "as if" or "as though" is preferred before a clause (a group of words with a subject and a verb). · "since" gives a reason or indicates a point in time. · "when" refers to a specific time. Thus, the correct sentence is: "She behaves as if she were the queen of the entire world." Hence, option (b) is the answer. Note: A conjunction (also called a connective) is a word such as and, because, but, for, if, or, when etc. Conjunctions are used to connect phrases, clauses, and sentences.

t: Select the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank. She didn't _____ the answer, so she asked her teacher for help.
e:
The given sentence talks about how the girl didn't have the information or understanding of the answer, so she asked her teacher for assistance. The word "know" means to have knowledge or awareness of something. So, in this context, it fits perfectly. Hence, (b) is the correct answer.
The final sentence: She didn't know the answer, so she asked her teacher for help.
No- a negative response or refusal.
Now- It refers to the present moment in time.
Knew- the past tense of the verb "know" [cannot fit after 'did'].

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
Several environmentalists from the city conducted a meet to discuss issues related to the ______ pollution levels created by the growing number of pharmaceutical companies.
e:
The blank requires a noun that indicates some changes to the pollution levels which are influenced by the pharmaceutical companies. 'Arise in' is an incorrect form of verb as 'arise' means 'get up or stand up or emerge' which is not relevant to the context of the sentence and thus negated. 'Rising from' has the preposition 'from' as an extra which is not required and so, it is negated. 'Raising of' means 'bringing up a person or animal from childhood' which is contextually irrelevant to the sentence and thus negated. 'Rise in' (an increase in number, size, amount, or degree) denotes an increase in some quantity or value of pollution levels by the pharmaceutical companies and it is also grammatically correct.
Hence, the correct answer is option (b).

t: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank(s). The stock market _____ a significant surge, _____ record-breaking highs.
e:
The adverb 'exclusively' doesn't fit in the first position [a verb is needed to complete the clause]. So, option (a) is eliminated. The -ing verb 'culminating' needs a helping verb before it. Since there is no helping verb before the first blank, option (b) is also eliminated. The adverb 'heavily' doesn't fit in the second position [a verb is needed to complete the sentence]. So, option (c) is eliminated. 
Among the given options, option (d) contains the most appropriate combination of words. 
Hence, option (d) is the correct answer. 
The complete sentence is: The stock market experienced a significant surge, reaching record-breaking highs.

t:
Select the correct homonym from the given options to fill in the blank.
He got hurt by running into a _____.
e:
The blank requires a noun that denotes the thing that caused injury to the subject. Accordingly, 'pole' (a long, slender, rounded piece of wood or metal, typically used with one end placed in the ground as a support for something) is the most appropriate word that matches the context of the sentence and can thus fill the blank.
Poll- the process of voting in an election.
Pol- a politician.
Poal has no meaning.
The complete sentence is: He got hurt by running into a pole.
Hence, the correct answer is option (c).

t:
Select the most appropriate homophones to fill in the blanks.
The ___________ of the worker was very loud when he found the ___________.
e: Option (a) is the correct choice. A roar is a loud, deep sound uttered by a person or crowd. An ore is a naturally occurring solid material from which a metal or valuable mineral can be extracted. The sentence is about the excitement of the worker when he found the mineral.

t:
Select the correct homonym from the given options to fill in the blank.
She ______ the maid's workload.
e:
The blank requires a verb that denotes the action done to affect the maid's workload. Accordingly, 'lessens' (make or become less) is the most appropriate word that matches the context of the sentence and can thus fill the blank.
Lessons- a period of learning or teaching.
Listens- give one's attention to a sound.
Lenses- a curved piece of glass, plastic, or other transparent material.
The complete sentence is: She lessens the maid's workload.
Hence, the correct answer is option (a).

t:
Select the correctly spelt word to fill in the blank.
We are entering a point where technology will change at __________ speeds.
e:
"Extreme" is correctly spelled and fits the context of rapid technological change.
Inferier: Misspelled; correct is "inferior."
Suprime: Misspelled; correct is "supreme."
Modarate: Misspelled; correct is "moderate."
Hence, the correct answer is option (a).

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
I ___ hear him yelling at his neighbours yesternight in a drunken state.
e:
'Could' refers to an ability that a person generally had in the past or to something that was generally possible in the past. The given sentence is in the past tense as indicated by the words 'yesternight' and 'could' used here in a similar context. Hence, (b) is the correct answer.
'Can' is used to denote strength, power, potential or authority.
'Will' is used when someone is determined or sure to do something; it is used emphatically.
'Shall' is used to express ideas related to specific rules or laws or used in the future tense to speak about something that will happen or exits, or it expresses promises of the future.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.
Fingernails and toenails helped our _________ to climb trees, peel fruits and use simple tools. While their colour and condition offer clues about your ________health. Nail polish turns them into fashion accessories.
e: · For the first blank, "ancestors" is the most fitting term, as it refers to early humans or primates who used fingernails and toenails for survival tasks like climbing and tool use, which aligns with evolutionary context. · For the second blank, "overall" is appropriate because it accurately describes the general state of health that nail color and condition can indicate, such as signs of nutritional deficiencies or medical conditions. The other options do not fit as well contextually or grammatically. For example, "predecessor" and "forefather" are less specific to evolutionary history, and "universal" or "altogether" do not convey the intended meaning for health. The completed sentence would read: "Fingernails and toenails helped our ancestors to climb trees, peel fruits and use simple tools. While their colour and condition offer clues about your overall health. Nail polish turns them into fashion accessories."

t: Select the most appropriate phrasal verb to fill in the blank. The employee thought he could __________ submitting false reports without anyone noticing.
e: Explanation: The correct answer is option (1). English Explanation: “Get away with” means to do something wrong or illegal without being punished or caught. In the sentence, the employee believed he could submit false reports without anyone noticing or taking action against him. Therefore, “get away with” correctly conveys the idea of escaping punishment for wrongdoing. “Get over” means to recover from something. “Get through” means to complete or successfully finish something. “Get by” means to manage or survive with difficulty. Since the context involves avoiding consequences for misconduct, “get away with” is the most appropriate fit. 1. Get away with: अपराध या गलती करके भी बिना सज़ा पाए बच जाना Example 1: He got away with cheating in the exam. (वह परीक्षा में नकल करके भी बच गया।) 2. Get over (उबर जाना) Example: It took him months to get over the accident. (उसे दुर्घटना से उबरने में महीनों लगे।) 3. Get through (पूरा कर लेना / सफलतापूर्वक पार करना) Example: She finally got through the entrance exam. (वह अंततः प्रवेश परीक्षा पास कर गई।) 4. Get by (किसी तरह काम चला लेना) Example: They manage to get by on a small salary. (वे कम वेतन में किसी तरह गुज़ारा कर लेते हैं।)

t:
Select the most appropriate homonym of the underlined word to fill in the blank.
The _______ treaty ended the long-standing conflict between the two nations. The leaders shook hands and gave each other a <u>piece</u> of cake.
e:
In this sentence, the context suggests that the blank needs to be filled with a word that indicates a treaty that brings an end to a conflict. 
"Peas" is not the correct choice. It's a plural noun referring to a type of vegetable. It doesn't fit the context of a treaty ending a conflict.
"Pierce" is not the correct choice. It means 'to go into or through something, making a hole in it using a sharp point'. It does not fit in contextually and grammatically (the blank requires either a noun to form a noun phrase or an adjective to modify the noun 'treaty', but 'pierce' is a verb) as well. 
"Peak" is not the correct choice. It's a noun that usually refers to the pointed top of a mountain or a high point. It doesn't fit the context of a treaty or conflict resolution.
"Peace" is the correct choice. It's a noun that refers to a state of harmony and absence of conflict. It perfectly fits the context of a treaty ending a long-standing conflict between nations.
Hence, option (d) is the correct answer.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank(s).
The old bookstore with its ________ wooden floors and shelves lined with ________ volumes, exuded a nostalgic charm that drew readers seeking solace in the ________ pages of classic literature.
e:
The words 'creaky, ancient, and weathered' appropriately describe an old bookstore with worn wooden floors and aged book volumes, enhancing the nostalgic atmosphere mentioned in the sentence.
'Creaky' means 'making or liable to make a creaking sound when being moved or when pressure is applied'.
'Weathered' means 'worn by long exposure to the atmosphere'.
'New' and 'modern' do not fit in contextually to explain 'volumes' (of books) in an old bookstore. 'Glossy' is not an appropriate adjective for books. 
Hence, (b) is the correct answer.

t:
Select the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank. 
The ___ of friends giggled together, forming a tight circle in the school hallway.
e:
The most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank is 'clique'. "Clique" refers to a small, exclusive group of people who associate closely and often exclude others. In the given sentence, it suggests that a group of friends giggled together, forming a tight circle in the school hallway. Other options do not fit the context of the sentence. "Cluck" typically refers to the sound made by a chicken. "Cleek" refers to a hook-shaped instrument. "Click" refers to a short, sharp sound or operating a computer mouse. 
The complete sentence is: The clique of friends giggled together, forming a tight circle in the school hallway.
Hence, (d) is the correct answer.

t:
Select the correct homonym from the given options to fill in the blank.
The artist has gone past his ____ days.
e: The blank requires an adjective to qualify the noun 'days' and describe its nature. Accordingly, 'peak' (at the highest level) is the most appropriate word that matches the context of the sentence and can thus fill the blank. Peek- look quickly or furtively. Peke- a Pekinese dog. Pick - an act or the right of selecting something from a number of alternatives. The complete sentence is: The artist has gone past his peak days. Hence, the correct answer is option (c). Note: Qualifiers: A word or phrase that limits the meaning of another word or phrase or makes it less general. 'Adverbs' and 'adjectives' are qualifiers.

t:
In the question given below, a sentence is given with two blanks, followed by four options, each having two words that may or may not fit in the blanks. From the given options, choose the one that has the correct pair of words to fit in the given blanks.
I'm very much ____ who will pay an artist ___ a thing that they've made.
e: The presence of relative pronoun 'who' suggests that there should be a pronoun too in the sentence whom it can refer to, so 'someone' is the pronoun that is apt for the first blank which is referring to the noun 'I'. With this, 'for' would fit in the second blank as it is used to showcase a reason or a cause. Hence, option (b) is correct. NOTE: Relative pronouns: A relative pronoun is used to connect a clause or phrase to a noun or pronoun. The clause modifies, or describes, the noun. The most common relative pronouns are who, whom, whose, which, and that. For example: She is the girl who received the award for bravery from our Home Minister.

t:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks. 
Plants play a crucial role in cleaning the air by taking in carbon dioxide and releasing oxygen during photosynthesis, which helps _____ atmospheric gases. They also ____ as natural air filters by capturing dust, pollutants, and other particulates on their surfaces, thereby reducing airborne contaminants.
e:
The most appropriate option to fill in the first blank is 'balance'. 'Balance' means to bring into harmony or equilibrium. In the sentence, it indicates that plants help to stabilise or regulate atmospheric gases by taking in carbon dioxide and releasing oxygen. Other words do not fit the context of the sentence. 'Withdraw' means to take back or remove. 'Express' means to convey or communicate. 'Disclose' means to reveal or make known.
The most appropriate option to fill in the second blank is 'act'. 'Act' means to perform a function or role. In the sentence, it describes how plants function as natural air filters by capturing dust and pollutants. Other words do not fit the context of the sentence.
